examples.en: The mock transcript includes civil witness testimony about the date of a fictional delivery.
examples.zh: 模拟庭审笔录包含有关一次虚构交付日期的「民事证人证言」。

examples.en: We considered the civil witness testimony separately from the arguments made by the parties.
examples.zh: 我们将「民事证人证言」与当事人提出的论点分开考察。

words.enDefinition: Combining multiple claims for resolution within one civil proceeding under applicable rules

examples.en: The federal example illustrates claim joinder by placing several claims in one complaint.
examples.zh: 联邦程序示例将几项主张写进同一起诉状，说明「请求合并」。

examples.en: We marked the issue of claim joinder separately from which parties were included.
examples.zh: 我们把「请求合并」问题与包括哪些当事人的问题分开标记。

words.enDefinition: Party who brings a claim under the civil rules of England and Wales

examples.en: The fictional form labels the claimant in the first box of the document.
examples.zh: 虚构表格在文件第一个方框内标明了「原告」。

examples.en: We used claimant when reading an England and Wales specimen claim form.
examples.zh: 我们在阅读英格兰和威尔士的样本起诉表时，了解提出请求的一方为何称为「原告」。

words.enDefinition: Group of people a particular statutory requirement is intended to protect

examples.en: The California handout asks who belongs to the class of persons protected by the fictional rule.
examples.zh: 加州法律讲义问，哪些人属于虚构规定所指的「受保护的人群」。

examples.en: We marked the class of persons protected before considering how the alleged harm occurred.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「受保护的人群」，再讨论所称损害如何发生。

collocations: identify the class of persons protected
within the class of persons protected
discuss the class of persons protected

words.enDefinition: a code used to classify fields of instructional programs in North America, including in related immigration tables

examples.en: The Canadian classroom table uses a Classification of Instructional Programs code to identify a program's subject field.
examples.zh: 加拿大课堂表格用「教学项目分类代码」标示项目所属专业领域。

examples.en: We read the Classification of Instructional Programs code before matching it to a description in the example table.
examples.zh: 我们先读取「教学项目分类代码」，再与示例表中的一条描述对应。

collocations: verify a Classification of Instructional Programs code
record the Classification of Instructional Programs code
Classification of Instructional Programs code for a program

words.enDefinition: A rule requiring sufficiently clear statutory language before attributing particular legal consequences to an enactment.

examples.en: Our comparative seminar asks why the fictional court invokes a clear statement rule for one interpretive issue.
examples.zh: 比较法研讨课询问，虚构法院为何在某个解释问题上援引「明确表述规则」。

examples.en: We read the disputed wording to identify what the clear statement rule requires in the fictional judgment.
examples.zh: 我们阅读争议措辞，找出虚构判决所述「明确表述规则」有什么要求。

words.enDefinition: In England and Wales, the inquiry into whether a wrong is sufficiently linked to the functions assigned to the person who committed it for vicarious liability.

examples.en: In our English tort seminar, we applied the close connection test to agreed facts about a worker's duties.
examples.zh: 在英格兰侵权法研讨课中，我们根据双方认可的劳动者职责事实运用「密切关联测试」。

examples.en: The case summary separates the close connection test from the initial question about the nature of the relationship.
examples.zh: 案例摘要将「密切关联测试」与最初的关系性质问题分开。

collocations: requirements of the close connection test

words.expression: closing argument in a civil trial
words.lemma: closing argument in a civil trial
words.enDefinition: Final presentation connecting the admitted evidence to a party's requested outcome
acceptedEnVariants: closing argument in a civil trial

examples.en: The federal exercise ends the hearing with a closing argument in a civil trial from each side.
examples.zh: 联邦程序练习以双方各自的「民事庭审结案陈词」作为庭审结尾。

examples.en: We compared the closing argument in a civil trial with the evidence described earlier in the packet.
examples.zh: 我们将「民事庭审结案陈词」与文件包前面描述的证据作了比较。

collocations: give a closing argument in a civil trial
read a closing argument in a civil trial
fictional closing argument in a civil trial

words.enDefinition: The codification of generally applicable and permanent rules published by US federal departments and agencies.

examples.en: The American law handout shows how the Code of Federal Regulations arranges agency rules by subject.
examples.zh: 美国法律讲义展示了「《美国联邦法规汇编》」如何按主题编排各机构制定的规则。

examples.en: We located the title number in the sample Code of Federal Regulations citation before reading the section.
examples.zh: 阅读该节法规以前，我们先在「《美国联邦法规汇编》」的引文样本中找出编号。

collocations: title of the Code of Federal Regulations
section of the Code of Federal Regulations
codified in the Code of Federal Regulations

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚入学确认编号
words.enDefinition: the identifying code of a provider-issued Confirmation of Enrolment in the Australian student visa system
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚入学确认编号

examples.en: The CoE code appears next to the course dates on the fictional enrolment confirmation used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的虚构入学确认材料把「澳大利亚入学确认编号」列在课程日期旁。

examples.en: We matched the CoE code in the sample visa file with the corresponding confirmation listed by the provider.
examples.zh: 我们将样例签证档案中的「澳大利亚入学确认编号」与教育机构列出的确认记录对应起来。

words.enDefinition: Review of a conviction through a separate legal proceeding rather than the ordinary direct appeal process.

examples.en: The seminar placed collateral review of a conviction on a separate branch of its fictional procedure chart.
examples.zh: 讨论课将「对定罪的另行审查」标在虚构程序图的一条独立分支上。

examples.en: We read the mock federal opinion to identify when it discussed collateral review of a conviction.
examples.zh: 我们阅读模拟联邦判决，找出其中哪些地方讨论了「对定罪的另行审查」。

collocations: seek collateral review of a conviction
a classroom example of collateral review of a conviction
the scope of collateral review of a conviction

words.enDefinition: To start having legal effect, when said of legislation or a particular provision.

examples.en: The fictional order states when three sections come into force and leaves the other dates for later.
examples.zh: 虚构命令列出三项条文何时「开始生效」，其余日期留待以后确定。

examples.en: Our reading exercise asks whether both provisions come into force on the same date under the sample Act.
examples.zh: 阅读练习询问，按照样本法令，两项条文是否在同一天「开始生效」。

collocations: come into force on a specified date

words.enDefinition: A UK legal instrument made under statutory power to bring provisions of legislation into force.

examples.en: The tutor used a fictional commencement order to explain why some provisions take effect later than others.
examples.zh: 老师用一份虚构「生效令」解释为什么有些条文比其他条文晚生效。

examples.en: We matched the commencement order to the section that authorised it in the classroom materials.
examples.zh: 我们把课堂材料里的「生效令」与授权制定它的条文对应起来。

collocations: come into force under a commencement order
date specified in a commencement order

words.enDefinition: A provision that states or determines when some or all of an enactment comes into force.

examples.en: In the fictional Act, a commencement provision gives different start dates for two groups of sections.
examples.zh: 在虚构法令中，一项「生效条款」为两组条文规定了不同的起始日期。

examples.en: We read the commencement provision before deciding which version applied on the date in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在判断练习所列日期适用哪个版本以前，我们先阅读了「生效条款」。

words.enDefinition: Practical business considerations that can help assess plausible interpretations in English contract law.

examples.en: The English mock judgment used commercial common sense to compare two readings that the wording could support.
examples.zh: 模拟英格兰判决运用「商业常识」，比较措辞能支持的两种理解。

examples.en: We discussed commercial common sense after tracing how each interpretation would affect the fictional printing arrangement.
examples.zh: 我们分析每种解释对虚构印刷安排的影响后，讨论了「商业常识」。

collocations: an argument based on commercial common sense

words.enDefinition: under some US contract rules, a ground for excusing performance made impracticable by a contingency whose nonoccurrence was a basic assumption

examples.en: The New York exercise considered commercial impracticability after a contingency undermined a basic assumption of the sale.
examples.zh: 某项偶发事件打破买卖的基本假设后，纽约州习题讨论了「商业上不能合理履行」。

examples.en: The class distinguished commercial impracticability from an ordinary increase in a fictional supplier's costs.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「商业上不能合理履行」与虚构供应方成本的一般上涨。

words.zhGloss: 商业协议法律意图推定
words.enDefinition: In English contract law, the rebuttable inference that parties in a commercial setting intend legal consequences.
acceptedZhAnswers: 商业协议法律意图推定

examples.en: The English classroom opinion considered the commercial presumption when two fictional campus suppliers exchanged written commitments.
examples.zh: 两家虚构校园供应商交换书面承诺时，英格兰课堂判决示例考虑了「商业协议法律意图推定」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the draft wording could rebut the commercial presumption in the fictional printing agreement.
examples.zh: 我们讨论虚构印刷协议草案中的措辞能否推翻「商业协议法律意图推定」。

words.enDefinition: A person or business that regularly sells products as part of commercial activity, a status relevant in product liability.

examples.en: The imaginary stationery company appears as a commercial seller in the product liability case materials for today's class.
examples.zh: 虚构文具公司在今天课上的产品责任案例材料中扮演「经营性卖方」。

examples.en: Our chart separates a commercial seller from a student who occasionally sells a personal item at a fair.
examples.zh: 我们的表格把「经营性卖方」与偶尔在市集出售私人物品的学生区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Authority over shared parts of premises such as a building entrance or hallway, relevant to allocating responsibility.

examples.en: The group compared the lease and service contract to decide who held common-area control in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 小组比较租赁合同和服务合同，以判断在假设案例中谁拥有「对公共区域的控制」。

examples.en: The foyer appears on both floor plans, but the clause on common-area control mentions only one landlord.
examples.zh: 两张平面图都标了门厅，但有关「对公共区域的控制」的条款只提到一位房东。

words.zhGloss: 占用人对来访者的共同注意义务
words.enDefinition: The statutory duty in England and Wales to take reasonable care for a visitor's safety when using premises for the permitted purpose.
acceptedZhAnswers: 占用人对来访者的共同注意义务

examples.en: In English law class, we applied the common duty of care to a fictional museum's visitors.
examples.zh: 在英格兰法课上，我们用「占用人对来访者的共同注意义务」分析一家虚构博物馆的访客案例。

examples.en: The answer on the common duty of care discusses the stated purpose of the gallery visit.
examples.zh: 有关「占用人对来访者的共同注意义务」的答案讨论了所述的到访画廊目的。

collocations: owe the common duty of care
breach the common duty of care
scope of the common duty of care

words.enDefinition: A body of legal principles developed through court decisions, in one common use of the term.

examples.en: The introductory reading discusses common law before turning to legislation enacted by the fictional jurisdiction's assembly.
examples.zh: 入门读物先讨论「普通法判例规则体系」，再谈虚构司法辖区议会制定的法律。

examples.en: We identified which principles came from the common law and which were set out in the assigned statute.
examples.zh: 我们辨明哪些原则来自「普通法判例规则体系」，以及哪些原则由指定制定法明确规定。

words.zhGloss: 普通法上的合法性原则
words.enDefinition: In UK statutory interpretation, the principle that legislation is read as preserving fundamental rights unless clear language or necessary implication displaces them.
acceptedZhAnswers: 普通法上的合法性原则

examples.en: The English law handout illustrates the common law principle of legality through a fictional provision about court access.
examples.zh: 英格兰法讲义用一项关于诉诸法院的虚构条文说明「普通法上的合法性原则」。

examples.en: The class asks which words matter to the common law principle of legality in the fictional judgment.
examples.zh: 全班讨论虚构判决中的哪些文字与「普通法上的合法性原则」有关。

collocations: apply the common law principle of legality
invoke the common law principle of legality
explain the common law principle of legality

words.enDefinition: Conveying assent to the offeror in the manner required or recognized by the applicable rules.

examples.en: The classroom problem separated communication of acceptance from the recipient's private decision to agree to the offer.
examples.zh: 课堂题区分了「承诺的通知」与收件人私下决定同意要约。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which transmission counted as communication of acceptance in the fictional exchange about printed posters.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，在印制海报的虚构交流中，哪次发送构成「承诺的通知」。

collocations: the timing of communication of acceptance

words.enDefinition: In England and Wales, a sentence requiring compliance with specified conditions in the community.

examples.en: The classroom decision classified a community order as a sentence served in the community under applicable requirements.
examples.zh: 课堂裁定把「社区刑罚令」归为按适用要求在社区执行的刑罚。

examples.en: We found the community order in the fictional England and Wales judgment before comparing the other outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们先在英格兰与威尔士虚构判决里找到「社区刑罚令」，再比较其他结果。

collocations: the terms of a community order
a court record of a community order

words.enDefinition: Framework comparing parties' responsibility when allocating compensation under the applicable law

examples.en: The course introduces comparative fault using an invented case with two contributing acts.
examples.zh: 课程用涉及两项促成行为的虚构案例介绍「比较过失」。

examples.en: We compared comparative fault with the rule illustrated by the other state.
examples.zh: 我们将「比较过失」与另一州所展示的规则作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 过失侵权的补偿性赔偿
words.enDefinition: Money awarded to compensate for loss legally caused by the negligence
acceptedZhAnswers: 过失侵权的补偿性赔偿

examples.en: The worksheet groups the hypothetical award under compensatory damages in negligence after liability is assumed.
examples.zh: 习题假定责任成立后，将题设赔偿归为「过失侵权的补偿性赔偿」。

examples.en: We discussed compensatory damages in negligence using an invented valuation of a damaged classroom display.
examples.zh: 我们借助一份展品受损的虚构估价讨论「过失侵权的补偿性赔偿」。

collocations: purpose of compensatory damages in negligence

words.enDefinition: performance that satisfies all remaining duties required from a party under a contract

examples.en: The final list treated the installation and missing manual together as necessary for complete performance in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习的最终清单将安装和补交缺失说明书一并列为「完全履行」所需事项。

examples.en: We marked complete performance on the timeline only after the last promised item had been delivered.
examples.zh: 只有最后一件承诺交付的物品也已交付，我们才在时间线上标出「完全履行」。

words.enDefinition: the change of a student record to Completed when the program and applicable authorized period have ended

examples.en: The fictional report marks completion of a SEVIS record at the end of the listed student timeline.
examples.zh: 虚构报告在所列学生时间线的末尾标出「完成SEVIS记录」。

examples.en: We distinguished a date of completion of a SEVIS record from the earlier academic completion date in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分「完成SEVIS记录」的日期与较早的学业完成日期。

collocations: confirm completion of a SEVIS record
date of completion of a SEVIS record
status after completion of a SEVIS record

words.enDefinition: A defect in a specific component considered on its own, rather than one attributed solely to the finished assembly.

examples.en: In the classroom example, the expert report locates the component part defect in a single supplied piece.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中的专家报告认定「零部件缺陷」出在一件单独供应的部件上。

examples.en: The mock appeal separates an alleged component part defect from a problem with the overall assembled design.
examples.zh: 模拟上诉把所称的「零部件缺陷」与整体组装设计中的问题区分开来。

collocations: liability for a component part defect

words.enDefinition: A business that makes a part intended for incorporation into a larger product, with liability assessed under applicable rules.

examples.en: The class distinguished the component part manufacturer from the company that assembled the fictional desk timer.
examples.zh: 全班区分了「零部件制造商」和组装虚构桌面计时器的公司。

examples.en: A signed order identifies the component part manufacturer in the packet for the fictional product liability problem.
examples.zh: 一份签署过的订单在虚构产品责任题的材料中注明了「零部件制造商」。

collocations: liability of a component part manufacturer
supply agreement with a component part manufacturer

words.enDefinition: Counterclaim federal rules require to be pleaded when specified conditions apply

examples.en: The federal law worksheet classifies a compulsory counterclaim within the related dispute.
examples.zh: 联邦法律习题将相关争议中的一项请求归为「强制性反诉」。

examples.en: We compared the compulsory counterclaim with another claim involving a separate fictional transaction.
examples.zh: 我们将「强制性反诉」与涉及另一项虚构交易的请求作了比较。

words.expression: conclusions of law in a civil case
words.lemma: conclusions of law in a civil case
words.enDefinition: Determinations about the legal consequences of the facts found in a civil dispute
acceptedEnVariants: conclusions of law in a civil case

examples.en: The federal mock decision puts conclusions of law in a civil case after the factual findings.
examples.zh: 联邦法院模拟裁判将「民事案件法律结论」放在事实认定之后。

examples.en: We identified conclusions of law in a civil case by looking at the court's application of the rule.
examples.zh: 我们通过查看法院如何应用规则，辨认出了「民事案件法律结论」。

collocations: state conclusions of law in a civil case
read conclusions of law in a civil case
separate conclusions of law in a civil case

words.enDefinition: The requirement that the relevant mental state coincide with and relate to the conduct constituting the offense.

examples.en: The mock court examined the timeline to decide whether the concurrence requirement was satisfied in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 模拟法庭查看时间线，判断假设案例是否满足「主客观要件并存要求」。

examples.en: We discussed the concurrence requirement after separating the mental state and the conduct in the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表中把心理状态与行为分开标注，再讨论「主客观要件并存要求」。

collocations: an issue about the concurrence requirement

words.enDefinition: Two or more causes operating together in producing the same outcome

examples.en: The hypothetical describes concurrent causes that together damage the fictional display model.
examples.zh: 假设案例描述了共同导致虚构展示模型受损的「并存原因」。

examples.en: We tracked the concurrent causes on two lines leading to the same result.
examples.zh: 我们沿通向同一结果的两条线分别查看「并存原因」。

words.enDefinition: reciprocal conditions under which each party's duty depends on the other's performance or tender at the same time

examples.en: The model sale treats payment and tender of the goods as concurrent conditions under the agreed exchange.
examples.zh: 示例买卖将付款与提出交货视为约定交换中的「同时履行条件」。

examples.en: We placed the concurrent conditions side by side on the fictional sale's timeline to show their timing.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构买卖的时间线上将「同时履行条件」并排放置，以显示它们的时序。

words.enDefinition: two or more remedies for a contractual failure that may coexist under the applicable rules

examples.en: The judge in the worksheet considered concurrent contractual remedies while ensuring the same loss was compensated only once.
examples.zh: 练习中的法官考虑「并存的合同救济」，同时确保同一损失只获赔一次。

examples.en: We reviewed concurrent contractual remedies without assuming that every requested combination was allowed under the stated law.
examples.zh: 我们依照指定法律审查「并存的合同救济」，没有把所有请求的组合都假定为可行。

words.enDefinition: Sentences ordered to run during the same period to the extent determined by the applicable judgment or law.

examples.en: The sentencing diagram used overlapping bars to illustrate concurrent sentences in the fictional court record.
examples.zh: 量刑图用相互重叠的条形来表示虚构法院卷宗中的「同时执行的刑罚」。

examples.en: We read the order for concurrent sentences before checking the timeline in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们先读了判处「同时执行的刑罚」的裁定，再核对课堂题的时间线。

collocations: review the entry for concurrent sentences

words.enDefinition: Persons whose separate torts contribute to the same damage

examples.en: Our invented scenario describes concurrent tortfeasors in connection with one indivisible result.
examples.zh: 虚构情境描述了与一个不可分结果有关的「并发侵权人」。

examples.en: We located both concurrent tortfeasors on the timeline of the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂题设的时间线上标出了两名「并发侵权人」。

words.zhGloss: 同意裁判结果的单独意见
words.enDefinition: A separate opinion that agrees with the court's result and may give different or additional reasoning.
acceptedZhAnswers: 同意裁判结果的单独意见

examples.en: The student underlined how the concurring opinion reached the same result using a narrower statutory interpretation.
examples.zh: 学生划出了「同意裁判结果的单独意见」如何通过更窄的法条解释得出相同结果。

examples.en: In the fictional judgment, the concurring opinion agrees with the disposition but gives an additional reason.
examples.zh: 虚构判决中的「同意裁判结果的单独意见」赞同处理结果，并补充了一项理由。

words.expression: condition at the time of sale
words.lemma: condition at the time of sale
words.enDefinition: The product's physical state at the time it was sold, relevant when evaluating whether a defect was already present then.
acceptedEnVariants: condition at the time of sale

examples.en: The expert's report addresses the condition at the time of sale of the fictional desk lamp.
examples.zh: 专家报告论述了虚构台灯在「出售时的产品状况」。

examples.en: The class compared the condition at the time of sale with the condition recorded three years later.
examples.zh: 全班将「出售时的产品状况」与三年后记录的状况进行比较。

collocations: establish the condition at the time of sale
evidence of condition at the time of sale
assess condition at the time of sale

words.enDefinition: an event that must occur before a specified contractual duty becomes due unless its occurrence is excused

examples.en: The contract problem made completion of the inspection a condition precedent to performance of the payment duty.
examples.zh: 合同例题把完成检查定为支付义务的「履行先决条件」。

examples.en: We marked the condition precedent to performance on the timeline before the date on which payment became due.
examples.zh: 我们在时间线上，将「履行先决条件」标在付款到期日之前。

collocations: satisfy a condition precedent to performance
waive a condition precedent to performance
failure of a condition precedent to performance

words.enDefinition: an event whose occurrence ends a duty that otherwise exists, subject to the terms and governing law

examples.en: In the fictional case, the condition subsequent ended the ongoing payment obligation when the stated event occurred.
examples.zh: 在虚构案例中，约定事件发生并触发「解除条件」后，持续的支付义务终止。

examples.en: We drew the condition subsequent after the duty began, using a separate marker for its possible discharge.
examples.zh: 我们把「解除条件」画在义务开始之后，并用单独标记表示该义务可能解除。

collocations: duty discharged by a condition subsequent

words.enDefinition: An event or requirement that must be satisfied before the proposed contract comes into existence.

examples.en: The mock draft treated committee approval as a condition to formation of the fictional exhibition contract.
examples.zh: 模拟草案将委员会批准列为虚构展览的「合同成立条件」。

examples.en: We distinguished a condition to formation from a requirement governing later performance in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂例题中，我们区分了「合同成立条件」与约束后续履行的要求。

words.enDefinition: A response that makes agreement to an offer depend on the offeror agreeing to a further condition.

examples.en: We classified the fictional response as a conditional acceptance because it depended on a different room being included.
examples.zh: 虚构回复以另一个房间也纳入协议为条件，我们把它归为「附条件承诺」。

examples.en: The seminar compared conditional acceptance under a common law example and a separate model about goods.
examples.zh: 讨论课对比了一道普通法案例与一道货物案例中的「附条件承诺」。

words.enDefinition: A gift that depends on an event not sought as the price of a promise.

examples.en: The mock problem called the free program a conditional gift because collection at the desk was required.
examples.zh: 模拟题把免费节目单视为「附条件赠与」，领取人必须到服务台取。

examples.en: We debated whether the fictional arrangement was a conditional gift or an exchange for a requested service.
examples.zh: 我们讨论这一虚构安排属于「附条件赠与」，还是用来换取指定服务的交易。

collocations: a promise of a conditional gift
distinguish a conditional gift from an exchange

words.enDefinition: The part of an offense definition specifying the act or omission that must be established.

examples.en: The worksheet placed the conduct element in a separate column from the specified result in the fictional statute.
examples.zh: 习题将虚构法规中的「行为要件」与指定结果分列在不同栏中。

examples.en: We marked the conduct element first before classifying the remaining parts of the classroom provision.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「行为要件」，再对课堂条文的其余部分进行归类。

words.expression: confirmation of course completion for immigration
words.lemma: confirmation of course completion for immigration
words.enDefinition: information supplied by an education provider confirming successful completion of a course for a specified immigration purpose
acceptedEnVariants: confirmation of course completion for immigration

examples.en: The fictional file lists confirmation of course completion for immigration after the final assessment record for the course.
examples.zh: 虚构档案在课程最终考核记录之后列出「移民用课程完成确认」。

examples.en: We read the confirmation of course completion for immigration alongside the course finish date in the example.
examples.zh: 我们将「移民用课程完成确认」与示例中的课程结束日期一并阅读。

collocations: record confirmation of course completion for immigration
check confirmation of course completion for immigration
provide confirmation of course completion for immigration

words.enDefinition: an offer of delivery in which the goods and the manner of offering them satisfy the contract

examples.en: The fictional seller made a conforming tender by offering the specified goods at the agreed place and time.
examples.zh: 虚构卖方在约定地点和时间准备交付指定货物，构成「合约交付的提出」。

examples.en: We identified the conforming tender after checking the model order's quantity and delivery conditions in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们核对了示例订单的数量和交付条件后，辨认出「合约交付的提出」。

words.enDefinition: Sentences ordered to run one after another rather than during the same period.

examples.en: The fictional sentencing chart placed consecutive sentences in separate intervals, one beginning after the other ended.
examples.zh: 虚构量刑图将「连续执行的刑罚」放在不同时间段中，一个结束后另一个才开始。

examples.en: We marked consecutive sentences on the classroom diagram before comparing them with the overlapping periods.
examples.zh: 我们先在课堂图上标出「连续执行的刑罚」，再与重叠的时间段作比较。

collocations: read an order for consecutive sentences

words.enDefinition: Binding court order based on terms agreed by parties to a civil case

examples.en: Our England and Wales worksheet labels the approved terms a consent order in civil proceedings.
examples.zh: 我们的英格兰及威尔士练习把法院批准的条款标注为「民事诉讼合意令」。

examples.en: A consent order in civil proceedings appears in the sample file after both sides agree.
examples.zh: 双方达成一致后，示例案卷中出现了一份「民事诉讼合意令」。

collocations: approve a consent order in civil proceedings
make a consent order in civil proceedings
terms of a consent order in civil proceedings

words.enDefinition: A change to another provision or law needed to accommodate or maintain consistency with a principal legislative change.

examples.en: The sample statute lists a consequential amendment replacing an outdated reference introduced by an earlier Act.
examples.zh: 制定法样本列出一处「相应修订」，替换早期法令引入的一项过时引用。

examples.en: We identified the consequential amendment by reading the schedule alongside the main provision in the fictional bill.
examples.zh: 我们将附表与虚构议案的主要条文对照阅读，找出了「相应修订」。

words.enDefinition: compensation for further loss flowing from breach through the injured party's circumstances, subject to applicable remoteness and proof rules

examples.en: The hypothetical retailer sought consequential damages for breach for a separate loss linked to its promised resale.
examples.zh: 假设零售商就与已承诺转售有关的额外损失，请求「违约后果性损失赔偿」。

examples.en: We reviewed the stated circumstances before deciding whether the assigned rule allowed consequential damages for breach.
examples.zh: 在依据指定规则判断能否获得「违约后果性损失赔偿」之前，我们先查阅所述情形。

words.enDefinition: Financial loss resulting from physical harm to the claimant or their property
acceptedEnVariants: economic loss consequential on physical damage

examples.en: The fictional organizer earns less after the display damage, illustrating consequential economic loss in class.
examples.zh: 虚构组织者在展品受损后收入减少，课堂用这个例子说明「继发性经济损失」。

examples.en: We separated consequential economic loss from the cost of fixing the modeled property itself.
examples.zh: 我们将「继发性经济损失」与修理模型物品本身的费用分开。

words.enDefinition: a contract term seeking to exclude loss categorized as consequential under the applicable interpretation and law

examples.en: The seminar considered how to interpret the consequential loss exclusion in the hypothetical supply contract's particular wording.
examples.zh: 研讨课结合假设供货合同的具体措辞，讨论如何解释「后果性损失排除」。

examples.en: We compared consequential loss exclusion with the separate cap on claims that were still covered in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们将「后果性损失排除」与练习中对仍列入保障范围的请求另设的上限作了比较。

collocations: rely on a consequential loss exclusion
scope of a consequential loss exclusion

words.enDefinition: Additional terms that do not contradict a final writing and may supplement it under applicable United States law.

examples.en: The New York exercise asked whether consistent additional terms could supplement the classroom's final but incomplete writing.
examples.zh: 纽约州练习问，「相容的补充条款」能否补充课堂案例中最终但不完整的书面文书。

examples.en: We examined the text before classifying the alleged additions as consistent additional terms in the fictional dispute.
examples.zh: 我们先审阅文本，再判断虚构争议中所称的增订内容是否属于「相容的补充条款」。

collocations: admit evidence of consistent additional terms
a dispute about consistent additional terms

words.enDefinition: An Act bringing existing statutory provisions on a subject together into a single legislative text.

examples.en: The tutor assigned a fictional consolidating Act to show how provisions from several earlier laws could be collected.
examples.zh: 老师指定阅读一部虚构「汇整法令」，说明如何汇集早先多部法律的条款。

examples.en: Our legal history exercise traces three provisions back to their sources before they appeared in the consolidating Act.
examples.zh: 法律史练习追溯了三项条文被收入「汇整法令」之前的来源。

collocations: consolidate legislation in a consolidating Act

words.enDefinition: A US interpretive principle favouring a plausible construction that avoids serious constitutional doubt when the statute permits it.

examples.en: The American casebook uses constitutional avoidance to explain a court's choice between two plausible statutory readings.
examples.zh: 美国案例教材用「避免宪法疑义原则」解释法院如何在两种合理的法条解读间作选择。

examples.en: The mock opinion discusses constitutional avoidance only after identifying a serious constitutional question in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 模拟意见先在课堂示例中指出一个严肃的宪法问题，随后才讨论「避免宪法疑义原则」。

words.enDefinition: A particular rule or clause forming part of a written constitution.

examples.en: The mock judgment starts with the constitutional provision quoted near the beginning of the course handout.
examples.zh: 模拟判决先讨论课程讲义开头附近引用的「宪法条款」。

examples.en: Our worksheet separates the text of the constitutional provision from the professor's explanatory notes beside it.
examples.zh: 练习单把「宪法条款」正文与教授写在旁边的注释分开。

words.enDefinition: Knowledge imputed when a person reasonably should have known of a danger

examples.en: The case study asks whether the facts support constructive knowledge of a risk in the fictional situation.
examples.zh: 案例讨论问，事实是否支持在虚构情境中「推定当事人知悉风险」。

examples.en: We drew a distinction between awareness and constructive knowledge of a risk in our course notes.
examples.zh: 我们在课程笔记中区分了实际知情和「对风险的推定知悉」。

collocations: consider constructive knowledge of a risk
facts supporting constructive knowledge of a risk
distinguish constructive knowledge of a risk

words.enDefinition: Knowledge the law attributes to a party when the premises condition should reasonably have been discovered.

examples.en: The California example asks students to distinguish constructive notice of a condition from a documented complaint.
examples.zh: 加州示例要求学生区分「对状况的推定知悉」与已有记录的一次投诉。

examples.en: The inspection dates are relevant to constructive notice of a condition in the fictional shopping arcade.
examples.zh: 在这个虚构的购物廊案例中，检查日期与「对状况的推定知悉」有关。

collocations: infer constructive notice of a condition
evidence of constructive notice of a condition
dispute constructive notice of a condition

words.enDefinition: processing of a visa application through a US embassy or consulate in the applicable category

examples.en: The lesson diagram places consular processing at the US diplomatic post handling the fictional visa application.
examples.zh: 课程示意图将「领事办理程序」标在处理虚构签证申请的美国外交机构。

examples.en: We distinguished consular processing from a hypothetical change-of-status request filed within the United States.
examples.zh: 我们区分「领事办理程序」与假设在美国境内提交的身份变更请求。

words.enDefinition: A product design test comparing a product's safety performance with what ordinary consumers would expect in relevant use conditions.

examples.en: The California notes introduce the consumer expectations test with a familiar household item and a fictional report.
examples.zh: 加州课程笔记用一种常见家用品和一份虚构报告来介绍「消费者期望测试」。

examples.en: The judge in our mock instruction discusses when the consumer expectations test can be used by jurors.
examples.zh: 模拟审判中的法官说明了陪审员可以在什么情况下使用「消费者期望测试」。

words.enDefinition: An oral agreement made at about the time the parties adopt a written agreement.

examples.en: The American worksheet asked whether a contemporaneous oral agreement contradicted the final wording in the fictional contract.
examples.zh: 美国习题问，一份「同期口头协议」是否与虚构合同的最终措辞相矛盾。

examples.en: We placed the contemporaneous oral agreement alongside the signed writing on the timeline of the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂题的时间线上把「同期口头协议」与已签署的书面文书并排标出。

collocations: evidence of a contemporaneous oral agreement
a dispute about a contemporaneous oral agreement

words.enDefinition: An interpretive approach that considers the contract's words in their textual and relevant factual setting.

examples.en: The English law exercise used contextual interpretation to relate the disputed wording to the wider agreement.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法练习运用「语境解释」，考察争议措辞与协议整体之间的关系。

examples.en: We discussed contextual interpretation after reading the fictional contract alongside the circumstances known to both parties.
examples.zh: 把虚构合同与双方都知道的相关情形一起阅读后，我们讨论了「语境解释」。

collocations: a contextual interpretation of a clause
consider contextual interpretation in a case

words.enDefinition: A nuisance treated as persisting or recurring under the applicable law, rather than arising only from a completed event.

examples.en: The English case reading uses a continuing nuisance example to discuss repeated interference with nearby property.
examples.zh: 英格兰案例读物用一则「持续性滋扰」示例讨论对毗邻地产反复造成的干扰。

examples.en: We marked each recurrence on the fictional timeline before discussing whether the claim involved a continuing nuisance.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构时间线上标出每次反复发生的情况，然后讨论该请求是否涉及「持续性滋扰」。

words.zhGloss: 作不利于条款提供方的解释
words.enDefinition: Where applicable, construing unresolved ambiguity against the party that supplied the disputed wording.
acceptedZhAnswers: 作不利于条款提供方的解释

examples.en: The mock judgment considered contra proferentem after finding two plausible readings of the provision drafted by one party.
examples.zh: 模拟判决发现一方拟定的条款有两种合理理解后，考察是否「作不利于条款提供方的解释」。

examples.en: We discussed contra proferentem as one possible interpretive principle in the fictional classroom dispute over an ambiguous provision.
examples.zh: 我们把「作不利于条款提供方的解释」作为课堂虚构条款歧义争议中的一种可能原则来讨论。

words.enDefinition: In English law, a contract embodied in a document given legal effect as a deed.

examples.en: The English materials labeled the classroom instrument a contract by deed and asked about its legal form.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律材料把课堂文书标为「契据合同」，并请我们识别其法律形式。

examples.en: We found the wording identifying the contract by deed on the first page of the fictional document.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构文书的第一页找到了将其标明为「契据合同」的措辞。

collocations: a contract by deed under English law

words.enDefinition: A separately signed copy of the same contract that forms part of one signed agreement.

examples.en: The tutor identified each contract counterpart by matching the text across both signed classroom copies.
examples.zh: 辅导老师对照课堂两份已签副本的文本，辨认各份「合同签署副本」。

examples.en: We treated the second contract counterpart as part of the same fictional agreement about the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们把第二份「合同签署副本」视为同一份虚构展览协议的一部分。

words.enDefinition: The ranking of contract documents used to decide which controls when provisions conflict.

examples.en: The contract document hierarchy in our exercise ranked the main text above the attached programme schedule.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中的「合同文件优先顺序」将正文列在所附活动安排表之前。

examples.en: We checked the contract document hierarchy after finding different dates in two fictional exhibition documents.
examples.zh: 发现两份虚构展览文件的日期不一致后，我们核对了「合同文件优先顺序」。

collocations: apply the contract document hierarchy in a classroom example

words.enDefinition: The legal process by which parties come to a binding agreement.

examples.en: The seminar separated contract formation from later duties in its fictional dispute about a student exhibition.
examples.zh: 讨论课用一则虚构的学生展览争议，区分「合同订立」与后续义务。

examples.en: We drew a timeline of contract formation from the first email to the final classroom agreement.
examples.zh: 我们画出「合同订立」时间线，从第一封邮件一直标到课堂案例中的最终协议。

words.enDefinition: An actual agreement inferred from the parties' conduct and circumstances rather than explicitly stated in words.

examples.en: The American hypothetical asked whether the groups' behavior supported a contract implied in fact about the display materials.
examples.zh: 美国假设案例问，各组的行为能否证明双方就展品材料达成了「事实默示合同」。

examples.en: We examined the conduct in the fictional record before discussing whether it demonstrated a contract implied in fact.
examples.zh: 我们考察虚构记录中的行为，再讨论它是否表明存在一份「事实默示合同」。

collocations: find a contract implied in fact
facts supporting a contract implied in fact
an example of a contract implied in fact

words.enDefinition: In United States usage, a standardized contract offered without meaningful opportunity to negotiate its terms.

examples.en: The American exercise asked whether the fictional campus form qualified as a contract of adhesion.
examples.zh: 美国课堂题问，虚构的校园表格是否属于「附合合同」。

examples.en: We read the facts about possible negotiations before classifying the document as a contract of adhesion.
examples.zh: 在把文书归类为「附合合同」之前，我们先阅读了有无协商机会的事实。

collocations: a potentially one-sided contract of adhesion

words.enDefinition: An introductory statement setting out the background or purpose of an agreement.

examples.en: The first contract recital explained why the fictional student groups planned to share exhibition materials.
examples.zh: 第一项「合同背景陈述」解释了虚构学生团体为何打算共享展览材料。

examples.en: We marked the contract recital before reading the later provisions about the parties' agreed commitments.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「合同背景陈述」，再读后面的双方承诺条款。

collocations: the wording of a contract recital

words.enDefinition: An attached part of a contract that sets out details such as dates, items, or specifications.

examples.en: The contract schedule listed the fictional exhibition rooms and corresponding dates in a separate table.
examples.zh: 「合同附表」在一张单独的表里列出了虚构展览各房间和相应日期。

examples.en: We checked the contract schedule after finding a short reference to it in the main agreement.
examples.zh: 我们在主协议看到一处简短引用后，查阅了「合同附表」。

collocations: a date in a contract schedule
include details in a contract schedule

words.enDefinition: A minor's legal ability to enter a contract, subject to local rules and exceptions.

examples.en: The American exercise asked how local rules affected the contractual capacity of a minor in the fictional purchase.
examples.zh: 美国习题问，当地规则如何影响虚构购买案例中「未成年人的缔约能力」。

examples.en: We compared two classroom examples about the contractual capacity of a minor without assuming the rules were identical.
examples.zh: 我们对比了两道关于「未成年人的缔约能力」的课堂案例，留意其适用规则。

collocations: discuss the contractual capacity of a minor
an issue about the contractual capacity of a minor
a reading about the contractual capacity of a minor

words.enDefinition: a contractual provision or effect preventing a specified claim from being brought or maintained when legally effective

examples.en: The mock opinion discusses a contractual claims bar tied to a requirement in the parties' fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构判词讨论了与当事方虚构协议中一项要求相关的「合同请求权限制」。

examples.en: We identified which claims the contractual claims bar purported to cover in the classroom case note.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂案例注释中识别「合同请求权限制」拟涵盖哪些请求。

collocations: limits on a contractual claims bar

words.enDefinition: Something of legal value given or promised in exchange for a promise under applicable common law rules.

examples.en: The seminar asked what contractual consideration the fictional print shop received for its promise to supply posters.
examples.zh: 讨论课问，虚构印刷店承诺提供海报，换来的「合同对价」是什么。

examples.en: We highlighted contractual consideration on both sides of the exchange described in the American classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们用高亮标出美国课堂题所述交易双方提供的「合同对价」。

words.enDefinition: an obligation under an agreement to provide or pay for another party's defense against certain claims

examples.en: The fictional agreement imposed a contractual duty to defend specified third-party claims before their merits were decided.
examples.zh: 虚构协议规定，在特定第三方请求的实体争议得到裁判前，当事方须承担「合同约定的抗辩义务」。

examples.en: We compared when the contractual duty to defend arose with when any payment for covered loss was due.
examples.zh: 我们对照「合同约定的抗辩义务」的发生时间与所涵盖损失的付款到期时间。

collocations: trigger a contractual duty to defend
scope of a contractual duty to defend
enforce a contractual duty to defend

words.enDefinition: a court order restraining or sometimes requiring action in connection with a contractual right

examples.en: The fictional claimant requested a contractual injunction to protect a restricted use of material under the assigned agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构请求人申请「合同禁令」，以保护题设协议对资料用途作出的限制。

examples.en: The class compared a proposed contractual injunction with an award of damages limited to past use.
examples.zh: 全班将拟议的「合同禁令」与只对已经发生的使用给予赔偿的裁决作比较。

words.enDefinition: a term specifying when interest accrues on a sum and how it is determined under the agreement

examples.en: The contractual interest clause set out how interest would accrue on overdue installments in the fictional plan.
examples.zh: 虚构付款计划的「合同利息条款」规定逾期分期款如何计息。

examples.en: We checked whether the contractual interest clause applied before comparing it with the fictional judgment's interest award.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「合同利息条款」是否适用，再与虚构判决判给的利息作比较。

collocations: scope of a contractual interest clause

words.enDefinition: Determining the meaning of a contract and its provisions under the applicable legal approach.

examples.en: The seminar used contractual interpretation to explain why a disputed phrase changed meaning when read in context.
examples.zh: 讨论课运用「合同解释」说明为什么结合上下文阅读时，争议短语的含义发生变化。

examples.en: We separated contractual interpretation from assessing whether the fictional student groups had made an agreement at all.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同解释」与判断虚构学生团体是否达成协议分开分析。

words.enDefinition: An incorrect belief at the time of agreement that may matter under the applicable contract rules.

examples.en: The seminar raised contractual mistake after finding that both fictional groups had assumed the same room was available.
examples.zh: 我们发现虚构的两组都以为同一房间可用后，讨论课提出了「缔约错误」问题。

examples.en: We compared two forms of contractual mistake before reading the mock court's conclusion about the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两种「缔约错误」，再读模拟法院对该协议的结论。

collocations: assess a claim of contractual mistake

words.enDefinition: a period specified for giving notice or for time to pass after notice before it takes effect

examples.en: The model termination letter referred to the contractual notice period listed in the agreement signed by both parties.
examples.zh: 示例终止函提到双方签署的协议里列明的「合同约定的通知期」。

examples.en: We tracked the contractual notice period using the separate dates shown for sending and receipt in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们按练习中各自列出的发出与收悉日期，追踪「合同约定的通知期」。

collocations: comply with a contractual notice period
expiry of the contractual notice period

words.enDefinition: A proposal showing willingness to be bound on stated terms if the other party accepts.

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the second email made a contractual offer about printing the fictional festival programs.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，第二封邮件是否就印制虚构节庆的节目单发出了「合同要约」。

examples.en: We identified a contractual offer by looking for words inviting agreement to specified terms in the mock exchange.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟交流中寻找邀请对方同意既定条款的措辞，以识别「合同要约」。

words.enDefinition: carrying out an obligation under an enforceable agreement

examples.en: The seminar compared the promised delivery date with the date of contractual performance in a fictional dispute.
examples.zh: 研讨课在虚构争议中，将约定交货日期和「合同履行」日期作了比较。

examples.en: The chart identifies actions that counted as contractual performance under the assumed terms of the agreement.
examples.zh: 图表指出了按假定的协议条款，哪些行为算作「合同履行」。

collocations: measure contractual performance against the terms

words.enDefinition: Recovery between persons liable for the same damage under the applicable law

examples.en: The English law chart discusses contribution between tortfeasors after showing the claimant's modeled award.
examples.zh: 英格兰法图表展示原告的模型赔偿后，讨论「侵权人之间的分担」。

examples.en: We compared contribution between tortfeasors with the defendant's obligation toward the fictional claimant.
examples.zh: 我们将「侵权人之间的分担」与被告对虚构原告承担的义务作比较。

words.enDefinition: Claimant's failure to exercise reasonable care contributing to their own harm

examples.en: The English and Welsh law exercise considers contributory negligence in a fictional property dispute.
examples.zh: 英格兰及威尔士法律练习在虚构财产纠纷中讨论「与有过失」。

examples.en: We discussed contributory negligence before considering the possible reduction of the modeled award.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「与有过失」，再考察模型赔偿数额可能减少多少。

words.enDefinition: Maryland rule generally blocking recovery for causally contributing negligence by the claimant

examples.en: The Maryland law chart places the contributory negligence bar beside a different state's rule.
examples.zh: 马里兰州法律图表将「与有过失阻却获赔」与另一州的规则并列。

examples.en: We discussed the contributory negligence bar as a regional rule in the fictional exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构练习中把「与有过失阻却获赔」作为一项地区规则讨论。

collocations: scope of the contributory negligence bar

words.enDefinition: A wrongful exercise of control over personal property sufficiently serious to interfere with another person's possessory rights under applicable law.

examples.en: The California case exercise illustrates conversion of personal property using a fictional dispute about a borrowed camera.
examples.zh: 加州案例练习用一起涉及借用相机的虚构争议说明「非法支配他人动产」。

examples.en: The mock brief distinguishes conversion of personal property from a brief interruption in the borrower's use.
examples.zh: 模拟诉状把「非法支配他人动产」与短暂妨碍借用人使用物品区分开来。

collocations: claim for conversion of personal property
damages for conversion of personal property

words.enDefinition: Criminal responsibility attributed to a corporation under rules governing how conduct and mental states are assigned to it.

examples.en: The seminar examined corporate criminal liability separately from the responsibility of a fictional individual in the record.
examples.zh: 讨论课分别考察「法人刑事责任」与卷宗中虚构个人的责任。

examples.en: We read the attribution provision before discussing corporate criminal liability in the abstract classroom case.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读归责条文，再讨论抽象课堂案例中的「法人刑事责任」。

collocations: a doctrine of corporate criminal liability
an issue of corporate criminal liability

words.enDefinition: the reasonable expense of correcting defective performance, used as a possible measure of loss in some contexts

examples.en: The classroom example compared the cost of cure with the lower value of the model item as delivered.
examples.zh: 课堂示例将「修补费用」与所交付示例物的价值减损作比较。

examples.en: We checked whether the mock court used the cost of cure to measure the loss from defective work.
examples.zh: 我们核对虚构法院是否用「修补费用」来衡量工作有瑕疵造成的损失。

collocations: damages measured by the cost of cure

words.enDefinition: Order concerning responsibility for litigation costs under applicable civil rules

examples.en: The England and Wales packet includes a costs order in civil proceedings beside the decision.
examples.zh: 英格兰和威尔士程序文件包在裁判旁附有一项「民事诉讼费用裁定」。

examples.en: We identified the costs order in civil proceedings separately from the award in the example.
examples.zh: 我们将示例中的「民事诉讼费用裁定」与赔偿分开辨认。

collocations: make a costs order in civil proceedings
read a costs order in civil proceedings
explain a costs order in civil proceedings

words.enDefinition: A separately numbered allegation of a particular offense stated in an indictment.

examples.en: The fictional federal opinion reviewed one count of an indictment before summarizing the jury's findings on that charge.
examples.zh: 虚构联邦判决先审查「起诉书中的一项指控」，再概述陪审团对该项指控的认定。

examples.en: We matched one count of an indictment to the corresponding line on the mock verdict form.
examples.zh: 我们把「起诉书中的一项指控」与模拟裁决表上的对应行配对。

collocations: read a count of an indictment
a separate count of an indictment
the elements in a count of an indictment

words.enDefinition: A specific count in a criminal case on which guilt has been legally established.

examples.en: The mock judgment listed each count of conviction beside the finding it recorded for that charge.
examples.zh: 模拟判决在各「据以定罪的指控项」旁列出了相应的有罪认定。

examples.en: We compared the original charges with each count of conviction shown in the classroom final record.
examples.zh: 我们将最初的指控与课堂最终记录里列出的各个「据以定罪的指控项」作比较。

collocations: a sentence for a count of conviction

words.zhGloss: 过失法上的反事实比较
words.enDefinition: Comparison of the actual outcome with the outcome under hypothesized careful conduct
acceptedZhAnswers: 过失法上的反事实比较

examples.en: The exercise uses a counterfactual comparison in negligence to distinguish the actual and imagined outcomes.
examples.zh: 练习通过「过失法上的反事实比较」区分实际结果和假想结果。

examples.en: We stated the assumptions before completing the counterfactual comparison in negligence for the fictional case.
examples.zh: 我们先说明假设，再完成虚构案例的「过失法上的反事实比较」。

collocations: make a counterfactual comparison in negligence
model a counterfactual comparison in negligence
assumptions in counterfactual comparison in negligence

words.enDefinition: the course charges or payment information recorded by a UK student sponsor in a student's CAS

examples.en: We compared course fees on the CAS with the amount on a separate receipt in the fictional file.
examples.zh: 我们将「CAS所列课程学费」与虚构档案中另一份收据显示的金额作比较。

examples.en: The exercise shows course fees on the CAS beside the sums that the institution had already received.
examples.zh: 练习将「CAS所列课程学费」与院校已经收取的金额并列显示。

collocations: check course fees on the CAS
record course fees on the CAS
compare course fees on the CAS

words.zhGloss: 学生担保所认定课程级别
words.enDefinition: the level of a UK course stated for immigration sponsorship purposes under the applicable qualification framework
acceptedZhAnswers: 学生担保所认定课程级别

examples.en: The fictional record shows the course level for student sponsorship in a separate field from the academic subject.
examples.zh: 虚构记录将「学生担保所认定课程级别」与学科分别放在不同栏位。

examples.en: We compared the course level for student sponsorship with the qualification framework used in the UK classroom case.
examples.zh: 我们将「学生担保所认定课程级别」与英国课堂案例所用资格框架对照。

collocations: record the course level for student sponsorship
confirm the course level for student sponsorship
framework for the course level for student sponsorship

words.enDefinition: A pattern from prior transactions between the same parties that may establish a shared understanding.

examples.en: The New York hypothetical used course of dealing to discuss how the parties understood an abbreviated label.
examples.zh: 纽约州假设题通过「以往交易惯例」讨论双方如何理解一个缩写标签。

examples.en: We examined several earlier transactions before identifying a possible course of dealing in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 课堂题中，我们考察了此前的几次交易，再辨认可能存在的「以往交易惯例」。

collocations: evidence of a course of dealing

words.zhGloss: 本合同的实际履行惯例
words.enDefinition: In UCC usage, repeated conduct under the same transaction when the other party knows its nature and accepts it or acquiesces without objection.
acceptedZhAnswers: 本合同的实际履行惯例

examples.en: The New York goods worksheet asked whether repeated conduct under one agreement established a course of performance.
examples.zh: 纽约州货物买卖习题问，同一协议下反复发生的行为是否形成「本合同的实际履行惯例」。

examples.en: We distinguished course of performance under the current fictional agreement from exchanges arising under earlier agreements.
examples.zh: 我们区分了当前虚构协议中的「本合同的实际履行惯例」与此前协议下的交易。

collocations: evidence from a course of performance
interpret terms using course of performance

words.enDefinition: a requirement for overseas students to make satisfactory academic progress under the relevant Australian condition or provider standard

examples.en: The classroom extract places the course progress requirement in the part covering ongoing contact with the education provider.
examples.zh: 课堂节选在涉及与教育机构持续联系的部分列出「课程进度要求」。

examples.en: We compared the course progress requirement with the separate attendance information in the fictional study record.
examples.zh: 我们将「课程进度要求」与虚构学习记录中另列的出勤信息作比较。

collocations: evidence relevant to a course progress requirement

words.zhGloss: 法院关联替代争议解决
words.enDefinition: Dispute resolution services organized through or affiliated with a court
acceptedZhAnswers: 法院关联替代争议解决

examples.en: The handout lists the neutral evaluation program under court-connected ADR for that court.
examples.zh: 讲义把中立评估项目归入该法院的「法院关联替代争议解决」服务。

examples.en: We compared the sample court-connected ADR program with privately arranged mediation during class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们比较了示例中的「法院关联替代争议解决」项目和自行安排的调解。

words.enDefinition: Mediation that a court directs parties to attend or participate in

examples.en: In our English procedure exercise, the timetable includes a period for court-ordered mediation.
examples.zh: 在英格兰程序练习中，时间表列出一段用于「法院命令的调解」的时间。

examples.en: The fictional judge explained that court-ordered mediation still left the settlement decision to both parties.
examples.zh: 虚构案例中的法官解释说，「法院命令的调解」仍由双方决定是否和解。

collocations: refer a case to court-ordered mediation

words.enDefinition: under applicable US sales law, recovery based on the cost of cover less the contract price, with permitted adjustments

examples.en: In the New York exercise, cover damages started from the difference between the replacement and contract prices.
examples.zh: 在纽约州练习中，「替代采购差额赔偿」从替代货物价格与合同价的差额算起。

examples.en: We considered saved expenses when reviewing cover damages for the fictional buyer under the specified sales rule.
examples.zh: 我们按指定买卖规则审查虚构买方的「替代采购差额赔偿」时，考虑了节省的费用。

words.enDefinition: Conduct worsening another's position by creating or increasing a relevant risk

examples.en: The fictional judgment considers creation of danger before deciding whether the omissions principle applies.
examples.zh: 虚构判决先考虑是否有「危险创设」，再判断不作为规则是否适用。

examples.en: We flagged creation of danger on the chart to separate it from simple inaction.
examples.zh: 我们在图上标出「危险创设」，将它与单纯未采取行动区分开来。

collocations: creation of danger by a defendant

words.enDefinition: Recognition of qualifying time already spent in custody when calculating a term under applicable law.

examples.en: The mock record noted credit for time served in a separate line of the sentencing discussion.
examples.zh: 模拟卷宗在量刑讨论的独立一行记载了「已羁押时间折抵」。

examples.en: We identified credit for time served before reading the fictional calculation in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中先找出「已羁押时间折抵」，再读虚构的计算结果。

collocations: a ruling about credit for time served
the meaning of credit for time served

words.enDefinition: the code identifying a particular course on Australia's Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Courses for Overseas Students

examples.en: The classroom register extract uses a CRICOS course code beside the title of the model diploma program.
examples.zh: 课堂名录节选在示例文凭项目的名称旁列出「CRICOS课程代码」。

examples.en: We matched the CRICOS course code to the program description before comparing the fictional documents in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先将「CRICOS课程代码」与项目描述对应，再比较虚构文件。

collocations: look up a CRICOS course code
program identified by a CRICOS course code

words.enDefinition: registration of a provider or course on Australia's official register for overseas student education

examples.en: The official extract shows CRICOS registration beside the course included in the fictional Australian study record.
examples.zh: 官方资料节选在虚构澳大利亚学习记录的课程旁列出「CRICOS注册登记」。

examples.en: We distinguished CRICOS registration for a course from the university's general academic accreditation in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们区分课堂示例中课程的「CRICOS注册登记」与大学的一般学术认证。

words.enDefinition: An offense requiring intent and legally sufficient conduct directed toward committing another offense.

examples.en: The classroom statute identified criminal attempt separately from the completed offense described in the next provision.
examples.zh: 课堂示例法规将「犯罪未遂」与下一条文描述的既遂犯罪分别列出。

examples.en: We matched criminal attempt to the mock judgment's section on intent and the applicable legal threshold.
examples.zh: 我们将「犯罪未遂」与模拟判决中关于故意及适用法律门槛的章节对应起来。

words.enDefinition: The relationship required to attribute a specified result to conduct for criminal responsibility.

examples.en: The mock ruling addressed criminal causation because the fictional charge depended on a specified result.
examples.zh: 由于虚构指控取决于是否发生特定结果，模拟裁定讨论了「刑法上的因果关系」。

examples.en: We compared two analyses of criminal causation in the absence of any disputed mental state.
examples.zh: 在心理状态没有争议的题设下，我们对照了两种关于「刑法上的因果关系」的分析。

words.enDefinition: In United States federal practice, a sworn written statement of essential facts alleging an offense.

examples.en: The mock federal case file placed the criminal complaint beside the corresponding entry about the initial appearance.
examples.zh: 模拟联邦案件卷宗将「刑事控告书」列在首次出庭的相应记录旁。

examples.en: We identified the criminal complaint from the heading and sworn allegations in the classroom document.
examples.zh: 我们根据标题以及经宣誓提出的指称，辨认课堂文书中的「刑事控告书」。

collocations: the facts in a criminal complaint

words.enDefinition: An offense based on an agreement to commit a crime, with any additional elements the law requires.

examples.en: The mock record listed agreement as an issue for the criminal conspiracy count in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 习题的模拟卷宗将是否达成合意列为「犯罪共谋」指控项的一个争点。

examples.en: The casebook example treated agreement as the key disputed element of criminal conspiracy under the assigned statute.
examples.zh: 依照指定法规，案例教材的例子将是否存在合意视为「犯罪共谋」的核心争议要件。

words.enDefinition: A legal determination of guilt following a guilty verdict or a plea with equivalent legal effect.

examples.en: The mock record separated the criminal conviction from the sentence imposed at the later hearing.
examples.zh: 模拟卷宗把「刑事定罪」和后来听证中作出的量刑决定分开列出。

examples.en: We checked which charge resulted in a criminal conviction before reading the corresponding classroom judgment.
examples.zh: 阅读相应课堂判决前，我们先核对哪项指控导致了「刑事定罪」。

words.enDefinition: A person or entity formally accused of an offense in a criminal proceeding.

examples.en: The mock court record identified the criminal defendant before listing the counts to be decided at trial.
examples.zh: 模拟法庭卷宗先注明「刑事被告人」，再列出将在审判中裁决的各项指控。

examples.en: We tracked how the name of the fictional criminal defendant appeared in different procedural documents.
examples.zh: 我们查看虚构「刑事被告人」的姓名如何出现在各种程序文书中。

words.enDefinition: A process for disclosing specified information between parties in a criminal case under the applicable rules.

examples.en: The mock American docket listed criminal discovery before the trial stages in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 美国模拟案件登记表在课堂案例的审判阶段之前列出了「刑事证据开示」。

examples.en: We read the classroom's summary of criminal discovery to identify which jurisdiction the example followed.
examples.zh: 我们阅读课堂对「刑事证据开示」的概述，确认例题依据哪个司法辖区。

words.enDefinition: A monetary penalty imposed as part of a sentence in a criminal case.

examples.en: The mock judgment placed a criminal fine among the penalties listed in the fictional case file.
examples.zh: 模拟判决把「刑事罚金」列入虚构案件卷宗所列的刑罚。

examples.en: We found the criminal fine in a different section from the order for compensation in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在另一章节找出了「刑事罚金」，赔偿命令另有章节记载。

collocations: a criminal fine in a judgment

words.enDefinition: A United States federal sentencing classification based on prior criminal history under the applicable guidelines.

examples.en: The federal example showed a criminal history category as one axis of its fictional sentencing table.
examples.zh: 联邦法例题把「前科类别」作为虚构量刑表的一个坐标轴。

examples.en: We identified the criminal history category from the headings in the classroom table of synthetic data.
examples.zh: 我们根据课堂合成数据表上的栏名找到「前科类别」。

words.enDefinition: In United States federal practice, a formal written charge filed by a prosecutor without a grand jury indictment.

examples.en: The fictional federal docket labeled the document a criminal information filed by the prosecutor in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的联邦法院虚构卷宗，将该文书标为检察官提交的「检察机关起诉书」。

examples.en: We compared the criminal information with the separate grand jury charging document described in the classroom materials.
examples.zh: 我们将「检察机关起诉书」与课堂材料所述的大陪审团起诉文书作比较。

collocations: a count in a criminal information

words.enDefinition: An intentional state of mind of the kind required by the applicable definition of an offense.

examples.en: The mock judgment treated criminal intent as a separate issue from whether the charged conduct occurred.
examples.zh: 模拟判决分别考察是否具有「犯罪故意」与被指控的行为是否发生。

examples.en: We reviewed the stated definition of criminal intent before comparing the findings about the two fictional counts.
examples.zh: 比较两个虚构指控项的认定前，我们先阅读了题设对「犯罪故意」的定义。

collocations: infer criminal intent under applicable law

words.enDefinition: A court's formal recorded disposition of a criminal case, including any conviction and sentence.

examples.en: The classroom record included a criminal judgment listing the outcome and sentence for the fictional defendant.
examples.zh: 课堂卷宗包含一份「刑事判决」，列出虚构被告人的裁决结果和所受刑罚。

examples.en: We compared the criminal judgment with the earlier verdict form to see what information each contained.
examples.zh: 我们比较「刑事判决」与此前的裁决表，了解各自包含哪些信息。

collocations: a sentence recorded in a criminal judgment

words.enDefinition: A judge's directions to jurors about the law, the elements to decide, and the applicable proof standard.

examples.en: The judge's criminal jury instructions listed the elements of the fictional charge for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 法官的「刑事陪审团指引」为课堂练习列出了虚构指控的各项要件。

examples.en: We located the proof standard in the model criminal jury instructions before reading the verdict form.
examples.zh: 我们先在示例「刑事陪审团指引」中找到证明标准，再阅读裁决表。

collocations: the standard in criminal jury instructions
a set of criminal jury instructions

words.enDefinition: The body of law defining crimes, criminal responsibility, and the penalties available upon conviction.

examples.en: The criminal law seminar asked how statutes define legal responsibility in a fictional court record.
examples.zh: 「刑法」讨论课考察，法规如何界定虚构法庭卷宗中的法律责任。

examples.en: We read a short criminal law opinion before identifying the issues in the classroom hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们先读一篇简短的「刑法」判决意见，再辨认课堂假设案例的争点。

words.enDefinition: Legal responsibility for an offense when the applicable requirements for holding a person accountable are met.

examples.en: The mock judgment considered criminal liability only after examining the required elements in the fictional charge.
examples.zh: 模拟判决先审查虚构指控的必要要件，再考察「刑事责任」。

examples.en: We compared the two classroom rulings to see why they reached different conclusions about criminal liability.
examples.zh: 我们比较两份课堂裁定，查看为何它们对「刑事责任」得出了不同结论。

words.enDefinition: A serious failure to perceive a substantial and unjustifiable risk, as defined by the applicable criminal law.

examples.en: The New York class compared criminal negligence with a mental state involving actual awareness of risk.
examples.zh: 纽约州法律课将「刑事过失」与实际意识到风险的心理状态作了比较。

examples.en: We examined the required degree of carelessness before discussing criminal negligence in the mock opinion.
examples.zh: 讨论模拟判决中的「刑事过失」之前，我们先查看对疏忽程度的要求。

words.enDefinition: Conduct prohibited by criminal law and subject to punishment after a conviction under applicable rules.

examples.en: The worksheet described a fictional criminal offense using only the language of the assigned statute.
examples.zh: 习题只用指定法规中的措辞，描述一项虚构的「刑事犯罪」。

examples.en: We identified which definition of criminal offense applied in the mock case involving different jurisdictions.
examples.zh: 我们辨认这道涉及不同司法辖区的模拟案例适用哪一项「刑事犯罪」定义。

collocations: the elements of a criminal offense

words.enDefinition: A failure to act that may support criminal liability where the law imposes a duty to act.

examples.en: The fictional decision asked whether a statutory duty supported treating the absence of action as a criminal omission.
examples.zh: 虚构判决考察，是否有法定义务可作为把未采取行动认定为「刑法上的不作为」的依据。

examples.en: We discussed criminal omission only after identifying the duty alleged in the abstract classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们在抽象课堂题中先找出所主张的义务，才讨论「刑法上的不作为」。

collocations: a duty relevant to a criminal omission

words.enDefinition: A legal proceeding in which a public authority pursues a charge under criminal law.

examples.en: The seminar followed a fictional criminal prosecution from the filing of the charge to the recorded outcome.
examples.zh: 讨论课追踪一宗虚构的「刑事追诉」，从提交指控一直看到记载的结果。

examples.en: We discussed which public authority was responsible for the criminal prosecution in the classroom jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 我们讨论，在课堂题设的司法辖区，哪个公共机关负责「刑事追诉」。

collocations: the start of a criminal prosecution

words.enDefinition: A public lawyer who represents the prosecution in criminal proceedings.

examples.en: The speaker labeled criminal prosecutor represented the public authority in the fictional courtroom exchange.
examples.zh: 在虚构庭审对话中，标注为「刑事检察官」的发言人代表公共机关。

examples.en: We compared the questions asked by the criminal prosecutor with those assigned to defense counsel.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「刑事检察官」提出的问题与分配给辩护律师的问题。

collocations: the role of a criminal prosecutor
an argument from a criminal prosecutor
the position of the criminal prosecutor

words.enDefinition: Conscious disregard of a substantial and unjustifiable risk under the governing criminal law standard.

examples.en: The New York worksheet asked whether the record showed conscious disregard of risk for criminal recklessness.
examples.zh: 纽约州习题问，卷宗是否显示当事人有意识地无视风险，从而支持对「刑法上的轻率」的认定。

examples.en: We discussed criminal recklessness in an abstract comparison of two fictional states of mind in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们通过抽象比较两种虚构的心理状态，讨论了「刑法上的轻率」。

words.enDefinition: A criminal court order to compensate a victim for specified loss, where law provides for it.

examples.en: The federal mock judgment listed criminal restitution separately from the fine in its final section.
examples.zh: 模拟联邦判决最后一节将「刑事程序中责令赔偿」与罚金分别列出。

examples.en: We linked criminal restitution to the line describing compensable loss in the fictional sentencing record.
examples.zh: 我们把「刑事程序中责令赔偿」与虚构量刑卷宗中描述可获赔损失的一行对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A separate offense under some laws of intentionally asking or encouraging another to commit a crime.

examples.en: The American worksheet treated criminal solicitation as a separate offense and identified its required mental element.
examples.zh: 美国习题将「教唆罪」作为独立罪名，并指出所要求的心理状态。

examples.en: The American classroom outline listed criminal solicitation separately from offenses based on agreement and attempt.
examples.zh: 美国课堂提纲将「教唆罪」与基于合意和基于未遂的罪名分开列出。

collocations: a fictional issue of criminal solicitation

words.enDefinition: A legal rule limiting when a criminal prosecution may be started, subject to applicable exceptions.

examples.en: The American seminar identified which criminal statute of limitations was referenced in the fictional judgment.
examples.zh: 美国讨论课辨认虚构判决援引的是哪一项「刑事追诉时效规定」。

examples.en: We distinguished a criminal statute of limitations from a deadline for filing a document within proceedings.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「刑事追诉时效规定」与诉讼过程中提交某份文书的截止期。

collocations: apply a criminal statute of limitations
the scope of a criminal statute of limitations
an issue under a criminal statute of limitations

words.enDefinition: A court proceeding that determines whether a criminal charge has been proved.

examples.en: The seminar diagram placed the criminal trial between the pretrial proceedings and the recorded verdict.
examples.zh: 讨论课流程图将「刑事审判」列在审前程序与记载的裁决之间。

examples.en: We identified the decision each participant would make in the fictional criminal trial used for class.
examples.zh: 我们辨认课堂虚构「刑事审判」中，各参与者分别负责作什么决定。

collocations: the stages of a criminal trial

words.enDefinition: A group of jurors that determines the verdict on criminal charges presented at trial.

examples.en: The diagram showed the criminal trial jury receiving instructions before deliberating in the fictional American case.
examples.zh: 示意图显示，在虚构美国案件中，「刑事审判陪审团」在评议前接收法官指引。

examples.en: We compared the criminal trial jury with the earlier charging body in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们把「刑事审判陪审团」与课堂示例中较早阶段的起诉机构作比较。

collocations: a verdict by the criminal trial jury
instructions for a criminal trial jury
the role of a criminal trial jury

words.enDefinition: A document recording a trial jury's decision on one or more criminal charges.

examples.en: The fictional criminal verdict form gave the jury a separate line for each charge in class.
examples.zh: 虚构的「刑事裁决表」为每项指控留出一行，供课堂模拟陪审团记录裁决。

examples.en: We compared each line of the criminal verdict form with the corresponding charge in the mock file.
examples.zh: 我们把「刑事裁决表」的各行与模拟卷宗中的对应指控作比较。

collocations: a count on a criminal verdict form

words.expression: cross-examination on a civil witness statement
words.lemma: cross-examination on a civil witness statement
words.enDefinition: Questioning an opposing witness about their written civil evidence
acceptedEnVariants: cross-examination on a civil witness statement

examples.en: The mock transcript labels cross-examination on a civil witness statement separately from the direct evidence.
examples.zh: 模拟笔录将「民事证言交叉询问」与主询问证言分开标注。

examples.en: We identified the questioned paragraph in the cross-examination on a civil witness statement extract for class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂「民事证言交叉询问」节选中找到了被询问的段落。

collocations: conduct cross-examination on a civil witness statement
extract of cross-examination on a civil witness statement
review cross-examination on a civil witness statement

words.zhGloss: 对另一条文的交叉引用
words.enDefinition: A reference directing the reader to another numbered section for a relevant definition, condition, or rule.
acceptedZhAnswers: 对另一条文的交叉引用

examples.en: The text uses a cross-reference to another section where the scope of the exception is set out.
examples.zh: 正文用「对另一条文的交叉引用」指向说明该例外范围的位置。

examples.en: We followed the cross-reference to another section and read the definition in its original statutory wording.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「对另一条文的交叉引用」找过去，阅读了定义在法令中的原文。

collocations: follow a cross-reference to another section
check a cross-reference to another section
insert a cross-reference to another section

words.enDefinition: Claim asserted against a coparty under US federal civil procedure

examples.en: The federal diagram draws the crossclaim between two defendants on the same side.
examples.zh: 联邦程序示意图在同一方的两名被告之间画出「同方当事人间的请求」。

examples.en: We compared a crossclaim with the claim directed back toward the plaintiff.
examples.zh: 我们把「同方当事人间的请求」和指向原告的请求作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The court in England and Wales that tries serious criminal cases and hears certain magistrates' court appeals.
acceptedZhAnswers: 英格兰与威尔士刑事法院

examples.en: The English classroom diagram showed the fictional serious charge going to the Crown Court for trial.
examples.zh: 英格兰课堂流程图显示，虚构的严重指控移送「皇家刑事法院」审判。

examples.en: We labeled the Crown Court on a separate arrow showing review from the magistrates' court.
examples.zh: 我们在表示对治安法院裁决进行审理的另一条箭头旁标出了「皇家刑事法院」。

collocations: an appeal to the Crown Court

words.enDefinition: The public prosecution authority for cases investigated by police and other bodies in England and Wales.

examples.en: The England and Wales lesson placed the Crown Prosecution Service on the prosecution side of its fictional diagram.
examples.zh: 英格兰与威尔士课程把「皇家检察署」列在虚构流程图的控方一侧。

examples.en: We read the unit's description of the Crown Prosecution Service before looking at the mock court hearing.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读本单元对「皇家检察署」的介绍，再看模拟庭审。

collocations: the role of the Crown Prosecution Service
guidance from the Crown Prosecution Service

words.enDefinition: A legally specified state of mind that can satisfy a mental element of an offense.

examples.en: Our seminar on New York law matched each culpable mental state with its statutory definition.
examples.zh: 我们的纽约州法律讨论课将各项「有责的心理状态」与相应的法定定义对应起来。

examples.en: We used the mock jury direction to identify the culpable mental state relevant to the charge.
examples.zh: 我们根据模拟陪审团指引找出与指控有关的「有责的心理状态」。

words.enDefinition: a term providing that stated remedies may be used alongside other available remedies, subject to applicable limitations

examples.en: The fictional cumulative remedies clause allowed the remedies listed in the contract to coexist with others under law.
examples.zh: 虚构的「救济可并行条款」允许合同列出的救济与其他法定救济并存。

examples.en: We discussed whether the cumulative remedies clause affected the separate rule against receiving compensation twice in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「救济可并行条款」是否影响练习中另外适用的禁止重复获赔规则。

collocations: effect of a cumulative remedies clause

words.enDefinition: A sentence imposing a term of imprisonment or another form of custody under applicable law.

examples.en: The England and Wales classroom chart listed a custodial sentence among the fictional court's sentencing outcomes.
examples.zh: 英格兰与威尔士课堂图表把「监禁刑」列为虚构法院的量刑结果之一。

examples.en: We read the entry for a custodial sentence before comparing the other orders in the example.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「监禁刑」条目，再比较示例中的其他命令。

words.enDefinition: money awarded or payable in response to a contractual breach, under the applicable measure and liability rules

examples.en: The exercise compared two calculations of damages for breach of contract using different assumptions about the promised delivery.
examples.zh: 练习基于关于约定交付的不同假定，对照两种「违约损害赔偿」计算结果。

examples.en: We explained which losses the mock court included in damages for breach of contract under the assigned rule.
examples.zh: 我们解释虚构法院根据适用规则，将请求的哪些损失纳入「违约损害赔偿」。

collocations: claim damages for breach of contract
award damages for breach of contract
assess damages for breach of contract

words.expression: damages in lieu of specific performance
words.lemma: damages in lieu of specific performance
words.enDefinition: a monetary award made instead of specific performance when the court has authority to grant such relief
acceptedEnVariants: damages in lieu of specific performance

examples.en: After reviewing the circumstances, the mock judgment considered an award of damages in lieu of specific performance.
examples.zh: 虚构判决中，法院审查承诺的相关情形之后，考虑了「替代实际履行的赔偿」。

examples.en: We distinguished damages in lieu of specific performance from an actual order directing the seller to perform.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「替代实际履行的赔偿」和实际命令卖方履行的裁定。

collocations: award damages in lieu of specific performance
seek damages in lieu of specific performance
availability of damages in lieu of specific performance

words.enDefinition: A physical state of property alleged to pose an unreasonable risk in the circumstances of a premises claim.

examples.en: The diagram in the mock file marks a dangerous condition of property in the covered courtyard.
examples.zh: 模拟案卷中的示意图标出了一处位于有顶庭院里的「物业危险状况」。

examples.en: The seminar notes discuss how witnesses described the dangerous condition of property before the exhibition opened.
examples.zh: 研讨课笔记讨论了目击者怎样描述展览开幕前的「物业危险状况」。

collocations: report a dangerous condition of property

words.zhGloss: 被撤销指定资格的院校
words.enDefinition: a Canadian institution whose official designation to host international students under the program has ended
acceptedZhAnswers: 被撤销指定资格的院校

examples.en: The case study discusses a de-designated learning institution and distinguishes current students from proposed new enrollees.
examples.zh: 案例研习讨论一所「被撤销指定资格的院校」，并区分目前在读与打算新入学的学生。

examples.en: We placed the decision affecting the de-designated learning institution on the fictional sequence of events in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把涉及「被撤销指定资格的院校」的决定标在虚构事件序列中。

collocations: status of a de-designated learning institution
enrollment at a de-designated learning institution

words.enDefinition: A rule treating legislation as having come into force at a stated time for legal purposes.

examples.en: The exercise compares the publication date with the date of deemed commencement in the fictional legislation.
examples.zh: 练习比较了虚构立法的公布日期与「视为生效」日期。

examples.en: Our notes explain how deemed commencement affects the date used in the imaginary timeline under discussion.
examples.zh: 笔记说明「视为生效」如何影响正在讨论的虚构时间线所采用的日期。

words.enDefinition: A civil wrong involving communication of defamatory material about someone, subject to the elements and defences of the applicable law.

examples.en: Our defamation seminar begins with a fictional newsletter and two competing readings of a sentence in it.
examples.zh: 「诽谤」研讨课从一份虚构简讯和对其中一个句子的两种不同解读讲起。

examples.en: The casebook introduces defamation by explaining the importance of what readers would understand from the publication.
examples.zh: 案例教材从解释读者如何理解发布内容的重要性入手，介绍「诽谤」。

words.enDefinition: Defamation alleged to arise from what a communication implies when read in context rather than from its direct wording.

examples.en: The classroom article contains no direct accusation, so the group discusses possible defamation by implication in context.
examples.zh: 课堂所用文章没有直接指控，所以小组结合语境讨论有无可能存在「暗示性诽谤」。

examples.en: The American torts exercise asks which parts of the fictional article matter to the defamation by implication allegation.
examples.zh: 美国侵权法练习询问，这篇虚构文章的哪些部分与「暗示性诽谤」指控有关。

words.enDefinition: A meaning conveyed by a communication that is capable of harming the reputation of a person identified in it.

examples.en: The fictional headline was read with the article to determine whether it carried a defamatory meaning.
examples.zh: 为判断虚构新闻标题是否带有「有损名誉的含义」，学生结合正文阅读了标题。

examples.en: The exercise asks which interpretation could amount to a defamatory meaning in the context of the paragraph.
examples.zh: 练习讨论结合这段文字来看，哪种解读可能构成「有损名誉的含义」。

words.enDefinition: A statement that carries a meaning capable of harming another's reputation under the applicable defamation standard.

examples.en: The teacher asked everyone to underline the alleged defamatory statement in the fictional student magazine excerpt.
examples.zh: 老师请大家在虚构学生杂志摘录中，给被指构成「有损名誉的陈述」的文字画下划线。

examples.en: Our case note identifies the defamatory statement before discussing how two fictional readers understood the wording.
examples.zh: 案例笔记先指出哪一句是「有损名誉的陈述」，再讨论两名虚构读者如何理解这段措辞。

words.enDefinition: Procedural failure to respond or defend as required in a civil proceeding

examples.en: The federal timeline records default in a civil action when the fictional response never arrives.
examples.zh: 联邦程序时间线在虚构答复始终未收到时记录了「民事诉讼缺席状态」。

examples.en: We kept default in a civil action distinct from the later judgment on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表中区分了「民事诉讼缺席状态」与之后的裁判。

collocations: entry of default in a civil action
record default in a civil action
discuss default in a civil action

words.enDefinition: Judgment available after failure to respond or defend when applicable conditions are met

examples.en: The fictional docket lists a default judgment after the unanswered claim entry.
examples.zh: 虚构案卷在无人答复的请求条目后列出一项「缺席判决」。

examples.en: We studied the default judgment separately from the entry recording the default.
examples.zh: 我们把「缺席判决」与记载缺席状态的记录分开学习。
