words.enDefinition: performance that falls short of a contractual requirement for the promised work, goods or service

examples.en: The exercise treated the wrongly sized shelves as defective performance under the fictional workshop agreement.
examples.zh: 练习将尺寸有误的架子视为虚构工坊协议下的「瑕疵履行」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the contract allowed correction of defective performance before the buyer sought another remedy.
examples.zh: 我们讨论合同是否允许在买方寻求其他救济前纠正「瑕疵履行」。

words.enDefinition: Response stating the defendant's position under England and Wales civil procedure

examples.en: The seminar reads a defence in a civil claim alongside the fictional particulars of claim.
examples.zh: 研讨课将一份「民事案件答辩状」与虚构的诉讼请求详述并排阅读。

examples.en: We located a response to each statement in the defence in a civil claim extract.
examples.zh: 我们在「民事案件答辩状」节选里找到了对各项陈述的回应。

collocations: read a defence in a civil claim
allegations addressed by a defence in a civil claim
specimen defence in a civil claim

words.enDefinition: A statutory defamation defence in England and Wales for statements of opinion meeting the Act's specified conditions.

examples.en: The English law seminar outlines the defence of honest opinion using a fictional review of a college exhibition.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课用一篇关于大学展览的虚构评论概述「诚实意见抗辩」。

examples.en: Our answer on the defence of honest opinion identifies where the fictional reviewer gave reasons for the assessment.
examples.zh: 我们关于「诚实意见抗辩」的答案指出，虚构评论者在哪些地方交代了得出评价的理由。

collocations: raise the defence of honest opinion
rely on the defence of honest opinion
requirements of the defence of honest opinion

words.expression: defense case in a criminal trial
words.lemma: defense case in a criminal trial
words.zhGloss: 刑事审判中的辩方举证
words.enDefinition: The portion of a criminal trial in which the defense may present evidence and arguments.
acceptedZhAnswers: 刑事审判中的辩方举证
acceptedEnVariants: defense case in a criminal trial
defence case in a criminal trial

examples.en: The flowchart labeled the defense case in a criminal trial as a distinct stage in the mock transcript.
examples.zh: 流程图将「刑事审判中的辩方举证」标为模拟庭审记录中的独立阶段。

examples.en: We read the classroom caption explaining the defense case in a criminal trial before continuing to deliberations.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读课堂图注对「刑事审判中的辩方举证」的解释，再看评议阶段。

collocations: the order of the defense case in a criminal trial
identify the defense case in a criminal trial
a classroom outline of the defense case in a criminal trial

words.expression: defense counsel in a criminal case
words.lemma: defense counsel in a criminal case
words.enDefinition: The lawyer representing or advising the defendant in a criminal proceeding.
acceptedEnVariants: defense counsel in a criminal case
defence counsel in a criminal case

examples.en: The worksheet asked when defense counsel in a criminal case appeared in the fictional docket entries.
examples.zh: 习题问，在虚构的案件登记记录中，「刑事案件辩护律师」何时出庭。

examples.en: We marked the questions assigned to defense counsel in a criminal case during the mock hearing.
examples.zh: 模拟庭审中，我们标出了分配给「刑事案件辩护律师」的问题。

collocations: appoint defense counsel in a criminal case
the role of defense counsel in a criminal case
arguments by defense counsel in a criminal case

words.enDefinition: postponement of the start of a student's course or enrolment under the chosen provider process

examples.en: The sample record shows deferment of commencement before the hypothetical course was due to open in class.
examples.zh: 课堂样例记录显示，假设课程在原定开课前发生「推迟开始就读」。

examples.en: We distinguished deferment of commencement from suspension after enrolment began on the fictional chronology in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习的虚构时间顺序中，我们区分「推迟开始就读」与注册开始后的暂停。

words.enDefinition: A word or expression assigned a specific meaning by the contract text.

examples.en: We found the defined term in the opening section before reading its use in the schedule.
examples.zh: 我们先在开头部分找到这个「经定义的术语」，再读它在附表中的用法。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the same defined term referred to all posters in the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，在虚构协议中，同一个「经定义的术语」是否指全部海报。

collocations: a defined term used in a clause

words.zhGloss: 制定法中的已定义术语
words.enDefinition: A word or phrase given a specified meaning by a statute for use within its stated scope.
acceptedZhAnswers: 制定法中的已定义术语

examples.en: In the fictional extract, a defined term in a statute has a narrower meaning than everyday usage.
examples.zh: 在虚构摘录中，一个「制定法中的已定义术语」含义比日常用法更窄。

examples.en: The exercise traces a defined term in a statute back to the section giving its special meaning.
examples.zh: 练习把一个「制定法中的已定义术语」追溯到给出其特定含义的条文。

collocations: locate a defined term in a statute
scope of a defined term in a statute
use of a defined term in a statute

words.enDefinition: An offer sufficiently clear for acceptance to establish an agreement under the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock judge looked for a definite offer before deciding whether the exchange could create a contract.
examples.zh: 模拟裁判者先查找是否有一项「确定的要约」，再判断该交流能否形成合同。

examples.en: In our classroom exercise, a definite offer identified the printed items and the proposed exchange in clear terms.
examples.zh: 在课堂练习中，一项「确定的要约」清楚写明了印刷物品和拟议的交换内容。

collocations: the terms of a definite offer

words.enDefinition: A contract provision explaining the meanings assigned to selected words or expressions in the agreement.

examples.en: The definitions clause explained what the fictional agreement meant by its shortened name for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 「定义条款」说明虚构协议中展览简称所指的内容。

examples.en: We checked the definitions clause before using any of the capitalized terms in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 使用课堂题里的任何大写术语之前，我们先查看了「定义条款」。

collocations: a meaning given in a definitions clause

words.enDefinition: A power conferred by one authority on another to perform a specified function, such as making rules.

examples.en: The UK seminar asks how the delegated power is described in the relevant section of the fictional Act.
examples.zh: 英国法律研讨课询问，虚构法案的相关条文怎样描述「授予下级主体的权力」。

examples.en: Our notes identify which organisation exercises the delegated power and which legislature establishes its limits.
examples.zh: 笔记指出哪个机构行使「授予下级主体的权力」，以及哪个立法机关规定其限度。

words.zhGloss: 委托他人履行合同义务
words.enDefinition: arrangement for another person to perform a contractual duty, with the original party's liability depending on the governing rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 委托他人履行合同义务

examples.en: The exercise distinguished delegation of contractual duties from an agreement releasing the original contractor altogether.
examples.zh: 练习区分了「委托他人履行合同义务」与完全解除原承包方责任的协议。

examples.en: We identified delegation of contractual duties when a substitute was asked to carry out the promised work.
examples.zh: 另一人受托完成已承诺的工作时，我们辨认出「委托他人履行合同义务」。

collocations: effect of delegation of contractual duties

words.enDefinition: In English law, an act signifying intention to be bound by a deed, sometimes subject to a condition.

examples.en: The English seminar discussed delivery of a deed after separating the signature from the intended time of commitment.
examples.zh: 讨论课区分签署与当事人有意受约束的时间之后，讨论了英格兰法中的「契据交付」。

examples.en: We noted that delivery of a deed concerned legal intention in the fictional case discussed in class.
examples.zh: 我们指出，课堂虚构案例中的「契据交付」涉及当事人的法律意图。

collocations: the timing of delivery of a deed
an issue of delivery of a deed

words.zhGloss: 要求提供充分的履行保证
words.enDefinition: under rules such as New York UCC section 2-609, a written request for assurance of due future performance when reasonable grounds for insecurity exist
acceptedZhAnswers: 要求提供充分的履行保证

examples.en: The New York case problem asked whether the written demand for adequate assurance was justified by the circumstances.
examples.zh: 纽约州案例题问，当时的情形能否支持这份书面「要求提供充分的履行保证」。

examples.en: We distinguished a demand for adequate assurance from a declaration that the fictional sale had already ended.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「要求提供充分的履行保证」与宣告虚构买卖已经结束。

collocations: make a demand for adequate assurance
grounds for a demand for adequate assurance

words.enDefinition: Formal dispute of an allegation recorded in a pleading

examples.en: The worksheet marks a denial in a pleading where the parties disagree about delivery.
examples.zh: 习题在双方对交付有争议的位置标出了「诉辩文书中的否认」。

examples.en: We matched each denial in a pleading to the corresponding allegation in the sample complaint.
examples.zh: 我们将各项「诉辩文书中的否认」与样本起诉状中对应的主张配对。

collocations: make a denial in a pleading
identify a denial in a pleading
scope of a denial in a pleading

words.enDefinition: A difference between the actual product and the design it was supposed to follow, often relevant to a manufacturing-defect claim.

examples.en: The workshop photographs show a departure from intended design in only one of the three fictional samples.
examples.zh: 工作坊的照片显示三个虚构样品中只有一个「偏离预定设计」。

examples.en: Students marked every departure from intended design on the comparison sheet before writing their own explanations.
examples.zh: 学生先在对照表上标出每一处「偏离预定设计」的地方，然后各自写下解释。

collocations: evidence of departure from intended design
identify a departure from intended design

words.enDefinition: Difference between the conduct in question and a recognized professional practice

examples.en: The fictional report describes a departure from professional practice when comparing the two valuation methods.
examples.zh: 虚构报告在比较两种估价方法时描述了一处「偏离专业做法」。

examples.en: We assessed the departure from professional practice separately from the amount of the claimed loss.
examples.zh: 我们将「偏离专业做法」与主张的损失数额分开评估。

collocations: identify a departure from professional practice
explain a departure from professional practice

words.zhGloss: 英国学生的受扶养子女
words.enDefinition: a qualifying child in a UK immigration category linked to a parent with or applying for Student permission
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生的受扶养子女

examples.en: The fictional family tree marks a dependent child of a Student beneath the parent in the application example.
examples.zh: 申请示例的虚构家庭关系图，在家长下方标出一名「英国学生的受扶养子女」。

examples.en: We matched the dependent child of a Student entry to the child-specific heading in the assigned guidance.
examples.zh: 我们将「英国学生的受扶养子女」条目与指定指南中专门针对子女的标题对应起来。

collocations: application as a dependent child of a Student
permission for a dependent child of a Student
requirements for a dependent child of a Student

words.zhGloss: 英国学生的受扶养伴侣
words.enDefinition: a qualifying partner in a UK immigration category linked to the principal applicant or holder of Student permission
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生的受扶养伴侣

examples.en: The classroom guidance example identifies a dependent partner of a Student in one of the fictional family scenarios.
examples.zh: 课堂指南示例在其中一个虚构家庭情形中辨认出一名「英国学生的受扶养伴侣」。

examples.en: We compared the dependent partner of a Student entry with the separate child entry in the policy worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把政策练习中「英国学生的受扶养伴侣」条目与另列的子女条目作比较。

collocations: application as a dependent partner of a Student
permission for a dependent partner of a Student
qualifying dependent partner of a Student

words.enDefinition: Written record of questions and answers from a deposition

examples.en: The worksheet quotes one exchange from a fictional deposition transcript for discussion.
examples.zh: 习题引用了虚构「庭外询问笔录」中的一段问答供讨论。

examples.en: We located the answer on the next page of the deposition transcript.
examples.zh: 我们在「庭外询问笔录」的下一页找到了回答。

words.enDefinition: A legally defective feature of the product's intended design, assessed using the rules of the applicable jurisdiction.

examples.en: The students discussed whether the same feature across the whole model range might indicate a design defect.
examples.zh: 学生们讨论了整个型号系列共有的同一特征是否可能表明存在「设计缺陷」。

examples.en: The hypothetical complaint alleges a design defect in the clasp shown on the approved assembly drawing.
examples.zh: 假设的起诉材料主张，批准的装配图所示的搭扣存在「设计缺陷」。

words.enDefinition: the reduction in value caused by a defect or breach, used as a loss measure in the stated context

examples.en: The exercise calculated diminution in value by comparing the promised item with the one actually received.
examples.zh: 练习将约定交付的物品与实际收到的物品比较，计算「价值减损」。

examples.en: We compared diminution in value with repair costs when reading the hypothetical decision in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读假设判决时，将「价值减损」与修理费用相对照。

collocations: damages based on diminution in value

words.enDefinition: Liability arising from the corporation's own legal wrong or failure to meet its duty.

examples.en: The seminar compares direct corporate liability for the company's own decision with liability for an employee's conduct.
examples.zh: 研讨课比较了公司因自身决定承担的「公司自身的直接责任」与因雇员行为承担的责任。

examples.en: Our hypothetical on direct corporate liability turns on what the fictional board itself decided at its meeting.
examples.zh: 关于「公司自身的直接责任」的假设案例，取决于虚构董事会自己在会议上作了什么决定。

words.enDefinition: Ordinary appellate review of a criminal judgment as part of the original case under applicable law.

examples.en: The federal classroom chart placed the direct criminal appeal immediately after the judgment in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 联邦法课堂流程图把「刑事直接上诉」放在虚构案件宣判之后。

examples.en: The mock appellate court identified which parts of the criminal judgment the direct criminal appeal challenged.
examples.zh: 模拟上诉法院指出，「刑事直接上诉」针对刑事判决的哪些部分。

collocations: a ruling in a direct criminal appeal

words.enDefinition: compensation for loss arising naturally from the breach, as distinguished from further loss under the governing law

examples.en: The example treated the goods' reduced value as direct damages for breach under the assigned rule.
examples.zh: 按题设规则，示例将退回货物价值的减少计入「违约直接损失赔偿」。

examples.en: We separated direct damages for breach from claimed losses arising through the buyer's downstream business arrangements in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分「违约直接损失赔偿」与买方因下游业务安排产生并主张的损失。

words.enDefinition: Meet the standard of careful conduct required under the relevant duty

examples.en: The seminar asks whether the fictional staff discharge a duty of care by taking reasonable precautions.
examples.zh: 研讨课问，虚构工作人员采取合理防范措施是否已经「履行注意义务」。

examples.en: We compared two suggested ways to discharge a duty of care in the fictional problem.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构题设中比较了两种拟议的「履行注意义务」方式。

collocations: discharge a duty of care by acting reasonably
determine whether parties discharge a duty of care
steps to discharge a duty of care

words.enDefinition: under English law, automatic discharge of future duties when an event outside the parties' fault and risk allocation makes performance radically different

examples.en: The English law problem tested discharge by frustration after the sole agreed venue became permanently unavailable.
examples.zh: 合同唯一指定的场地永久无法使用后，英格兰法例题考查「合同受挫自动解除」。

examples.en: We contrasted discharge by frustration with relief expressly provided by the fictional agreement's event clause.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同受挫自动解除」与虚构协议事件条款明确提供的救济作比较。

collocations: contract subject to discharge by frustration

words.enDefinition: the ending of contractual duties once the performance that satisfies them is completed

examples.en: The last item on the classroom timeline marked discharge by performance after all remaining obligations had been satisfied.
examples.zh: 课堂时间线最后一项标为「义务因履行而消灭」，此时所有剩余义务均已履行。

examples.en: We compared discharge by performance with cancellation before the work was finished in a separate hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们将「义务因履行而消灭」与另一个假设中工作完成前取消合同的情况比较。

collocations: discharge by performance of contractual duties

words.enDefinition: Part 31 certification of disclosure compliance with details of the search

examples.en: The specimen disclosure statement explains the scope of the search in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 样本「披露说明」说明了虚构案件中查找文书的范围。

examples.en: We found the disclosure statement attached to the sample document list in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上找到了随样本文书清单附带的「披露说明」。

words.enDefinition: Ending a criminal charge without a verdict on it, with further effects depending on the applicable rules.

examples.en: The mock court recorded dismissal of a criminal charge before any jury determination on that count.
examples.zh: 模拟法庭在陪审团尚未就该项指控作出裁决时记载了「驳回刑事指控」。

examples.en: We discussed dismissal of a criminal charge as a distinct procedural outcome in our classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 在课堂比较中，我们把「驳回刑事指控」作为一种独立的程序结果讨论。

collocations: order dismissal of a criminal charge
record dismissal of a criminal charge
an order for dismissal of a criminal charge

words.enDefinition: The court's formal ruling about what happens to the case, such as affirming or setting aside an earlier decision.

examples.en: The closing paragraph states the disposition of the case after giving the fictional court's reasons for its conclusion.
examples.zh: 最后一段在给出虚构法院得出结论的理由后，写明「案件的处理结果」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks students to record the disposition of the case separately from the legal test applied.
examples.zh: 练习单要求学生分别记录「案件的处理结果」和法院适用的法律判断标准。

collocations: state the disposition of the case
read the disposition of the case
explain the disposition of the case

words.enDefinition: Taking away a person's possession of property, as distinct from other interference with its use or condition.

examples.en: In the loaned instrument example, the class identifies the moment of dispossession from the agreed fictional timeline.
examples.zh: 在乐器借用示例中，全班根据双方认可的虚构时间线找出「剥夺占有」发生的时点。

examples.en: Our notes on dispossession compare denial of possession with temporary impairment of the item's use.
examples.zh: 关于「剥夺占有」的课堂笔记比较了虚构案情中的剥夺占有与暂时妨碍使用物品。

words.enDefinition: A judge's separate opinion disagreeing with the decision or a relevant part of it.

examples.en: The handout lists the dissenting opinion after the majority's reasoning in the fictional constitutional dispute.
examples.zh: 讲义先列出多数法官的论证，再列出虚构宪法争议中的「异议意见」。

examples.en: Our discussion identifies why the dissenting opinion would interpret the two provisions differently in the sample case.
examples.zh: 讨论指出，为什么样本案例中的「异议意见」会对这两项条文作不同解释。

words.enDefinition: To explain why an earlier case does not govern a later one because a material fact or legal issue differs.

examples.en: The fictional court chose to distinguish a precedent because its statutory provision used materially different wording.
examples.zh: 虚构法院选择「区分先例」，因为该先例涉及的制定法条文在措辞上有实质差异。

examples.en: Our tutor asks students to distinguish a precedent by focusing on the legal issue actually decided.
examples.zh: 老师要求学生着眼于法院实际裁断的法律问题来「区分先例」。

collocations: distinguish a precedent on its facts

words.enDefinition: Federal jurisdiction based on qualifying differences in citizenship and amount in controversy

examples.en: The federal chart lists both citizenship and the amount under diversity jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 联邦程序图表在「州籍相异管辖权」项下列出当事人州籍和争议金额。

examples.en: The worksheet contrasts diversity jurisdiction with jurisdiction over claims arising under federal law.
examples.zh: 习题把「州籍相异管辖权」与依据联邦法提出的请求所涉及的管辖权相对照。

words.enDefinition: a contract whose corresponding parts of performance can be treated as separate exchanges under the governing rules

examples.en: The problem describes a divisible contract in which payment for each finished unit corresponded to its delivery.
examples.zh: 例题描述一项「可分合同」，每个完工单元的款项对应于该单元的交付。

examples.en: We discussed whether a divisible contract analysis allowed recovery for the portions already performed in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论，按「可分合同」分析是否允许就练习中已经履行的部分取得款项。

words.enDefinition: Harm whose distinct components can reasonably be attributed to separate causes

examples.en: The fictional problem uses divisible harm because the two losses can be treated separately.
examples.zh: 虚构题设使用「可分损害」概念，因为两项损失可以分开处理。

examples.en: We marked separate figures on the worksheet to represent divisible harm in class.
examples.zh: 我们在习题中标出不同数值，用于课堂表示「可分损害」。

words.enDefinition: a report submitted by a Canadian designated learning institution with requested student enrollment or academic status information

examples.en: The sample DLI compliance report lists enrollment status fields beside the institution's name in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中的「指定学校的合规报告」样张在院校名称旁列出注册状态栏。

examples.en: We checked which term the DLI compliance report covered when reading the fictional administrative record in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上阅读虚构行政记录时，我们核对了「指定学校的合规报告」覆盖哪个学期。

collocations: entries in a DLI compliance report
period covered by a DLI compliance report

words.expression: document checklist for a study permit
words.lemma: document checklist for a study permit
words.enDefinition: a list of supporting documents identified for a study permit application in the applicable Canadian process
acceptedEnVariants: document checklist for a study permit

examples.en: The instructor used a specimen document checklist for a study permit to show how evidence categories are organized.
examples.zh: 老师用「学习许可文件清单」样张展示如何按类别编排证据。

examples.en: We compared the document checklist for a study permit with the attachments in the fictional application file.
examples.zh: 我们把「学习许可文件清单」与虚构申请档案的附件比较。

collocations: consult a document checklist for a study permit
items on a document checklist for a study permit
compare a document checklist for a study permit with attachments

words.enDefinition: An arrangement made in a family or household setting, often analyzed for contractual intention in English law.

examples.en: The English seminar used a fictional domestic agreement about sharing books to discuss the parties' legal intention.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律讨论课用一则家庭成员分享图书的虚构「家庭性协议」讨论当事人的法律约束意图。

examples.en: We compared the setting of a domestic agreement with the written arrangement between two student organizations.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「家庭性协议」的订立场合与两个学生组织的书面安排。

words.enDefinition: A United States constitutional protection against repeated prosecution or punishment for the same offense, subject to legal limits.

examples.en: The American seminar considered double jeopardy after comparing two proceedings listed in a fictional docket.
examples.zh: 美国讨论课先比较虚构案件登记表列出的两项程序，再讨论「一事不再理保障」。

examples.en: We marked double jeopardy beside the two proceedings whose relationship was disputed in the classroom opinion.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂判决中两项关系有争议的程序旁标出「一事不再理保障」。

collocations: consider double jeopardy in a classroom case

words.enDefinition: Obtaining compensation twice for the same underlying loss

examples.en: The fictional table flags double recovery because two entries represent one expense.
examples.zh: 虚构表格指出，两条记录实际代表同一笔开支，可能构成「重复受偿」。

examples.en: We checked for double recovery after comparing the two proposed awards.
examples.zh: 我们比较两项拟议赔偿后检查是否存在「重复受偿」。

words.zhGloss: 兼具工作与私人目的的行程
words.enDefinition: A trip serving both an employment-related purpose and a personal one, considered in deciding whether the travel was within employment.
acceptedZhAnswers: 兼具工作与私人目的的行程

examples.en: The dual-purpose trip in our fictional case involved a business collection and a personal visit downtown.
examples.zh: 虚构案例中的「兼具工作与私人目的的行程」包括因公取件和去市中心的私人拜访。

examples.en: The model answer asks whether the employer would have requested the work errand on this dual-purpose trip anyway.
examples.zh: 参考答案追问，即使没有私人安排，雇主原本是否仍会交办这趟「兼具工作与私人目的的行程」中的公务。

collocations: classify travel as a dual-purpose trip
vicarious liability involving a dual-purpose trip

words.enDefinition: Improper pressure that leaves a party without a reasonable alternative to apparent agreement under applicable rules.

examples.en: The seminar discussed duress in contract law when reading the fictional court's account of pressure during negotiations.
examples.zh: 讨论课阅读虚构法院对协商压力的叙述时，讨论了「合同法上的胁迫」。

examples.en: We distinguished ordinary bargaining pressure from duress in contract law in the hypothetical opinion our tutor supplied.
examples.zh: 辅导老师给出的假设判决意见中，我们区分了普通议价压力与「合同法上的胁迫」。

collocations: an allegation of duress in contract law
the concept of duress in contract law
a classroom example of duress in contract law

words.enDefinition: Link between the loss claimed and the risk the duty protects against

examples.en: The English law seminar checks the duty nexus after identifying the relevant risk.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课先确定相关风险，再核查「义务与损失的关联」。

examples.en: We marked the duty nexus wherever a loss matched the duty's protective purpose.
examples.zh: 当一项损失与义务的保护目的一致时，我们就标出「义务与损失的关联」。

words.expression: duty of an expert to the court
words.lemma: duty of an expert to the court
words.enDefinition: Overriding obligation to assist the court under England and Wales civil rules
acceptedEnVariants: duty of an expert to the court

examples.en: The England and Wales class underlines the duty of an expert to the court in the rule extract.
examples.zh: 英格兰及威尔士程序课堂在规则节选中给「专家对法院的职责」画了下划线。

examples.en: We separated the duty of an expert to the court from the fictional arrangements for payment.
examples.zh: 我们把「专家对法院的职责」与虚构的付款安排分开讨论。

collocations: explain the duty of an expert to the court
scope of the duty of an expert to the court
recognize the duty of an expert to the court

words.enDefinition: Legal obligation to take reasonable care toward another under relevant circumstances

examples.en: The tutor asks whether a duty of care exists before assessing the fictional conduct.
examples.zh: 老师先考虑是否有「注意义务」，再比较虚构案例中的行为。

examples.en: Our diagram places the duty of care question before breach and causation in the analysis.
examples.zh: 我们的分析图将「注意义务」问题放在义务违反和因果关系之前。

collocations: existence of a duty of care
scope of a duty of care

words.enDefinition: an express or implied obligation to provide cooperation needed for the other party's performance in the stated context

examples.en: The classroom contract imposed a duty to cooperate by requiring timely access to the workshop space.
examples.zh: 课堂所用合同要求及时开放工坊空间，由此规定「协作义务」。

examples.en: We read the fictional finding that the duty to cooperate included supplying the drawings needed to begin work.
examples.zh: 我们读到虚构裁判认定，「协作义务」包括提供开始工作所需的图纸。

words.zhGloss: 对非来访者的注意义务
words.enDefinition: A duty potentially owed under the law of England and Wales to entrants who lack visitor status, subject to statutory conditions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 对非来访者的注意义务

examples.en: The worksheet on the duty to non-visitors summarises the statutory conditions used in England and Wales.
examples.zh: 讲解「对非来访者的注意义务」的练习单概述了英格兰及威尔士适用的法定条件。

examples.en: The tutor gave the class a separate passage headed duty to non-visitors for the comparison exercise.
examples.zh: 为进行对比练习，老师另发了一段标题为「对非来访者的注意义务」的材料。

collocations: scope of the duty to non-visitors

words.enDefinition: a legally binding obligation to carry out a promise when any applicable conditions have been met

examples.en: The hypothetical buyer's duty to perform arose only after the seller made a conforming delivery under the agreement.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中，卖方按协议完成合格交付后，买方才承担「履行责任」。

examples.en: We identified whose duty to perform was at issue before reading the fictional court's discussion of breach.
examples.zh: 我们先判断争议涉及谁的「履行责任」，再阅读虚构法院对违约的讨论。

words.enDefinition: Early assessment of a dispute by a neutral evaluator without binding effect

examples.en: A District Court guide from Northern California lists early neutral evaluation among its programs.
examples.zh: 加州北区联邦地区法院的指南将「早期中立评估」列为一项法院项目。

examples.en: The seminar used early neutral evaluation to illustrate how parties can receive an impartial assessment.
examples.zh: 研讨课用「早期中立评估」说明当事人如何获得公正的案件评估。

collocations: refer a dispute to early neutral evaluation

words.enDefinition: US doctrine limiting negligence recovery for certain purely financial losses

examples.en: The California seminar compares the economic loss rule across two fictional commercial relationships.
examples.zh: 加州法律研讨课比较「经济损失规则」在两种虚构商业关系中的适用。

examples.en: We placed the economic loss rule under restrictions on recovery in the comparative law chart.
examples.zh: 我们在比较法图中将「经济损失规则」归到限制损害赔偿的部分。

collocations: scope of the economic loss rule
exception to the economic loss rule

words.enDefinition: an intermediary representing or assisting students or providers with education recruitment and enrolment matters

examples.en: The fictional provider's document names an education agent who communicates with prospective students about course offerings.
examples.zh: 虚构教育机构的文件列出一位「教育代理」，负责与意向学生沟通所开设的课程。

examples.en: We distinguished the education agent from the government decision-maker in the classroom diagram of student applications.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂学生申请示意图中，区分了「教育代理」与作出决定的政府人员。

words.enDefinition: a UK student sponsorship condition requiring appropriate oversight or inspection of the provider under its applicable category

examples.en: The policy example connects the educational oversight requirement with the institution's licence rather than the student's results.
examples.zh: 政策示例将「教育监管要求」与院校的资质许可相联系，学生成绩属于另一项。

examples.en: We reviewed the educational oversight requirement in the part of the guidance addressed to education providers.
examples.zh: 我们在指南中面向教育机构的部分阅读了「教育监管要求」。

collocations: scope of the educational oversight requirement

words.enDefinition: In England and Wales, an offense triable in a magistrates' court or in the Crown Court.

examples.en: The classroom flowchart showed two possible trial courts for an either-way offence named in the fictional statute.
examples.zh: 课堂流程图为虚构法规所指的「可择审理方式的罪行」列出了两种可能的审判法院。

examples.en: We identified the either-way offence in the England and Wales example before reading the allocation decision.
examples.zh: 我们先在英格兰与威尔士示例中识别「可择审理方式的罪行」，再阅读审理法院分配决定。

collocations: a charge for an either-way offence

words.enDefinition: A canon under which general words following specific examples may be limited to the same class.

examples.en: The class used ejusdem generis to ask whether general words covered things unlike the earlier listed items.
examples.zh: 我们用「同类解释规则」考察概括性措辞是否涵盖与前列项目不同类的事物。

examples.en: We identified the common class in the fictional materials list before considering ejusdem generis in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们先在虚构材料清单中找出共同类别，再考虑「同类解释规则」。

collocations: a classroom example of ejusdem generis

words.enDefinition: selection among available remedies, especially where the applicable legal rules prevent pursuing inconsistent remedies through final relief

examples.en: The hypothetical appeal concerned election of remedies after the claimant requested two outcomes treated as inconsistent.
examples.zh: 假设上诉涉及「救济方式的选择」，因为原告请求了适用规则视为互不相容的两项结果。

examples.en: We distinguished election of remedies from the alternative claims listed earlier in the mock pleading.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「救济方式的选择」与虚构诉状先前列出的备选请求。

collocations: timing of an election of remedies

words.enDefinition: A regularly updated online editorial compilation of US federal regulations, distinct from the official legal edition of the CFR.

examples.en: The librarian shows how the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations labels the date of the displayed version.
examples.zh: 图书馆员演示「《美国联邦法规汇编》电子版」怎样标明所显示版本的日期。

examples.en: Our notes list the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations beside the annually updated printed version for comparison.
examples.zh: 笔记把「《美国联邦法规汇编》电子版」和每年更新的印刷版本并列，供我们比较。

collocations: search the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations
consult the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations
version in the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations

words.enDefinition: electronic travel clearance for certain visa-exempt foreign nationals flying to or transiting through Canada, linked to a passport

examples.en: The lesson lists an electronic travel authorization separately from permission to study in the Canadian entry example.
examples.zh: 加拿大入境示例的课程将「加拿大电子旅行授权」与学习许可分别列出。

examples.en: We matched the fictional electronic travel authorization to the passport number shown on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把虚构的「加拿大电子旅行授权」与课堂图所示护照号码对应起来。

collocations: passport linked to an electronic travel authorization

words.enDefinition: A fact or legal requirement that must be established for the charged offense.

examples.en: The tutor underlined each element of a criminal offense before discussing the fictional case record.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在各项「刑事犯罪的构成要件」下划线，再讨论虚构案件卷宗。

examples.en: We matched an element of a criminal offense to each numbered issue in the classroom assignment.
examples.zh: 我们将各项「刑事犯罪的构成要件」与课堂作业中的编号争点一一对应。

collocations: identify an element of a criminal offense
prove an element of a criminal offense
the required element of a criminal offense

words.enDefinition: Required components commonly including duty, breach, causation, and legally recognized damage

examples.en: The chart lists the elements of negligence beside separate facts from the fictional problem.
examples.zh: 图表将「过失侵权构成要件」和虚构题设中的各项事实对应列出。

examples.en: We used the elements of negligence to organize our answer about the damaged prop.
examples.zh: 我们用「过失侵权构成要件」组织关于道具损坏的答题思路。

words.enDefinition: a subject field recognized under the rules applying to a particular study or post-study immigration option

examples.en: The fictional Canadian example lists an eligible field of study by its classification code rather than by title.
examples.zh: 加拿大的虚构示例用分类代码列出「符合规定的专业领域」，名称则另列。

examples.en: We compared the example program code with the eligible field of study entry cited in the handout.
examples.zh: 我们将示例项目代码与讲义引述的「符合规定的专业领域」条目对照。

collocations: identify an eligible field of study
program in an eligible field of study
classification of an eligible field of study

words.enDefinition: in UK student sponsorship guidance, a separate provider that offers linked courses as part of a higher education partnership

examples.en: The diagram shows an embedded college delivering the first linked program before the fictional university course starts.
examples.zh: 图中「嵌入式合作学院」在虚构大学课程开始前，开设相衔接的第一项课程。

examples.en: We looked up embedded college in the definitions section of the UK sponsorship reading for class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂英国担保阅读材料的定义部分查阅「嵌入式合作学院」。

collocations: student sponsorship at an embedded college

words.enDefinition: A decision by a US appellate court sitting as a full court or other larger formation provided by its rules.

examples.en: The American research exercise compares an en banc decision with the earlier decision of a small judicial panel.
examples.zh: 美国法律检索练习把一项「全席审理裁判」与较早由小规模合议庭作出的裁判相比较。

examples.en: Our notes flag the en banc decision so students can check its place in the circuit's precedents.
examples.zh: 笔记标出「全席审理裁判」，以便学生核查它在该巡回区先例中的地位。

words.enDefinition: An Act that grants an authority the power to make further legal rules or instruments.

examples.en: We checked the enabling Act to see which body the fictional statutory instrument named as its maker.
examples.zh: 我们核对「授权制定规则的法令」，查明虚构法定文书所列的制定主体。

examples.en: The lecture puts the enabling Act beside the regulations so students can follow the chain of authority.
examples.zh: 讲座把「授权制定规则的法令」和规章并排展示，让学生看清权力的来源。

collocations: relevant provision in an enabling Act

words.enDefinition: A provision that grants particular legal powers, such as the power to make regulations.

examples.en: The UK law exercise asks which enabling provision authorises publication of the fictional instrument under study.
examples.zh: 英国法律练习询问，哪项「授权性条款」准许发布正在学习的虚构文书。

examples.en: We drew a line from the enabling provision to the regulation it authorises in the classroom outline.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂提纲里，从「授权性条款」画一条线连到它授权制定的规章。

collocations: authority conferred by an enabling provision

words.enDefinition: A conventional statement identifying the lawmaking authority and formally introducing the enacted provisions.

examples.en: The handout prints an enacting formula above the first section of the fictional Act for discussion.
examples.zh: 讲义将「法令制定语」印在虚构法令第一条上方，供全班讨论。

examples.en: We compared the enacting formula in the sample with the headings that organise the substantive provisions.
examples.zh: 我们把样本里的「法令制定语」与编排实体条款的标题作比较。

words.enDefinition: Legal measures through which an operative civil judgment is given effect

examples.en: The class chart places enforcement of a civil judgment after the decision and its formal recording.
examples.zh: 课堂图表将「民事判决执行」置于裁判作出并正式登记之后。

examples.en: We discussed enforcement of a civil judgment using an imaginary judgment in the course materials.
examples.zh: 我们使用课程材料里的假想判决讨论了「民事判决执行」。

collocations: rules on enforcement of a civil judgment
issue concerning enforcement of a civil judgment
discuss enforcement of a civil judgment

words.enDefinition: Use of legal procedures to compel compliance with an arbitration decision

examples.en: The international arbitration handout uses a hypothetical unpaid award to explain enforcement of an arbitral award.
examples.zh: 国际仲裁讲义用一份尚未兑现的模拟裁决来解释「执行仲裁裁决」。

examples.en: In the mock opinion, enforcement of an arbitral award is discussed separately from the tribunal's underlying findings.
examples.zh: 模拟裁判意见把「执行仲裁裁决」和仲裁庭本身的认定分开讨论。

collocations: seek enforcement of an arbitral award
order for enforcement of an arbitral award
requirements for enforcement of an arbitral award

words.enDefinition: a notice recording that a student's enrolment has been cancelled, where relevant to an Australian education provider process

examples.en: The fictional enrolment cancellation notice states the provider's decision and identifies the relevant course on its first page.
examples.zh: 虚构「取消注册通知」在首页说明教育机构的决定，并标明相关课程。

examples.en: We read the enrolment cancellation notice and marked when the change reached the institution's administrative record.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「取消注册通知」，并标出该变更何时录入机构管理记录。

collocations: date of an enrolment cancellation notice

words.enDefinition: A risk characteristic of or reasonably associated with an enterprise's activities, considered in some vicarious liability analyses.

examples.en: In the California seminar, enterprise risk explains why the nature of the fictional business matters to the analysis.
examples.zh: 在加州法律研讨课中，「经营活动固有风险」说明了虚构企业的经营性质为何会影响分析。

examples.en: The group compared enterprise risk with the risk arising solely from a worker's unrelated personal activity.
examples.zh: 小组把「经营活动固有风险」与完全源于员工无关私人活动的风险进行了比较。

words.enDefinition: a contractual obligation treated as one whole rather than as separate parts for purposes such as entitlement to payment

examples.en: The class considered an entire obligation where payment depended on delivering the finished work as a whole.
examples.zh: 在约定对价以整体交付完工成果为条件的情形中，全班讨论了「不可分履行义务」。

examples.en: We compared the entire obligation with separate duties attached to individual deliveries in another hypothetical contract.
examples.zh: 我们将「不可分履行义务」与另一假设合同中附属于每次交付的独立义务对照。

collocations: payment subject to an entire obligation

words.enDefinition: An entrant's legal classification, which may affect the duties owed under the applicable premises liability rules.

examples.en: The historical case notes discuss entrant status before turning to the store owner's responsibilities.
examples.zh: 历史案例笔记先讨论「场所进入者身份」，然后谈到店主的责任。

examples.en: The professor asked us to identify entrant status separately for both people in the fictional lease problem.
examples.zh: 教授要求我们分别认定虚构租赁问题中两个人的「场所进入者身份」。

words.enDefinition: Formal recording of a court's judgment in the US federal docket

examples.en: The mock docket marks entry of judgment in a separate dated entry.
examples.zh: 模拟案卷用一条单独带日期的记录标示「判决登记」。

examples.en: We distinguished the entry of judgment from the point when reasons were announced.
examples.zh: 我们将「判决登记」与宣布判决理由的时间点区分开来。

words.enDefinition: relief founded on equitable principles and subject to applicable discretionary standards, such as specific performance or an injunction

examples.en: The chart placed specific performance under equitable remedy and listed ordinary damages in a separate column.
examples.zh: 图表将强制实际履行列入「衡平法救济」，并在另一栏列出通常的损害赔偿。

examples.en: We checked the conditions for the equitable remedy in the fictional opinion before discussing the result.
examples.zh: 讨论结果前，我们先核对虚构判词中授予「衡平法救济」的条件。

words.enDefinition: under English law, setting a closely connected cross-claim against a claim where enforcing payment separately would be unjust

examples.en: The English law problem asks whether equitable set-off applies to two claims arising from closely related performance.
examples.zh: 英格兰法例题问，由密切相关的履行产生的两项请求是否可以「衡平抵销」。

examples.en: We discussed the relationship between the two claims before assessing equitable set-off in the hypothetical dispute.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论两项请求之间的关系，再判断假设争议中是否适用「衡平抵销」。

words.enDefinition: Mistaken choice made while weighing options, assessed against the relevant care standard

examples.en: The worksheet calls the choice an error of judgment before asking about reasonable care.
examples.zh: 习题先将这一选择称为「判断失误」，再就合理注意提问。

examples.en: We discussed whether the error of judgment involved a departure from the expected standard.
examples.zh: 我们讨论这项「判断失误」是否涉及偏离预期标准。

words.zhGloss: 澳海外学生教育法规框架
words.enDefinition: Australia's body of legislation and standards regulating education services provided to overseas students
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳海外学生教育法规框架

examples.en: The course summary uses ESOS framework for the laws and standards governing the fictional education provider's obligations.
examples.zh: 课程总结提到「澳海外学生教育法规框架」，指规范虚构教育机构义务的法规及标准。

examples.en: We opened the official guide to locate the ESOS framework provisions assigned for the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 我们打开官方指南，查找课堂对比指定的「澳海外学生教育法规框架」条文。

words.enDefinition: The terms sufficiently important to the parties or law that agreement on them matters to contract formation.

examples.en: Our seminar identified the essential terms of the fictional printing deal before examining the parties' later conduct.
examples.zh: 讨论课先找出虚构印刷交易的「必要条款」，再查看双方后续行为。

examples.en: We asked which essential terms remained unresolved after reading both draft emails in the mock case.
examples.zh: 我们阅读模拟案例的两封草稿邮件后，考察还有哪些「必要条款」尚未确定。

words.enDefinition: Item individually marked for presentation or consideration as evidence

examples.en: The mock transcript refers to an evidentiary exhibit by its specimen label.
examples.zh: 模拟庭审笔录以样本编号指代一件「呈堂证物」。

examples.en: We matched each evidentiary exhibit label with its description in the case packet.
examples.zh: 我们将各个「呈堂证物」标签与案卷中的对应说明配对。

words.enDefinition: Initial questioning of a witness by the party calling that witness

examples.en: The English example shows brief examination-in-chief in a civil trial supplementing a signed witness statement.
examples.zh: 英格兰程序示例展示了如何用简短的「民事庭审主询问」补充签名的证人陈述。

examples.en: We identified the calling party during examination-in-chief in a civil trial in the mock transcript.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟笔录的「民事庭审主询问」部分辨认出了传唤证人的一方。

collocations: conduct examination-in-chief in a civil trial
record examination-in-chief in a civil trial
example of examination-in-chief in a civil trial

words.enDefinition: a provision seeking to remove liability for specified events, losses or breaches, subject to applicable law

examples.en: The hypothetical court considered whether the exclusion clause covered the type of loss claimed under the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 假设法院讨论「责任排除条款」是否涵盖虚构协议下提出的那种损失。

examples.en: We marked the exclusion clause separately from the provision that capped all other covered claims in the contract.
examples.zh: 我们将「责任排除条款」和为其他适用请求设定最高额的合同条款分别标出。

words.enDefinition: Sole control of the instrumentality associated with an unusual event

examples.en: The worksheet asks about exclusive control in negligence at the time relevant to the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 习题问，在假设情境的相关时点是否存在「过失法上的排他控制」。

examples.en: We discussed exclusive control in negligence by comparing access to the fictional equipment in each scenario.
examples.zh: 我们比较各情境中谁能接触虚构器材，以讨论「过失法上的排他控制」。

collocations: facts showing exclusive control in negligence
role of exclusive control in negligence

words.enDefinition: a provision limiting a party to a designated remedy for a specified failure, if given effect under the governing law

examples.en: The exclusive remedy clause designated replacement as the contractual response to a particular defect in the fictional sale.
examples.zh: 在虚构买卖中，「排他性救济条款」指定更换为针对特定瑕疵的合同救济。

examples.en: We considered whether the exclusive remedy clause left any other remedies for the hypothetical buyer under applicable law.
examples.zh: 我们讨论依据适用法律，「排他性救济条款」是否给假设买方保留了其他救济。

collocations: scope of an exclusive remedy clause

words.enDefinition: A defense concerned with whether a person should be held responsible even if the conduct remains wrongful.

examples.en: The seminar described an excuse defense as focusing on responsibility for the conduct in its abstract example.
examples.zh: 讨论课用抽象示例说明，「可宽宥抗辩」关注当事人是否须对行为负责。

examples.en: In the mock opinion, the judge examined an excuse defense after assuming the conduct remained wrongful.
examples.zh: 在模拟判决中，法官先假定行为仍属不法，再审查「可宽宥抗辩」。

collocations: the requirements for an excuse defense

words.enDefinition: a decision or rule treating a duty as due even though an applicable condition did not occur

examples.en: The mock opinion discussed excuse of condition after finding that the party relying on it obstructed its occurrence.
examples.zh: 虚构判词认定主张该条件的一方阻止了条件成就，随后讨论「条件成就要求的免除」。

examples.en: We distinguished excuse of condition from a finding that the condition had already been met in the problem.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们区分了「条件成就要求的免除」与认定条件本已成就。

words.enDefinition: delay for which a contractual or legal rule provides relief from stated consequences

examples.en: The model timetable labels two days as excused delay under a provision supporting an extension of time.
examples.zh: 示例时间表根据允许顺延期限的条款，将其中两天标为「可免责的迟延」。

examples.en: We checked which effects of excused delay the fictional contract specified before considering a payment adjustment.
examples.zh: 讨论调整付款前，我们先检查虚构合同对「可免责的迟延」规定了哪些后果。

words.enDefinition: Regulatory violation with a justification relevant to rebutting a negligence presumption

examples.en: The California problem asks whether the conduct amounts to an excused statutory violation.
examples.zh: 加州法律题问，所述行为是否构成「可免责的法定违规」。

examples.en: We separated the excused statutory violation question from causation on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中把「可免责的法定违规」问题与因果关系分开列出。

collocations: issue of an excused statutory violation

words.enDefinition: money aimed at putting the injured party in the economic position it would have occupied had the contract been performed

examples.en: The worksheet used expectation damages to compare the promised position with the actual position after the hypothetical breach.
examples.zh: 习题用「期待利益损害赔偿」比较按约履行时的经济地位与假设违约后的实际经济地位。

examples.en: We deducted the expenses the claimant saved when calculating expectation damages in the classroom example of nonperformance.
examples.zh: 在课堂不履行案例中，我们计算「期待利益损害赔偿」时扣除了请求人节省的费用。

words.enDefinition: the value of receiving the contractual performance or benefit of the bargain as promised

examples.en: The court diagram illustrates the expectation interest by showing what the fictional claimant would have received upon performance.
examples.zh: 裁判示意图展示合同履行后虚构请求人本可获得的利益，从而说明「期待利益」。

examples.en: We distinguished the expectation interest from simply recovering the money spent preparing for the performance in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分「期待利益」与单纯取回为履行而支出的费用。

words.enDefinition: Specialized evidence given by a qualified expert to assist a civil court

examples.en: The class discusses expert evidence in civil proceedings in a fictional dispute about a technical drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论一场有关技术图纸的虚构纠纷中的「民事诉讼专家证据」。

examples.en: We identified which part of the extract was expert evidence in civil proceedings in the example.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出了示例节选中哪一部分属于「民事诉讼专家证据」。

collocations: admit expert evidence in civil proceedings
assess expert evidence in civil proceedings
scope of expert evidence in civil proceedings

words.expression: expert report in a civil case
words.lemma: expert report in a civil case
words.enDefinition: Written account of a specialist's findings and opinions in a civil dispute
acceptedEnVariants: expert report in a civil case

examples.en: The mock packet includes an expert report in a civil case about the condition of a display.
examples.zh: 模拟文件包含一份关于展品状况的「民事案件专家报告」。

examples.en: We read the conclusion of the expert report in a civil case before discussing its reasoning.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「民事案件专家报告」的结论，再讨论其推理。

collocations: read an expert report in a civil case
conclusions in an expert report in a civil case
contents of an expert report in a civil case

words.expression: explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument
words.lemma: explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument
words.enDefinition: A document accompanying UK secondary legislation to explain its purpose, policy background, and practical effect to Parliament and other readers.
acceptedEnVariants: explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument

examples.en: The handout includes an explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument alongside the text of the fictional instrument.
examples.zh: 讲义将一份「法定文书说明备忘录」与虚构法定文书正文并列收录。

examples.en: We read the explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument before summarising its policy background for class.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「法定文书说明备忘录」，然后在课上概述其政策背景。

collocations: prepare an explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument
consult an explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument
publish an explanatory memorandum to a statutory instrument

words.enDefinition: Separate material prepared to explain the context or operation of legislation, distinguished from the enacted provisions themselves.

examples.en: The UK law handout places explanatory notes to legislation beside the fictional section they discuss in class.
examples.zh: 英国法律讲义把「立法说明」和课堂所讨论的虚构条文并排放置。

examples.en: We compared the explanatory notes to legislation with the text actually enacted by the fictional legislature.
examples.zh: 我们把「立法说明」与虚构立法机关正式通过的法条文本作了比较。

collocations: legal status of explanatory notes to legislation

words.enDefinition: a directly stated event or requirement on which a duty to pay depends

examples.en: The hypothetical purchase order describes a signed receipt as an express condition of payment for the delivery.
examples.zh: 假设采购订单将签收的收据规定为对该交付的「明示付款条件」。

examples.en: We highlighted the wording of the express condition of payment in the materials for the contract seminar.
examples.zh: 我们在合同研讨课资料中突出标记了「明示付款条件」的措辞。

collocations: satisfy an express condition of payment
waive an express condition of payment
identify an express condition of payment

words.enDefinition: An agreement whose formation is shown through explicit written or spoken words.

examples.en: The mock case called the spoken agreement an express contract because both parties stated their commitments openly.
examples.zh: 模拟案例把口头协议称为「明示合同」，因为双方都明确说出了各自的承诺。

examples.en: We read the message exchange as possible evidence of an express contract in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 在课堂题中，我们把这些来往消息视为可能证明存在「明示合同」的证据。

collocations: the words of an express contract

words.enDefinition: A directly communicated invitation to come onto land or premises, capable of establishing permission subject to its terms.

examples.en: The fictional gallery gave an express invitation to enter in a letter about the exhibition opening.
examples.zh: 虚构画廊在有关展览开幕的信中发出了「明确的进入邀请」。

examples.en: Our answer identifies an express invitation to enter in the booking manager's message to the fictional group.
examples.zh: 答案指出订场经理发给虚构团体的消息中有一条「明确的进入邀请」。

collocations: give an express invitation to enter
rely on an express invitation to enter
evidence of an express invitation to enter

words.enDefinition: Repeal accomplished by language that states which legislation or provisions are being removed.

examples.en: The example of express repeal names the older sections directly in the text of the fictional Act.
examples.zh: 「明文废止」示例在虚构法令正文中直接点明了旧条文。

examples.en: The worksheet asks us to find express repeal in the schedule listing the changes to legislation.
examples.zh: 练习单要求我们在列明立法变动的附表中找出「明文废止」的内容。

words.enDefinition: A contractual term stated explicitly by the parties in writing or speech.

examples.en: The mock agreement gave the exhibition date as an express term in the first numbered clause.
examples.zh: 模拟协议在第一项编号条款中把展览日期列为「明示条款」。

examples.en: We read the express term before discussing whether the fictional contract left any point unstated.
examples.zh: 讨论虚构合同是否还有未明说的事项前，我们先读了「明示条款」。

collocations: an express term of the contract

words.zhGloss: 明列一项视为排除其他项
words.enDefinition: A canon under which expressly listing one or more items may signal that comparable unlisted items were excluded.
acceptedZhAnswers: 明列一项视为排除其他项

examples.en: The American seminar discusses expressio unius est exclusio alterius while interpreting a short list in a fictional statute.
examples.zh: 美国法研讨课在解释虚构制定法中的一份短列表时，讨论了「明列一项视为排除其他项」。

examples.en: Our class used expressio unius est exclusio alterius to evaluate one possible inference from the list.
examples.zh: 全班运用「明列一项视为排除其他项」，评估从该列表得出的一种可能推论。

collocations: apply expressio unius est exclusio alterius
invoke expressio unius est exclusio alterius
expressio unius est exclusio alterius canon

words.enDefinition: Magnitude of the injury or damage that actually results

examples.en: The invented examples differ in the extent of harm despite involving similar kinds of loss.
examples.zh: 这些虚构示例的损失种类相似，但「损害程度」不同。

examples.en: We recorded the extent of harm separately from the type of damage in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上将「损害程度」与损坏类别分开记录。

words.enDefinition: Material outside the contract text offered to help establish its meaning, scope, or formation.

examples.en: The mock American court considered extrinsic evidence after reading the disputed provision in the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟美国法院阅读虚构协议中有争议的条款后，考虑了「合同文本之外的证据」。

examples.en: We sorted the documents into contract text and extrinsic evidence before discussing their different classroom uses.
examples.zh: 我们将材料分为合同文本与「合同文本之外的证据」，再讨论课堂题中的不同用途。

words.enDefinition: the US nonimmigrant immigration status applicable to admitted academic students under its terms and conditions

examples.en: The lesson explains F-1 student status by comparing what is recorded on an entry record and a visa.
examples.zh: 课程通过比较入境记录与签证分别记载的内容，解释「美国F-1学生身份」。

examples.en: The fictional school's message linked continued F-1 student status to compliance with the applicable student requirements.
examples.zh: 虚构学校的消息将维持「美国F-1学生身份」与遵守适用的学生要求联系起来。

words.enDefinition: a separate US student eligibility form issued to an eligible dependent linked to the principal student's record

examples.en: The fictional file includes an F-2 dependent Form I-20 with the family member's own identifying details.
examples.zh: 虚构档案包含一份标有家庭成员本人身份信息的「F-2家属I-20表」。

examples.en: We separated the F-2 dependent Form I-20 from the principal student's form when labeling the teaching packet.
examples.zh: 我们标注教学材料包时，将「F-2家属I-20表」与主申请学生的表格分别归类。

collocations: issue an F-2 dependent Form I-20
details on an F-2 dependent Form I-20
identify an F-2 dependent Form I-20

words.enDefinition: US nonimmigrant status for a qualifying spouse or unmarried minor child of an F-1 academic student

examples.en: The classroom family chart indicates F-2 dependent status beside the fictional spouse of the academic student.
examples.zh: 课堂家庭关系图在该学生的虚构配偶旁标出「美国F-2家属身份」。

examples.en: We compared F-2 dependent status with the principal student's category in the example immigration records.
examples.zh: 我们在示例移民记录中，将「美国F-2家属身份」和主申请学生的类别作比较。

collocations: family member in F-2 dependent status

words.enDefinition: Judge or jury responsible for determining disputed facts in a proceeding

examples.en: The exercise asks who is the factfinder in the fictional bench trial.
examples.zh: 习题问，虚构无陪审团审理中的「事实认定者」是谁。

examples.en: We listed the factfinder separately from the lawyers on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上将「事实认定者」与律师分别列出。

words.enDefinition: Inquiry into whether conduct actually contributed to the occurrence of the harm

examples.en: The diagram places factual causation before the question about limits on legal responsibility.
examples.zh: 示意图将「事实因果关系」放在法律责任界限问题之前。

examples.en: We considered factual causation by comparing two possible versions of the fictional event.
examples.zh: 我们比较虚构事件的两个可能版本，以讨论「事实因果关系」。

words.enDefinition: The background facts reasonably available to the parties when contracting that may inform interpretation under English law.

examples.en: The seminar limited the factual matrix to circumstances both fictional groups could reasonably have known at formation.
examples.zh: 讨论课把「相关事实背景」限于虚构双方订立合同时本可以合理知悉的情形。

examples.en: We noted which background facts belonged to the factual matrix before interpreting the classroom's English agreement.
examples.zh: 解释课堂示例中的英格兰法协议前，我们先记录哪些事实属于「相关事实背景」。

collocations: interpret a clause in light of the factual matrix

words.zhGloss: 救济途径的根本目的落空
words.enDefinition: in US sales law, the failure of a designated remedy to provide the basic relief for which it was agreed
acceptedZhAnswers: 救济途径的根本目的落空

examples.en: The New York discussion addressed failure of essential purpose when the sole remedy could not provide repair.
examples.zh: 虚构的唯一救济无法提供约定修理时，纽约州课堂讨论了「救济途径的根本目的落空」。

examples.en: We considered failure of essential purpose and separately reviewed the fictional contract's exclusion of consequential damages.
examples.zh: 我们分别考虑「救济途径的根本目的落空」和假设合同中另一条款是否排除后果性损失赔偿。

collocations: finding of failure of essential purpose
limited remedy subject to failure of essential purpose

words.enDefinition: omission of a communication required under a contract or legal rule, with consequences depending on the applicable terms

examples.en: The hypothetical court examined failure to give notice as a separate issue from the delivery defect itself.
examples.zh: 假设法院将「未发出通知」与交付瑕疵本身作为两个独立问题审查。

examples.en: We considered whether failure to give notice changed the remedy available under the fictional agreement's stated terms.
examples.zh: 我们讨论，依照虚构协议写明的条款，「未发出通知」是否改变可获得的救济。

collocations: consequences of failure to give notice

words.zhGloss: 未陈述可获救济的请求
words.enDefinition: Federal objection that allegations do not state a legally viable claim
acceptedZhAnswers: 未陈述可获救济的请求

examples.en: The federal exercise uses failure to state a claim to assess the sufficiency of the allegations.
examples.zh: 联邦程序练习用「未陈述可获救济的请求」评估诉状里的主张是否充分。

examples.en: We discussed failure to state a claim before viewing any evidence in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论了「未陈述可获救济的请求」，再查看虚构案件中的证据。

collocations: dismissal for failure to state a claim
motion alleging failure to state a claim
discuss failure to state a claim

words.enDefinition: A legal claim or alleged omission based on failing to communicate a risk that applicable rules require someone to disclose.

examples.en: For the failure to warn exercise, the tutor handed out two fictional versions of a product leaflet.
examples.zh: 为做「未履行警示义务」练习，老师发放了某产品说明单的两个虚构版本。

examples.en: The mock pleading presents failure to warn as a separate allegation concerning the information supplied with the sample.
examples.zh: 模拟诉状把「未履行警示义务」作为一项独立指控，针对随样品提供的信息。

words.enDefinition: An account that represents an official proceeding or record fairly and correctly, as required for some forms of privilege.

examples.en: In the English classroom exercise, the fictional article is assessed as a possible fair and accurate report.
examples.zh: 在英格兰法课堂练习中，学生评估虚构文章是否属于「公正准确的报道」。

examples.en: Students identified differences that could affect whether the article qualified as a fair and accurate report.
examples.zh: 学生找出了哪些差异可能影响这篇文章能否被视为「公正准确的报道」。

collocations: publish a fair and accurate report
qualify as a fair and accurate report
fair and accurate report of proceedings

words.enDefinition: English consideration of whether recognizing a proposed duty is appropriate overall

examples.en: The seminar asks whether imposing the proposed duty would be fair, just and reasonable.
examples.zh: 研讨课问，确立题设中的注意义务是否「公平公正且合理」。

examples.en: We underlined fair, just and reasonable on the English law chart for novel duties.
examples.zh: 我们在英格兰法的新型义务图上给「公平公正且合理」画了下划线。

collocations: whether a duty is fair, just and reasonable
find it fair, just and reasonable
consider it fair, just and reasonable

words.enDefinition: A protection in some jurisdictions for sufficiently fair and accurate accounts of specified official proceedings or records.

examples.en: The American seminar uses a fictional court report to discuss the possible application of fair report privilege.
examples.zh: 美国法律研讨课用一份虚构庭审报道讨论「公正报道特权」可能如何适用。

examples.en: The fair report privilege exercise asks students to compare the fictional article with an official record.
examples.zh: 「公正报道特权」练习要求学生把虚构报道与一份官方记录相比较。

collocations: report covered by fair report privilege

words.enDefinition: In US jurisdictions recognising the tort, publicly putting someone in a misleading light that is highly offensive under the applicable standard.

examples.en: The American privacy class discusses whether a fictional caption could place its subject in a false light.
examples.zh: 美国隐私法课堂讨论，一条虚构图片说明能否让当事人被置于「公众面前的失实形象」之中。

examples.en: The comparison chart records which of the jurisdictions in our reading recognises false light as a privacy tort.
examples.zh: 对照表记录了阅读材料涉及的哪些司法辖区承认「公众面前的失实形象」是一类隐私侵权。

collocations: portray someone in a false light

words.enDefinition: Level of claimant fault triggering the applicable rule that blocks recovery

examples.en: The Ohio worksheet marks the fault threshold for recovery on a hypothetical comparison table.
examples.zh: 俄亥俄州法律习题在假设对比表上标出了「获赔的过失门槛」。

examples.en: We discussed whether each state used a fault threshold for recovery in the class chart.
examples.zh: 我们讨论课堂图表上的各州是否采用「获赔的过失门槛」。

collocations: determine the fault threshold for recovery
apply a fault threshold for recovery

words.enDefinition: Defective performance of work, such as construction, maintenance, or repair by a contractor on premises.

examples.en: The schedule in the English statutory example attributes the building condition to faulty execution of work.
examples.zh: 英格兰法条示例中的附表把建筑状况归因于「施工执行不当」。

examples.en: Our notes identify the company accused of faulty execution of work in the fictional repair project.
examples.zh: 我们的笔记指出了在虚构修缮项目中被指「施工执行不当」的公司。

collocations: harm attributed to faulty execution of work
faulty execution of work by a contractor
evidence of faulty execution of work

words.enDefinition: A different design that could practicably have been adopted when relevant, with its legal significance depending on the governing rule.

examples.en: The mock design report discusses whether a different handle was a feasible alternative design at the relevant time.
examples.zh: 模拟设计报告讨论另一种手柄在相关时间是否属于「可行的替代设计」。

examples.en: In the comparative exercise, both groups explain how their assigned jurisdictions treat evidence of a feasible alternative design.
examples.zh: 在对比练习中，两组都解释了各自所分配的司法辖区如何看待有关「可行的替代设计」的证据。

collocations: evidence of a feasible alternative design

words.enDefinition: Authority of United States federal courts to hear criminal matters under federal law.

examples.en: The American worksheet discussed federal criminal jurisdiction after identifying the federal law named in the fictional charge.
examples.zh: 美国习题先找出虚构指控援引的联邦法律，再讨论「联邦刑事管辖权」。

examples.en: We compared federal criminal jurisdiction with the state court's authority in the assigned classroom reading.
examples.zh: 我们在指定课堂阅读材料中比较了「联邦刑事管辖权」与州法院的权限。

collocations: an issue of federal criminal jurisdiction

words.enDefinition: A United States federal body that decides whether probable cause supports bringing charges by indictment.

examples.en: The classroom chart showed the federal grand jury before the trial jury in the fictional timeline.
examples.zh: 课堂图表在虚构时间线上把「联邦大陪审团」列在审判陪审团之前。

examples.en: We distinguished the federal grand jury's charging function from the later decision about guilt in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「联邦大陪审团」决定是否提出指控的职能与后续的有罪认定。

collocations: present evidence to a federal grand jury

words.enDefinition: Federal subject-matter authority over civil actions arising under specified federal law

examples.en: The mock complaint identifies a federal statute when discussing federal question jurisdiction in class.
examples.zh: 课堂模拟起诉状在讨论「联邦问题管辖权」时列出了一项联邦法规。

examples.en: We marked federal question jurisdiction on the chart as one route to federal court.
examples.zh: 我们在图中将「联邦问题管辖权」标为联邦法院受理民事案件的一项依据。

collocations: federal question jurisdiction over an action

words.enDefinition: The official US federal publication for documents such as agency rules, proposed rules, and notices.

examples.en: We searched a sample Federal Register issue for the date printed next to the fictional agency rule.
examples.zh: 我们在一期「《联邦公报》」样刊中寻找印在虚构机构规则旁边的日期。

examples.en: Our professor explained why a Federal Register citation sometimes appears next to a codified regulation's text.
examples.zh: 教授解释，为什么法规汇编条文的旁边有时会出现「《联邦公报》」引文。

words.enDefinition: A law enacted by the national legislature of a federation, such as the US Congress.

examples.en: The classroom example asks readers to locate the federal statute cited in the fictional agency notice.
examples.zh: 课堂示例要求读者找出虚构机构通知所引用的「联邦制定法」。

examples.en: The textbook uses a fictional federal statute to illustrate how Congress sets out duties in legislation.
examples.zh: 教材用一部虚构「联邦制定法」说明美国国会如何在立法中列明义务。

words.enDefinition: A category of more serious criminal offenses under the particular United States jurisdiction's classification.

examples.en: The American worksheet used felony as a statutory category in a fictional comparison of criminal charges.
examples.zh: 美国习题用「重罪」这一法定类别比较虚构的刑事指控。

examples.en: We checked how the model statute classified each offense before marking the felony column in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先查看示例法规如何给各项犯罪分类，再标出「重罪」一栏。

collocations: classify an offense as a felony

words.enDefinition: a specific exception under Canadian policy that makes the field of study criterion inapplicable to a particular post-graduation work permit case

examples.en: The worksheet discusses a field of study exemption separately from the fictional applicant's remaining eligibility criteria.
examples.zh: 习题将「专业领域要求豁免」和虚构申请人仍需满足的其他资格标准分别讨论。

examples.en: We found the field of study exemption in the official guidance extract before examining the two cases.
examples.zh: 在查看两个案例前，我们先在官方指南节选中找到「专业领域要求豁免」。

collocations: apply a field of study exemption
scope of a field of study exemption
eligibility for a field of study exemption

words.enDefinition: a condition assessing whether a completed program falls within accepted subject fields for a specified immigration benefit

examples.en: The Canadian handout uses field of study requirement when discussing eligibility for a specified post-study work authorization.
examples.zh: 加拿大讲义在讨论某项学业结束后工作许可的申请资格时，使用了「专业领域要求」。

examples.en: We checked which fictional program the field of study requirement applied to in the classroom guidance excerpt.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂指南节选中核对「专业领域要求」适用于哪个虚构项目。

collocations: meet a field of study requirement
scope of a field of study requirement

words.enDefinition: Federal order governing trial issues and procedures after final pretrial preparation

examples.en: The mock final pretrial order lists the issues that remain for trial.
examples.zh: 模拟「最终审前令」列出了仍需审理的问题。

examples.en: We checked which witness was named in the final pretrial order for class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们核对了「最终审前令」提到了哪名证人。

collocations: issues in a final pretrial order

words.enDefinition: In US agency rulemaking, a regulation issued in final form, often with a stated effective date.

examples.en: The classroom exercise asks when the fictional final rule was published and when it would take effect.
examples.zh: 课堂练习询问虚构「正式规则」在何时公布、何时生效。

examples.en: Our sample final rule lists the sections of the federal regulations that the issuing agency will amend.
examples.zh: 「正式规则」样本列出了发布机构将要修改的联邦法规条款。

collocations: effective date of a final rule

words.expression: financial requirement for the Student route
words.lemma: financial requirement for the student route
words.zhGloss: 英国学生类别资金要求
words.enDefinition: the financial eligibility requirement for UK Student permission, covering relevant course and living costs under the applicable rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生类别资金要求
acceptedEnVariants: financial requirement for the Student route

examples.en: The policy exercise lists the financial requirement for the Student route separately from identity and course evidence.
examples.zh: 政策练习将「英国学生类别资金要求」与身份和课程证明分别列出。

examples.en: We checked the heading for the financial requirement for the Student route in the official guidance excerpt.
examples.zh: 我们在官方指南节选中核对「英国学生类别资金要求」的标题。

collocations: meet the financial requirement for the Student route
assess the financial requirement for the Student route
evidence for the financial requirement for the Student route

words.expression: findings of fact in a civil case
words.lemma: findings of fact in a civil case
words.enDefinition: Determinations resolving the factual questions presented in a civil dispute
acceptedEnVariants: findings of fact in a civil case

examples.en: The federal example sets out findings of fact in a civil case before turning to legal conclusions.
examples.zh: 联邦程序示例先列出「民事案件事实认定」，再转入法律结论。

examples.en: We located findings of fact in a civil case in the first section of the fictional decision.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构裁判的第一节找到了「民事案件事实认定」。

collocations: state findings of fact in a civil case
read findings of fact in a civil case
separate findings of fact in a civil case

words.enDefinition: A merchant's signed offer to buy or sell goods that assures it will stay open under applicable UCC rules.

examples.en: The New York case study asked whether the signed stationery proposal was a firm offer under the UCC.
examples.zh: 纽约州案例题问，已签署的文具提议是否属于「UCC 商人确定要约」。

examples.en: We read a fictional signed record before debating whether it contained a firm offer under the UCC.
examples.zh: 我们读过一份虚构的签署记录，再讨论其中的提议是否属于「UCC 商人确定要约」。

collocations: identify a firm offer under the UCC
an example of a firm offer under the UCC
the limits of a firm offer under the UCC

words.enDefinition: To apply the relevant rule from an earlier judicial decision when deciding a later case.

examples.en: The mock court explains why it must follow a precedent from a higher court in the same system.
examples.zh: 模拟法院解释，为什么它必须「遵循先例」，该先例来自同一体系内的上级法院。

examples.en: Our assignment asks when a court may follow a precedent from another jurisdiction as persuasive authority.
examples.zh: 作业询问，法院什么时候可以「遵循先例」，把另一司法辖区的裁判作为有说服力的依据。

words.enDefinition: a contractual provision specifying events beyond a party's control and the resulting relief or changes in obligations

examples.en: The fictional force majeure clause listed events and described what would happen to the time for performance.
examples.zh: 虚构的「不可抗力条款」列明了各类事件，并规定履行时间将如何变化。

examples.en: We checked whether the force majeure clause addressed a temporary interruption or allowed the agreement to end.
examples.zh: 我们核查「不可抗力条款」是针对暂时中断，还是允许终止协议。

collocations: scope of a force majeure clause

words.enDefinition: an event treated as beyond a party's control and qualifying for relief under the applicable contract or law

examples.en: The hypothetical court asked whether the unexpected venue closure was a force majeure event under the written clause.
examples.zh: 假设法院问，突发的场地关闭按书面条款是否构成「不可抗力事件」。

examples.en: We identified the alleged force majeure event before discussing whether it had caused the delay in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先找出题目所主张的「不可抗力事件」，再讨论它是否造成延期。

collocations: delay caused by a force majeure event

words.enDefinition: Person within the group reasonably expected to be affected by conduct

examples.en: The worksheet asks whether the owner is a foreseeable claimant in the invented case.
examples.zh: 习题问，在虚构案例中，物品所有人是否属于「可预见的原告」。

examples.en: We discussed a foreseeable claimant by considering who might reasonably be affected.
examples.zh: 我们考察谁可能合理地受到影响，以讨论谁是「可预见的原告」。

words.enDefinition: loss that falls within the applicable test for what the parties or breaching party could anticipate when contracting

examples.en: The seminar considered foreseeable contractual loss using information available to the parties when they made the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 研讨课根据当事人订立虚构协议时可得的信息，讨论「可预见的合同损失」。

examples.en: We checked whether the claimed foreseeable contractual loss followed from circumstances discussed before the contract was signed.
examples.zh: 我们核对所主张的「可预见的合同损失」是否源于签约前讨论过的相关情形。

words.enDefinition: Later action within the range of events reasonably anticipated beforehand

examples.en: The model answer treats the helper’s conduct as a foreseeable intervening act in the scenario.
examples.zh: 参考答案把该情境中协助者的行动视为「可预见的介入行为」。

examples.en: We considered whether the foreseeable intervening act stayed within the risks discussed in class.
examples.zh: 我们考虑「可预见的介入行为」是否仍属于课堂讨论的风险范围。

collocations: effects of a foreseeable intervening act

words.enDefinition: Category of injury or damage that could be reasonably anticipated

examples.en: The class asks whether the damaged display represents a foreseeable kind of harm in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 课堂问，展品受损在假设情境中是否属于「可预见的损害种类」。

examples.en: We discussed a foreseeable kind of harm before considering the unexpected extent of the loss.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「可预见的损害种类」，再考察损失超出预期的程度。

collocations: identify a foreseeable kind of harm
example of a foreseeable kind of harm
classify a foreseeable kind of harm

words.enDefinition: In traditional US tort terminology, a substantial personal departure from an employee's assigned work.

examples.en: The facts describe an entirely personal trip, which the defendant characterised as a frolic in our mock case.
examples.zh: 案情描述了一次纯粹的私人出行，在模拟案例里，被告把它称为「擅离职务的私人活动」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared a frolic with a minor detour using errands from a fictional delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 老师用虚构送货时间表上的差事来比较「擅离职务的私人活动」和轻微绕行。

collocations: classify an activity as a frolic
distinction between a frolic and a detour

words.enDefinition: under some US contract rules, substantial defeat of the agreement's principal purpose by a supervening event assumed not to occur

examples.en: The seminar considered frustration of purpose after the fictional event was canceled despite the room remaining available.
examples.zh: 虚构活动取消、房间仍可使用的情况下，研讨课讨论了「合同目的落空」。

examples.en: We identified the agreement's principal purpose before discussing frustration of purpose under the assigned US rule.
examples.zh: 我们先判断协议的主要目的，再根据指定的美国规则讨论「合同目的落空」。

words.enDefinition: the enrollment or academic workload specified for a US student classification, which depends on the program and applicable rules

examples.en: The handout explains a full course of study separately for two fictional programs subject to different workload rules.
examples.zh: 讲义分别解释两项虚构项目的「规定的全日制修读量」，它们适用不同的学业负荷规则。

examples.en: We checked each program description before interpreting the phrase full course of study in the classroom materials.
examples.zh: 我们先查阅各项目说明，再解释课堂材料中「规定的全日制修读量」一语的含义。

collocations: pursue a full course of study
enroll in a full course of study
meet the full course of study requirement

words.enDefinition: The complete text of a judgment rather than a case summary or selected extract.

examples.en: The UK archive exercise asks students to open the full text judgment linked beside the case description.
examples.zh: 英国档案检索练习要求学生打开案件说明旁的「判决全文」链接。

examples.en: Our tutor recommends checking the full text judgment to trace the exact paragraph quoted by the fictional commentator.
examples.zh: 老师建议查阅「判决全文」，找出虚构评论者所引用的具体段落。

collocations: link to the full text judgment

words.enDefinition: In United States contract law, a writing adopted as the complete and final statement of the parties' agreement.

examples.en: The American worksheet asked whether the fictional text was a fully integrated agreement covering the whole exchange.
examples.zh: 美国课堂题问，这份虚构文本是不是涵盖整个交易的「完全整合的协议」。

examples.en: We read the mock court's explanation of why the writing counted as a fully integrated agreement.
examples.zh: 我们阅读模拟法院的说明，理解为何这份书面文书属于「完全整合的协议」。

collocations: treat a writing as a fully integrated agreement
evidence of a fully integrated agreement

words.enDefinition: a breach substantially depriving the other party of what the CISG contract entitles it to expect, subject to the treaty's foreseeability limitation

examples.en: The seminar compared fundamental breach under CISG with a merely minor departure in the fictional international sale.
examples.zh: 研讨课在虚构国际买卖中，比较了「《销售公约》下的根本违约」与仅轻微偏离约定的情形。

examples.en: We discussed fundamental breach under CISG after checking what the buyer was entitled to expect under the contract.
examples.zh: 我们先核对买方按合同可期待得到什么，再讨论「《销售公约》下的根本违约」。

collocations: elements of fundamental breach under CISG
avoidance for fundamental breach under CISG

words.enDefinition: Financial harm expected to arise after the time used to assess damages

examples.en: The worksheet states its assumptions before listing the estimated future pecuniary loss.
examples.zh: 习题先说明假设，再列出估算的「未来财产性损失」。

examples.en: The worksheet estimates future pecuniary loss from its fictional timetable of future expenses.
examples.zh: 习题依据虚构的未来开支时间表估算「未来财产性损失」。

words.enDefinition: In US borrowed-employee doctrine, the employer that originally employs the worker shared with or lent to another employer.

examples.en: In the California exercise, the worker's contract with the general employer remained in place during the assignment.
examples.zh: 在加州练习中，这名劳动者与「借调前的原雇主」的合同在任务期间仍然有效。

examples.en: We used the label general employer to trace who employed the worker before the temporary placement.
examples.zh: 我们根据「借调前的原雇主」这个标签查找谁在临时调派前雇用了该劳动者。

words.enDefinition: In some United States classifications, intent to engage in the conduct specified by the offense.

examples.en: The American table used general intent for the mental state associated with undertaking the stated conduct.
examples.zh: 美国课堂表格用「一般故意」表示实施所述行为所对应的心理状态。

examples.en: We compared the two model statutes before deciding whether the classroom example required general intent.
examples.zh: 我们比较两则示例法规，再判断课堂例题是否要求「一般故意」。

words.enDefinition: Agreement given freely and based on a sufficient understanding under the applicable rules of consent.

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the fictional record showed genuine assent given the party's account of the negotiations.
examples.zh: 考虑到当事人对协商经过的叙述，辅导老师问虚构记录是否表明存在「真实同意」。

examples.en: We identified a genuine assent issue even though the classroom file contained a signed page from both groups.
examples.zh: 尽管课堂档案中有双方签署的页面，我们仍识别出一个「真实同意」问题。

words.enDefinition: A general rule in some US employment-related tort cases that ordinary commuting typically falls outside the scope of employment.

examples.en: The California casebook introduces the going-and-coming rule with a fictional dispute involving an ordinary trip to work.
examples.zh: 加州案例教材用一宗涉及普通上班途中行程的虚构争议介绍「上下班通勤规则」。

examples.en: The diagram distinguishes the going-and-coming rule from exceptions that might apply when the employer assigns an errand.
examples.zh: 示意图区分了「上下班通勤规则」与雇主交办差事时可能适用的例外。

words.enDefinition: A provision identifying the law chosen to govern interpretation or other matters under the contract.

examples.en: The governing law clause named English law in the fictional exhibition supply agreement used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的虚构展览物资协议在「法律适用条款」中指定了英格兰法。

examples.en: We found the governing law clause before reading the mock opinion's discussion of how to interpret the text.
examples.zh: 阅读模拟判决关于如何解释文本的讨论前，我们先找到了「法律适用条款」。

collocations: the jurisdiction named in a governing law clause

words.enDefinition: A promise made without seeking a performance or return promise in exchange.
