examples.en: In the classroom example, a gratuitous promise offered a book without asking the classmate for anything in exchange.
examples.zh: 课堂例题中的「无偿承诺」答应送一本书，未要求同学提供任何回报。

examples.en: The seminar compared the gratuitous promise with a second example involving an exchange of student club services.
examples.zh: 讨论课将「无偿承诺」与另一个涉及学生社团交换服务的例题作比较。

collocations: distinguish a gratuitous promise from a bargain

words.enDefinition: In historical US federal sentencing materials, a sentence outside the applicable range based on authority provided by an older guideline provision.

examples.en: The historical federal reading used guideline departure to describe a fictional decision grounded in an older guideline provision.
examples.zh: 历史联邦法阅读材料用「依指南规则偏离量刑」描述一项依据旧版指南条文的虚构裁定。

examples.en: We found guideline departure in a mock opinion in a lesson on historical federal sentencing.
examples.zh: 在学习美国联邦量刑沿革时，我们在一篇模拟判决意见中找到了「依指南规则偏离量刑」一语。

collocations: apply a guideline departure under an older manual
a ruling on a guideline departure

words.enDefinition: A formal trial finding that the charged offense has been proved under the applicable standard.

examples.en: The fictional jury returned a guilty verdict on one count listed in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 虚构陪审团就课堂题列出的一项指控作出「有罪裁决」。

examples.en: We placed the guilty verdict on the timeline before the separate entry for the court's sentence.
examples.zh: 我们把「有罪裁决」标在时间线上、法院量刑的单独条目之前。

collocations: a guilty verdict on one count

words.enDefinition: To formally deliver or release a judgment, especially in UK court usage.

examples.en: The UK court schedule shows when judges would hand down a judgment in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 英国法院日程显示，法官何时将在虚构案件中「正式宣布判决」。

examples.en: The news exercise asks whether the court will hand down a judgment immediately after hearing arguments.
examples.zh: 新闻练习询问，法院听完论辩后是否会立即「正式宣布判决」。

collocations: hand down a judgment in open court
date to hand down a judgment
scheduled to hand down a judgment

words.enDefinition: US framework comparing precaution burdens with probability multiplied by potential loss

examples.en: The class uses the Hand formula to compare costs in an imaginary case.
examples.zh: 课堂用「汉德公式」比较一个假想案例中的各项成本。

examples.en: We labeled probability, loss, and precaution burden in the Hand formula chart.
examples.zh: 我们在「汉德公式」图表中标出了概率、损失和防范负担。

collocations: use the Hand formula in a hypothetical

words.enDefinition: To read provisions together in a way that gives them consistent effect when reasonably possible.

examples.en: The class tried to harmonize contract terms before deciding whether the two descriptions of delivery were inconsistent.
examples.zh: 我们先尝试「协调解释合同条款」，再判断两处关于交付的描述是否相互矛盾。

examples.en: We discussed how to harmonize contract terms by reading the schedule with the main text in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在习题中，我们把附表与正文一起读，讨论怎样「协调解释合同条款」。

collocations: harmonize contract terms before finding a conflict

words.enDefinition: Distinct categories of harm or expense considered in assessing compensation

examples.en: We arranged the heads of loss in separate rows of the fictional award table.
examples.zh: 我们将各项「损失项目」分别列在虚构赔偿表的各行。

examples.en: The tutor checked whether two heads of loss included the same fictional expense.
examples.zh: 老师检查两个「损失项目」是否指的是同一笔开支。

words.enDefinition: Ground allowing admission of hearsay under an applicable evidence rule

examples.en: The federal worksheet asks which hearsay exception is mentioned in the fictional ruling.
examples.zh: 联邦程序习题问，虚构裁定提到了哪项「传闻证据例外」。

examples.en: We read the hearsay exception alongside the general rule in the classroom packet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂文件包上将「传闻证据例外」和一般规则并排阅读。

words.zhGloss: 民事诉讼中的传闻证据
words.enDefinition: Out-of-court statement offered to establish the truth of what it asserts
acceptedZhAnswers: 民事诉讼中的传闻证据

examples.en: We compared rules on hearsay in civil proceedings in the federal and English law exercises.
examples.zh: 我们比较了联邦程序练习与英格兰法练习中「民事诉讼中的传闻证据」的规则。

examples.en: The worksheet identifies hearsay in civil proceedings before discussing how the applicable rule treats it.
examples.zh: 习题先辨认「民事诉讼中的传闻证据」，再讨论适用规则如何处理。

collocations: issue of hearsay in civil proceedings
treatment of hearsay in civil proceedings
example of hearsay in civil proceedings

words.enDefinition: A power in UK primary legislation to amend or repeal provisions of primary legislation by secondary legislation.

examples.en: The parliamentary reading compares a Henry VIII power with a narrower power to make administrative rules.
examples.zh: 议会制度读物把「亨利八世权力」与范围更窄的制定行政规则权力作比较。

examples.en: The fictional bill contains a Henry VIII power whose scope the class examines in the following section.
examples.zh: 虚构议案含有一项「亨利八世权力」，全班在下一节课研究其范围。

collocations: scope of a Henry VIII power

words.enDefinition: The ordering of legal norms by authority within a legal system, relevant when rules conflict.

examples.en: Our seminar uses a diagram of the hierarchy of norms to compare national and local legal provisions.
examples.zh: 研讨课用「法律规范位阶」示意图比较国家和地方的法律条文。

examples.en: The fictional example asks where a regulation belongs in the hierarchy of norms shown on the board.
examples.zh: 虚构示例询问，一项规章在黑板所示的「法律规范位阶」中位于哪里。

collocations: position in the hierarchy of norms

words.enDefinition: An interference with privacy sufficiently offensive to a reasonable person under the standard used in an intrusion claim.

examples.en: The fictional claim uses highly offensive intrusion as part of the test in the American model instruction.
examples.zh: 虚构诉求采纳美国示范指引，把「严重冒犯的侵扰」作为判定标准的一部分。

examples.en: The students reviewed the agreed facts before discussing what might qualify as a highly offensive intrusion.
examples.zh: 学生先阅读双方认可的事实，再讨论什么可能构成「严重冒犯的侵扰」。

words.zhGloss: 法院对法律问题的裁断
words.enDefinition: The court's determination of a legal issue necessary to decide the case, particularly in US case briefing.
acceptedZhAnswers: 法院对法律问题的裁断

examples.en: The American case brief states the holding of the court immediately after setting out the issue presented.
examples.zh: 美国判例简报列出提交审理的问题后，紧接着写明「法院对法律问题的裁断」。

examples.en: We compared the holding of the court with an example the judges mentioned while explaining their reasoning.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「法院对法律问题的裁断」与法官阐释理由时提到的一个例子。

collocations: state the holding of the court
distinguish the holding of the court
scope of the holding of the court

words.enDefinition: The principle governing a court's adherence to its own prior decisions, including when it may depart from them.

examples.en: We discussed horizontal stare decisis when the fictional appellate court reconsidered one of its own earlier decisions.
examples.zh: 虚构上诉法院重新考虑它自己的一项较早裁判时，我们讨论了「横向遵循先例原则」。

examples.en: The classroom note on horizontal stare decisis explains why the issuing court matters to the precedent question.
examples.zh: 课堂关于「横向遵循先例原则」的笔记解释，为什么先例由何法院作出会影响判断。

words.enDefinition: A jury unable to reach the agreement required for a verdict after deliberating.

examples.en: The worksheet described a hung jury after the fictional jurors could not agree on a decision.
examples.zh: 习题写道，虚构陪审员未能就裁决达成一致，因此成了「意见僵持的陪审团」。

examples.en: We treated a hung jury as a distinct procedural outcome in our chart of the classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例流程图里，我们把出现「意见僵持的陪审团」列为一种独立的程序结果。

collocations: a proceeding involving a hung jury
a mistrial following a hung jury

words.enDefinition: An apparent commitment whose terms leave performance entirely to the supposed promisor's choice.

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the fictional promise of unlimited discretion amounted to an illusory promise under American law.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，虚构案例中由一方全权决定是否履行的承诺，在美国法下是否属于「虚幻承诺」。

examples.en: We looked at the limits on choice before classifying the response as an illusory promise in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们查看选择权是否有限制，再在习题中判断那条回复是否构成「虚幻承诺」。

collocations: a clause containing an illusory promise
distinguish an illusory promise from a commitment

words.enDefinition: a charge payable for certain UK immigration applications to support access to public health services under applicable rules

examples.en: The teaching file lists the immigration health surcharge separately from the fee for deciding the fictional application.
examples.zh: 教学文件将「英国移民医疗附加费」与审理虚构申请的费用分别列出。

examples.en: We identified the immigration health surcharge on the classroom payment statement without using real charges or dates.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂付款单上辨认出「英国移民医疗附加费」，练习所用收费和日期均为虚构。

collocations: exemption from the immigration health surcharge

words.enDefinition: a medical examination used to assess specified health requirements for an immigration process when it is required

examples.en: The fictional file lists an immigration medical examination entry separately from the student's proof of school acceptance.
examples.zh: 虚构文件将「移民体检」条目与学生的校方录取证明分别列出。

examples.en: The class read the description of an immigration medical examination on an administrative checklist supplied for discussion.
examples.zh: 全班阅读了用于讨论的行政清单上对「移民体检」的描述。

collocations: exemption from an immigration medical examination

words.enDefinition: a decision to shorten a previously granted period of UK immigration permission under the applicable legal framework

examples.en: The classroom timeline places immigration permission curtailment after an administrative decision under the assigned UK guidance.
examples.zh: 课堂时间线在指定英国指南下的一项行政决定之后标出「移民许可缩短」。

examples.en: We compared the immigration permission curtailment entry with the originally granted end date in the fictional record.
examples.zh: 我们将虚构记录中的「移民许可缩短」一项与原先批准的结束日期作比较。

words.expression: implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
words.lemma: implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
words.zhGloss: 默示诚信与公平交易义务
words.enDefinition: in many US jurisdictions, an implied contractual duty of good faith and fair dealing whose scope depends on governing law
acceptedZhAnswers: 默示诚信与公平交易义务
acceptedEnVariants: implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing

examples.en: The professor contrasted the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing with rewriting a bargain after signing.
examples.zh: 老师将「默示诚信与公平交易义务」与签约之后重写约定区分开来。

examples.en: The case note identifies an implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing in the stated jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 案例注释指出，题设司法辖区认可「默示诚信与公平交易义务」。

collocations: invoke the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
breach of the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
scope of the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing

words.enDefinition: Permission to enter inferred from conduct or circumstances in a way the applicable law recognises.

examples.en: We discussed whether the fictional notice and usual opening hours suggested implied permission to enter.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了虚构告示和通常开放时段是否暗示存在「默示进入许可」。

examples.en: The English case note examines implied permission to enter in light of the landholder's conduct.
examples.zh: 这份英格兰案例笔记结合土地占有人的行为讨论了「默示进入许可」。

words.enDefinition: Under certain legal systems, the displacement of an earlier rule by a later irreconcilable provision even without express repeal.

examples.en: Our comparative law exercise treats implied repeal as a separate question from what the new statute explicitly removes.
examples.zh: 比较法练习把「默示废止」与新制定法明确删除什么的问题分开讨论。

examples.en: The fictional judgment analyses implied repeal after trying to read the two statutory provisions together.
examples.zh: 虚构判决先尝试把两项制定法条款结合起来理解，再分析「默示废止」。

words.enDefinition: A term that becomes part of a contract under applicable legal rules without being expressly stated.

examples.en: The fictional opinion considered an implied term after finding that the written clauses left the point unanswered.
examples.zh: 发现成文条款没回答该问题后，虚构判决考察了可能的「默示条款」。

examples.en: We discussed an implied term alongside the exact words in the classroom's English contract law example.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂英格兰合同法示例中，将一项「默示条款」与合同原文一并讨论。

collocations: an implied term of a contract

words.expression: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.lemma: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.zhGloss: 特定用途适用性默示担保
words.enDefinition: an implied US sales warranty arising when the seller has reason to know the buyer's particular purpose and reliance on the seller's skill or judgment, and the buyer relies on it
acceptedZhAnswers: 特定用途适用性默示担保
acceptedEnVariants: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose

examples.en: The New York problem asks whether an implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose arose at contracting.
examples.zh: 纽约州例题问，订立合同时是否产生「特定用途适用性默示担保」。

examples.en: We distinguished the implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose from suitability for the goods' ordinary use.
examples.zh: 我们区分「特定用途适用性默示担保」与货物适用于普通用途这一要求。

collocations: assert an implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
breach of the implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose claim

words.enDefinition: in US sales law, an implied warranty for goods sold by a merchant of that kind, including ordinary fitness, unless properly excluded or modified

examples.en: The New York problem discusses the implied warranty of merchantability for goods from a merchant of that kind.
examples.zh: 纽约州例题讨论了经销该类货物的商人所售货物的「适销性默示担保」。

examples.en: We compared the implied warranty of merchantability with a promise about the buyer's separate specialized use.
examples.zh: 我们将「适销性默示担保」与针对买方另有特殊用途而作出的承诺作比较。

collocations: breach the implied warranty of merchantability
exclude the implied warranty of merchantability
implied warranty of merchantability for goods

words.enDefinition: an immigration application made from within the country whose permission is requested, where the relevant process allows it

examples.en: The worksheet labels the fictional submission as an in-country application because it was made within the United Kingdom.
examples.zh: 习题将虚构申请标为「境内申请」，因为它是在英国境内提交的。

examples.en: We compared an in-country application with the one lodged abroad in the assigned UK guidance example.
examples.zh: 我们将英国指定指南示例中的「境内申请」与另一份在境外递交的申请比较。

words.expression: in force on a given date
words.lemma: in force on a given date
words.enDefinition: Legally operative on a particular date, taking account of the relevant commencement, amendment, or repeal provisions.
acceptedEnVariants: in force on a given date

examples.en: The worksheet asks which subsection was in force on a given date in the fictional timeline.
examples.zh: 练习单要求找出虚构时间线上哪一个分条「在指定日期有效」。

examples.en: The tutor compared published versions to show how to check wording in force on a given date.
examples.zh: 老师通过比较已公布的版本，演示如何核查「在指定日期有效」的条文措辞。

collocations: text in force on a given date
provision in force on a given date
verify what was in force on a given date

words.enDefinition: In legal interpretation, on the same subject or purpose so that separate enactments may be read together.

examples.en: The American casebook treats two fictional statutes as in pari materia because they address the same subject.
examples.zh: 美国案例教材把两部虚构制定法按「同类法条合并理解」处理，因为它们涉及同一事项。

examples.en: Our tutor asks whether the assigned provisions should be read in pari materia despite their different dates.
examples.zh: 老师询问，指定阅读的条文尽管日期不同，是否仍应按「同类法条合并理解」阅读。

words.enDefinition: a formal decision that a person falls within a legal ground barring admission or stay, subject to applicable rules

examples.en: The fictional inadmissibility determination cites the ground considered by the decision maker in the Canadian law exercise.
examples.zh: 加拿大法练习中的虚构「不准入认定」引用决定机关所审查的事由。

examples.en: We marked the relevant law before discussing the inadmissibility determination in the mock immigration decision.
examples.zh: 讨论虚构移民决定中的「不准入认定」之前，我们先标出相关法规。

words.enDefinition: An offense addressing conduct directed toward another crime even though that other crime is not completed.

examples.en: The seminar listed an inchoate offense in a separate column from the completed offense in its diagram.
examples.zh: 讨论课在图中将「未完成罪」与已经完成的犯罪分栏列出。

examples.en: We examined whether the fictional charge described an inchoate offense before reading the abstract legal definition.
examples.zh: 阅读抽象的法律定义之前，我们先考察虚构指控是否属于「未完成罪」。

collocations: an example of an inchoate offense

words.zhGloss: 《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿
words.enDefinition: in US sales law, compensation for qualifying commercially reasonable expenses incurred in responding to a breach
acceptedZhAnswers: 《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿

examples.en: The New York sales exercise discussed incidental damages under UCC for reasonable costs connected with the rejected delivery.
examples.zh: 纽约州买卖法练习讨论因拒收交货产生的合理费用能否获得「《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿」。

examples.en: We compared incidental damages under UCC with claimed lost sales when sorting the fictional buyer's expense list.
examples.zh: 我们整理虚构买方的费用清单时，将「《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿」与所主张的销售损失比较。

words.enDefinition: Provisions drawn into a contract from another source under the applicable rules.

examples.en: The classroom draft pointed to a schedule containing the incorporated terms for the fictional exhibition agreement.
examples.zh: 课堂草案指向一份附表，里面有虚构展览协议「并入的条款」。

examples.en: We checked which incorporated terms the mock opinion treated as part of the parties' actual agreement.
examples.zh: 我们查看了模拟判决将哪些「并入的条款」视为双方实际协议的一部分。

words.enDefinition: Making an external document or provision part of a contract through a reference that the law recognizes.

examples.en: The mock agreement illustrated incorporation by reference by naming a separate document containing the exhibition details.
examples.zh: 模拟协议写明载有展览细节的另一份文件，以说明「引用并入」。

examples.en: We followed the cross-reference in the draft before discussing incorporation by reference in our classroom case.
examples.zh: 在讨论课堂案例中的「引用并入」之前，我们沿着草案中的交叉引用查找相关文件。

collocations: an issue of incorporation by reference
incorporation by reference of a schedule

words.enDefinition: English approach developing new duties by comparison with established legal categories

examples.en: The incremental approach to duty compares the fictional relationship with the closest established category.
examples.zh: 「渐进确认义务的方法」把虚构关系与最接近的既有义务类型作比较。

examples.en: We used the incremental approach to duty to explain the reasoning shown on the class chart.
examples.zh: 我们用「渐进确认义务的方法」解释课堂图表中所示的推理。

collocations: explain the incremental approach to duty
apply the incremental approach to duty

words.enDefinition: a term by which one party assumes an obligation to cover specified losses, liabilities or claims of another

examples.en: The fictional indemnity clause listed which third-party claims the supplier agreed to cover under the service contract.
examples.zh: 虚构的「补偿责任条款」列出了供应方同意按服务合同承担的第三方请求。

examples.en: We compared the indemnity clause with the damages provision to understand their separate functions in the classroom agreement.
examples.zh: 我们将「补偿责任条款」与赔偿条款相对照，了解二者在课堂协议中的不同作用。

words.zhGloss: 仅依起诉书审理的罪行
words.enDefinition: In England and Wales, an offense for which trial takes place only in the Crown Court.
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅依起诉书审理的罪行

examples.en: The classroom problem treated the fictional charge as an indictable-only offence requiring trial in the Crown Court.
examples.zh: 课堂题把虚构指控归为「仅依起诉书审理的罪行」，须在皇家刑事法院审判。

examples.en: We traced an indictable-only offence from the first court entry to the trial forum in class.
examples.zh: 我们从课堂卷宗的首条登记开始，追踪「仅依起诉书审理的罪行」最后由哪一法院开庭审判。

collocations: a case involving an indictable-only offence

words.enDefinition: Single harm whose effects cannot reasonably be separated into shares by cause

examples.en: The seminar treats the modeled damage as indivisible harm because it cannot be separated.
examples.zh: 由于模型中的损坏无法拆开，研讨课将其视为「不可分损害」。

examples.en: We compared indivisible harm with separate losses in the fictional answer chart.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构案例的答案图中比较了「不可分损害」和几项独立损失。

words.enDefinition: Usual industry practice considered as evidence of the appropriate standard of care

examples.en: We considered industry custom in negligence after reading how similar fictional workshops handled their records.
examples.zh: 我们阅读类似虚构工坊的记录管理方式后，讨论了「过失法上的行业惯例」。

examples.en: The California exercise treats industry custom in negligence as relevant to assessing reasonable care.
examples.zh: 加州法律练习将「过失法上的行业惯例」作为评估合理注意的相关因素。

collocations: evidence of industry custom in negligence
role of industry custom in negligence

words.enDefinition: Conclusion of possible negligence drawn from circumstances consistent with that conclusion

examples.en: The fictional example asks whether the circumstances support an inference of negligence.
examples.zh: 虚构示例问，相关情境是否支持作出「过失推断」。

examples.en: We marked the inference of negligence separately from the facts used to support it.
examples.zh: 我们将「过失推断」与用来支持它的事实分开标注。

collocations: evidence supporting an inference of negligence

words.enDefinition: A minor violation classified separately from misdemeanors in some United States jurisdictions.

examples.en: The American lesson used infraction as the label for a minor violation in one model jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 美国课堂以「轻微违法事项」标注某个示例司法辖区中的轻微违法行为。

examples.en: We checked how the fictional statute defined an infraction before comparing the available court procedures.
examples.zh: 我们核对虚构法规如何定义「轻微违法事项」，再比较适用的法庭程序。

collocations: classify a violation as an infraction

words.enDefinition: An early United States criminal proceeding at which the defendant is first brought before a judicial officer.

examples.en: The mock federal docket placed the initial appearance before the later entry asking for a plea.
examples.zh: 模拟联邦案件登记表把「首次出庭」列在随后要求作出答辩的记录之前。

examples.en: We read the initial appearance entry to locate the first judicial stage of the classroom case.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「首次出庭」条目，找出课堂案例的第一个司法阶段。

collocations: a docket entry for an initial appearance

words.enDefinition: Information federal parties generally exchange at an early stage under specified rules

examples.en: The mock calendar lists initial disclosures before the later discovery requests.
examples.zh: 模拟日历先列出「初始披露」，随后才列证据开示请求。

examples.en: We identified which items belonged to initial disclosures in the federal classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们在联邦程序课堂示例中辨认出哪些项目属于「初始披露」。

words.enDefinition: a student record marked Initial in SEVIS before the relevant school registration and activation for the program

examples.en: The simulated dashboard labeled the newly created entry an initial SEVIS record before the school recorded registration.
examples.zh: 学校登记学生注册情况之前，模拟面板将新建的条目标为「SEVIS初始状态记录」。

examples.en: We compared the initial SEVIS record with the later dashboard entry after registration in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构示例中，将「SEVIS初始状态记录」与注册后面板上的条目比较。

collocations: information on an initial SEVIS record

words.enDefinition: A time-stamped or dated record of inspections of premises, which may be relevant to what should have been discovered.

examples.en: In the mock case, the property manager's inspection log recorded the date of each inspection round.
examples.zh: 模拟案例中，物业经理的「场所检查日志」记载了每轮检查的日期。

examples.en: The seminar question asks what gaps in the inspection log might mean in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 研讨课问题要求说明「场所检查日志」里的空白在假设案例中可能意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: Examination of disclosed documents when permitted by the applicable civil rules

examples.en: The England and Wales chart places inspection of documents after the listing stage.
examples.zh: 英格兰和威尔士的程序图将「文书查阅」放在制作文书清单之后。

examples.en: We located inspection of documents in the specimen order on exchanging information.
examples.zh: 我们在关于交换信息的样本程序令中找到了「文书查阅」。

words.enDefinition: a single UK course combining undergraduate and master's-level study, relevant to particular Student route rules

examples.en: The chart describes an integrated masters course as a single program with lower and higher level study.
examples.zh: 图表把「本硕衔接课程」描述为包含较低和较高两个学习层级的单一项目。

examples.en: We compared an integrated masters course with two separately admitted courses in the fictional sponsorship file.
examples.zh: 我们将「本硕衔接课程」与虚构担保文件中分别录取的两项课程作比较。

collocations: enrol on an integrated masters course
completion of an integrated masters course

words.enDefinition: A person or group for whom a product is designed or marketed, relevant when assessing expected use and safety.

examples.en: The case packet describes the intended user of an imaginary drawing table in the manufacturer's brochure.
examples.zh: 案例材料通过制造商的宣传册介绍一张虚构绘图桌的「产品的预定使用者」。

examples.en: Our discussion compares what an intended user could expect with what the reports actually recorded about the product.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「产品的预定使用者」的预期与相关报告实际记录的产品表现。

words.enDefinition: An intention, assessed objectively in English contract law, for an agreement to have legal effect.

examples.en: The English worksheet asked whether the fictional parties showed an intention to create legal relations in their exchange.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题问，虚构双方是否在往来中表现出「设立法律关系的意图」。

examples.en: We examined the agreement's setting before discussing intention to create legal relations in the mock judgment.
examples.zh: 我们先分析协议订立的场合，再讨论模拟判决中的「设立法律关系的意图」。

collocations: show intention to create legal relations
assess intention to create legal relations
evidence of intention to create legal relations

words.enDefinition: a period of study for an additional qualification between parts of an ongoing course, relevant to UK Student rules

examples.en: The fictional medical course timeline places intercalation between two years of the student's main academic program.
examples.zh: 虚构医学课程时间线将「插修学位课程」安排在该生主修项目的两个学年之间。

examples.en: We read how intercalation appears in the UK sponsor guidance example about returning to a main course.
examples.zh: 我们阅读英国担保指南中返回主修课程的示例如何描述「插修学位课程」。

words.enDefinition: In statutes using this heading, the section that defines terms or sets out rules for reading the Act.

examples.en: The legislation worksheet asks students to find the interpretation section before deciding what the defined term means.
examples.zh: 立法阅读练习单要求学生找出「释义条文」，再判断已定义术语的含义。

examples.en: Under the interpretation section of the fictional Act, the definition applies throughout the document unless otherwise stated.
examples.zh: 根据虚构法令的「释义条文」，除非另有说明，该定义适用于整部文件。

words.enDefinition: Later action occurring between the original conduct and the harm under review

examples.en: The class considers an intervening act after introducing a second fictional actor.
examples.zh: 课堂引入第二名虚构行为人后，分析一项「介入行为」。

examples.en: We marked the intervening act on the timeline before assessing its legal effect.
examples.zh: 我们先在时间线上标出「介入行为」，再评估其法律影响。

words.enDefinition: Within the legal powers given to a person or body in the circumstances.

examples.en: The mock judgment explains why the fictional authority's decision was intra vires under the relevant legislative provision.
examples.zh: 模拟判决解释了依相关法律条文，虚构机关的决定为何是「在权限以内的」。

examples.en: Our exercise asks what language in the enabling Act supports calling the rule intra vires.
examples.zh: 练习询问，授权法中的哪些文字支持把这项规则认定为「在权限以内的」。

words.enDefinition: In US privacy tort law, an offensive intrusion into someone else's private affairs or seclusion, subject to applicable legal elements.

examples.en: The American privacy unit uses stipulated fictional facts to introduce intrusion upon seclusion as a distinct civil claim.
examples.zh: 美国隐私法单元采用双方约定的虚构事实，将「侵扰私人生活安宁」作为一类独立的民事请求介绍。

examples.en: The sample answer on intrusion upon seclusion focuses on the expectation of privacy described in the agreed facts.
examples.zh: 关于「侵扰私人生活安宁」的参考答案聚焦双方认可的案情中描述的隐私期待。

words.enDefinition: In English contract law, an invitation for others to make an offer rather than itself showing final commitment.

examples.en: The English law exercise asked whether the campus sale display was merely an invitation to treat.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题问，校园售卖展台的陈列是否仅为「要约邀请」。

examples.en: We marked invitation to treat beside the announcement inviting student groups to send their own proposals.
examples.zh: 我们在邀请学生团体提出各自方案的公告旁标注了「要约邀请」。

collocations: classify a display as an invitation to treat
distinguish an invitation to treat from an offer
an example of an invitation to treat

words.enDefinition: The particular question submitted for the court to decide, often stated explicitly in a US case document or brief.

examples.en: The case brief begins with the issue presented before summarising how the fictional court answered the question.
examples.zh: 判例简报先写出「提交法院审理的问题」，再概述虚构法院怎样回答。

examples.en: Our tutor asks whether the issue presented is framed more narrowly in the opinion than in the assignment.
examples.zh: 老师询问，裁判意见里「提交法院审理的问题」的表述是否比作业里的更窄。

words.enDefinition: Meeting in which the mediator and all sides discuss the dispute together

examples.en: Both teams heard the facilitator explain ground rules at the opening joint mediation session.
examples.zh: 双方小组在第一次「共同调解会议」上都听到调解员说明基本规则。

examples.en: After the separate meetings, another joint mediation session appears in our role-play script.
examples.zh: 角色扮演脚本中，在分头会面之后还有一场「共同调解会议」。

collocations: participants in a joint mediation session

words.enDefinition: In US federal criminal procedure, a court's entry of acquittal on an offense when the evidence is insufficient to sustain a conviction.

examples.en: The mock federal opinion recorded a judgment of acquittal on a count and explained its basis.
examples.zh: 模拟联邦判决就其中一项指控载明「无罪判决」，并解释其依据。

examples.en: We located the judgment of acquittal in the classroom file before identifying who issued the ruling.
examples.zh: 我们先在课堂卷宗中查到「无罪判决」，再确认由谁作出该裁定。

collocations: a judgment of acquittal on a count
a ruling granting a judgment of acquittal

words.enDefinition: Judgment deciding substantive rights or claims raised in a proceeding

examples.en: The fictional docket records a judgment on the merits resolving the underlying civil claim.
examples.zh: 虚构案卷记载了一项解决原民事请求的「实体判决」。

examples.en: We compared the judgment on the merits with an order addressing only a procedural question.
examples.zh: 我们把「实体判决」与只处理一个程序问题的法院命令作了比较。

collocations: issue a judgment on the merits
read a judgment on the merits

words.enDefinition: A written statement by a court or judge explaining the legal reasoning or position in a case.

examples.en: The U.S. case reading uses a fictional judicial opinion to show how a court explains its reasoning.
examples.zh: 美国判例读物用虚构的「法院裁判意见」展示法院怎样阐述推理过程。

examples.en: We compared the judicial opinion with the case summary to check which statements came from the court itself.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「法院裁判意见」与案件摘要，核查哪些表述来自法院本身。

words.enDefinition: An earlier judicial decision that can provide authority or guidance on a legal issue in a later case.

examples.en: The common law exercise asks which judicial precedent the fictional court uses when explaining the applicable rule.
examples.zh: 普通法练习要求指出，虚构法院阐释适用规则时引用了哪项「司法先例」。

examples.en: Our reading notes identify a judicial precedent cited by both sides in the fictional dispute about local regulations.
examples.zh: 阅读笔记指出，在关于地方法规的虚构争议中，双方共同援引了一项「司法先例」。

words.zhGloss: 后续裁判对先例的处理
words.enDefinition: The way a later court refers to or deals with an earlier authority, such as following or distinguishing it.
acceptedZhAnswers: 后续裁判对先例的处理

examples.en: The research task asks us to compare judicial treatment of a precedent across two fictional appellate decisions.
examples.zh: 检索任务要求我们比较两项虚构上诉裁判中「后续裁判对先例的处理」有何不同。

examples.en: We used the research notes to record judicial treatment of a precedent separately from the original decision's outcome.
examples.zh: 我们用检索笔记分别记录「后续裁判对先例的处理」和原裁判的结果。

collocations: analyse judicial treatment of a precedent
compare judicial treatment of a precedent
track judicial treatment of a precedent

words.expression: jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim
words.lemma: jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim
words.enDefinition: Objection disputing a court’s authority to hear a civil claim
acceptedEnVariants: jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim

examples.en: The worksheet gives the jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim its own heading before discussing the facts.
examples.zh: 习题先将「民事管辖权异议」列为单独标题，再讨论案件事实。

examples.en: We read the fictional court's answer to the jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上阅读了虚构法院对「民事管辖权异议」的处理。

collocations: raise a jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim
issue in a jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim
decide a jurisdictional challenge in a civil claim

words.enDefinition: A defendant's legally recognized relinquishment of jury trial under applicable criminal court rules.

examples.en: The mock federal case file placed the jury trial waiver beside the order identifying the trial forum.
examples.zh: 模拟联邦卷宗将「放弃陪审团审判」记录列在指定审判方式的裁定旁。

examples.en: We located the jury trial waiver before comparing the roles assigned to the judge in both models.
examples.zh: 我们查到「放弃陪审团审判」记录后，比较两个示例中赋予法官的职责。

collocations: a jury trial waiver in a criminal case
a record of a jury trial waiver

words.enDefinition: Reduction in damages under English law reflecting the claimant's share of responsibility

examples.en: The English worksheet discusses a just and equitable reduction in the fictional compensation calculation.
examples.zh: 英格兰法习题在虚构赔偿计算中讨论「公正公平的减额」。

examples.en: We placed the just and equitable reduction after the assessment of responsibility in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上将「公正公平的减额」放在评估责任之后。

collocations: make a just and equitable reduction
consider a just and equitable reduction
basis for a just and equitable reduction

words.enDefinition: A defense treating the conduct as legally permitted in the circumstances under applicable law.

examples.en: The mock opinion classified one argument as a justification defense because it concerned the legal status of conduct.
examples.zh: 模拟判决把一项论点归为「正当化抗辩」，因为其关乎行为在法律上的性质。

examples.en: We compared the justification defense with a different basis for excusing responsibility in the classroom outline.
examples.zh: 我们把「正当化抗辩」与课堂提纲中另一种免除责任的依据作了比较。

collocations: the scope of a justification defense

words.enDefinition: Conduct accompanied by awareness of its nature or of circumstances specified in the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock opinion examined knowing conduct by asking what the fictional party was aware of at the time.
examples.zh: 模拟判决考察虚构当事人在当时知道哪些事实，以判断是否构成「明知而实施的行为」。

examples.en: We discussed knowing conduct separately from a desire to bring about the stated result in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在习题中，我们将「明知而实施的行为」与希望发生所述结果分开讨论。

words.enDefinition: A demonstrated tendency of a particular animal to behave dangerously that was known to the responsible person under the applicable rule.

examples.en: The hypothetical asks whether the keeper had notice of a known dangerous propensity mentioned in the prior record.
examples.zh: 假设案例要求判断饲养人先前是否获知档案所提到的「已知的危险倾向」。

examples.en: The casebook explains why a known dangerous propensity may matter under a rule covering a domestic animal.
examples.zh: 案例教材解释了「已知的危险倾向」为何可能对家养动物适用的规则有影响。

collocations: evidence of a known dangerous propensity
liability based on a known dangerous propensity

words.enDefinition: A risk actually known or reasonably ascertainable through the available knowledge when the legal duty arose.

examples.en: The warning claim exercise asks whether the available literature pointed to a known or knowable risk at distribution.
examples.zh: 警示责任练习讨论已有文献是否显示，在分销时存在「已知或可获知的风险」。

examples.en: In the California reading, the students compare a known or knowable risk with information learned much later.
examples.zh: 在阅读加州法律材料时，学生把「已知或可获知的风险」与很久之后才获得的信息相比。

collocations: evidence of a known or knowable risk
identify a known or knowable risk
warning about a known or knowable risk

words.enDefinition: Expiration of an offer after a stated or otherwise applicable period passes without acceptance.

examples.en: The seminar timeline showed lapse of an offer when the fictional proposal's stated response period ended.
examples.zh: 讨论课时间线显示，虚构提议的回复期限届满时发生了「要约失效」。

examples.en: We discussed lapse of an offer separately from a later message announcing the offeror's withdrawal.
examples.zh: 我们把「要约失效」与要约人后来发消息宣布撤回要约分开讨论。

collocations: the timing of lapse of an offer
distinguish lapse of an offer from withdrawal

words.enDefinition: An ambiguity that becomes apparent when otherwise clear wording is applied to external facts.

examples.en: The fictional room name appeared clear until two rooms shared it, revealing a latent ambiguity in the exercise.
examples.zh: 虚构地点名称原本看似明确，得知两间房同名后，习题里的「潜在歧义」才显现出来。

examples.en: We discussed latent ambiguity after connecting the apparently straightforward clause to the classroom map of the venue.
examples.zh: 我们将看似简单明了的条款与课堂场馆地图联系起来后，讨论了「潜在歧义」。

collocations: an example of a latent ambiguity

words.enDefinition: A danger that is not readily apparent to someone using or inspecting the premises in ordinary circumstances.

examples.en: The simulation identifies a latent hazard on the basis of what the visiting group could reasonably see.
examples.zh: 模拟案例以访客群体在合理情况下所能看见的范围为依据，认定了一处「隐蔽危险」。

examples.en: We compared witness descriptions before deciding whether to label the marked condition a latent hazard in class.
examples.zh: 我们比较了目击者的描述，然后讨论课堂上是否应将标出的状况称为「隐蔽危险」。

words.enDefinition: A reference identifying where a reported case appears in a series of law reports.

examples.en: We read the law report citation to find the report series and opening page of the assigned case.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「判例汇编引证」，查找指定判例所在的汇编系列及起始页。

examples.en: The worksheet lists the law report citation separately from the court's own reference for the case.
examples.zh: 练习单把「判例汇编引证」与法院为案件编定的编号分开列出。

collocations: components of a law report citation

words.enDefinition: A purpose or subject matter of an agreement permitted by the applicable law.

examples.en: The California classroom materials asked us to identify the lawful object of the fictional supply agreement.
examples.zh: 加利福尼亚州法课堂材料要求我们指出虚构供应协议的「合法的合同目的」。

examples.en: We discussed lawful object separately from whether both groups had agreed to the same terms in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「合法的合同目的」和双方是否同意同样的条款分开讨论。

collocations: the lawful object of an agreement
a requirement for a lawful object

words.enDefinition: A person entitled or permitted by law to enter premises under the rules being applied.

examples.en: The seminar asks whether a technician invited to the fictional studio was a lawful visitor.
examples.zh: 研讨课讨论获邀前往虚构工作室的技术员是不是「合法来访者」。

examples.en: The example in our English law text describes a ticket holder as a lawful visitor.
examples.zh: 我们的英格兰法教材把示例中持票的人称为「合法来访者」。

collocations: treat someone as a lawful visitor

words.enDefinition: English protection for confidential lawyer-client communications for obtaining or giving legal advice

examples.en: The fictional ruling addresses legal advice privilege for a confidential request for advice.
examples.zh: 虚构裁定讨论一项保密的咨询请求是否涉及「法律咨询保密特权」。

examples.en: We placed the communication under legal advice privilege on the classroom comparison chart.
examples.zh: 我们把这段沟通列在课堂对比图的「法律咨询保密特权」项下。

words.enDefinition: In consideration analysis, receipt of something to which the recipient was not already legally entitled.

examples.en: The American example used legal benefit to describe the promised service that the recipient could not otherwise demand.
examples.zh: 美国例题用「法律上的利益」描述一项约定服务，接受方原本无权要求该服务。

examples.en: We highlighted the legal benefit in the mock opinion by locating the new entitlement recognized by the court.
examples.zh: 我们找出模拟判决中裁判者认可的新权利，以标记「法律上的利益」。

collocations: a possible legal benefit to a party
a legal benefit in consideration analysis

words.enDefinition: The legal ability to enter a binding contract under the applicable rules.

examples.en: The instructor asked which facts mattered to legal capacity to contract in the fictional seminar problem.
examples.zh: 老师问，在讨论课的虚构题里，哪些事实与「缔约能力」有关。

examples.en: We treated legal capacity to contract as a separate issue from identifying the offer and acceptance.
examples.zh: 我们把「缔约能力」与识别要约、承诺分为不同问题。

collocations: an issue of legal capacity to contract

words.enDefinition: Legal attribution of a consequence after limits on responsibility have been considered

examples.en: The seminar addresses legal causation once the model answer has assumed factual causation.
examples.zh: 参考答案假定事实因果成立后，研讨课开始讨论「法律因果关系」。

examples.en: We highlighted the legal causation column in the worksheet's discussion of remoteness.
examples.zh: 我们在习题讨论损害过远性的部分高亮标出了「法律因果关系」一栏。

words.enDefinition: An act, forbearance, or promise restricting a legal freedom or undertaking something not already required.

examples.en: The American classroom opinion treated the promised surrender of a contractual right as a possible legal detriment.
examples.zh: 美国课堂判决示例把承诺放弃一项合同权利视为可能的「法律上的不利益」。

examples.en: We looked for a legal detriment in the exchanged promises rather than estimating the parties' financial losses.
examples.zh: 我们在互相交换的承诺中寻找「法律上的不利益」。

collocations: a legal detriment in an exchange

words.enDefinition: English and Welsh protection for qualifying legal communications or litigation materials

examples.en: The sample index marks legal professional privilege beside a category of legal communications.
examples.zh: 样本索引在一类法律沟通材料旁标出了「法律职业保密特权」。

examples.en: We compared two branches of legal professional privilege in the England and Wales seminar.
examples.zh: 我们在英格兰和威尔士程序研讨课上比较了「法律职业保密特权」的两个分支。

words.enDefinition: An agreement creating obligations recognized and enforceable under the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock judgment asked whether the parties' exchange created a legally binding agreement about the exhibition space.
examples.zh: 模拟判决考察双方的交流是否就展览场地形成了「有法律约束力的协议」。

examples.en: We contrasted a legally binding agreement with a tentative plan in the fictional student committee's messages.
examples.zh: 我们对比了虚构学生委员会消息中的「有法律约束力的协议」和暂定计划。

collocations: a legally binding agreement between parties

words.enDefinition: Legal power to make or enact rules of a specified kind, as conferred under a particular system.

examples.en: The constitutional diagram identifies which body has legislative authority over the subject in our fictional exercise.
examples.zh: 宪法示意图指出，在虚构练习中哪个机构对这个事项享有「立法权限」。

examples.en: Our model answer cites the constitutional provision that establishes legislative authority for the fictional national legislature.
examples.zh: 参考答案引用了确立虚构国家立法机关「立法权限」的宪法条款。

words.enDefinition: A formal committee report concerning proposed legislation, which may explain the proposal or record the committee's recommendation.

examples.en: The American library exercise asks us to find a legislative committee report associated with the fictional bill.
examples.zh: 美国图书馆练习要求我们找出与虚构议案有关的「立法委员会报告」。

examples.en: The tutor compared the legislative committee report with the statutory text the legislature eventually adopted for class.
examples.zh: 老师把「立法委员会报告」与立法机关最后通过、课堂正在学习的制定法文本作比较。

collocations: language in a legislative committee report

words.enDefinition: Materials generated during the process of making legislation, considered in legal research and sometimes in statutory interpretation.

examples.en: The American statutory interpretation seminar includes legislative history in a section on materials outside the enacted text.
examples.zh: 美国制定法解释研讨课在讨论制定文本之外的材料时，专设一节介绍「立法过程资料」。

examples.en: We reviewed the legislative history folder before discussing which documents our fictional court considered relevant.
examples.zh: 我们先浏览了「立法过程资料」文件夹，再讨论虚构法院认为哪些文件相关。

words.enDefinition: The intended meaning or objective attributed to a legislature when interpreting its enactment.

examples.en: The seminar asks how competing interpretations of legislative intent relate to the words of the fictional statute.
examples.zh: 研讨课询问，相互竞争的「立法意图」解读与虚构制定法的措辞如何关联。

examples.en: Our reading exercise underlines where the opinion describes legislative intent before explaining the court's chosen interpretation.
examples.zh: 阅读练习划出了裁判意见在解释法院所选读法前描述「立法意图」的位置。

words.enDefinition: A matter of legitimate interest to the public, relevant to certain US claims concerning public disclosure of private facts.

examples.en: The American privacy exercise asks whether the topic of the fictional report was a legitimate public concern.
examples.zh: 美国隐私法练习讨论虚构报道的主题是否属于「公众正当关切」。

examples.en: The discussion of legitimate public concern in the casebook looks at the relevance of the information published.
examples.zh: 案例教材讨论「公众正当关切」时，考察了所公布信息与报道主题的相关性。

words.enDefinition: A lesser offense whose required elements are contained in a greater offense under the applicable legal test.

examples.en: The American lesson compared the elements before identifying a lesser included offense in the fictional charge.
examples.zh: 美国课程先比较各项要件，再辨认虚构指控中「所包含的较轻犯罪」。

examples.en: We read the mock instruction on a lesser included offense alongside the diagram of overlapping elements.
examples.zh: 我们把模拟「所包含的较轻犯罪」指引与要件重合示意图放在一起阅读。

collocations: a charge involving a lesser included offense
a direction on a lesser included offense

words.expression: letter of acceptance for a study permit
words.lemma: letter of acceptance for a study permit
words.enDefinition: a letter from an educational institution confirming acceptance for study, used as evidence in the Canadian permit context
acceptedEnVariants: letter of acceptance for a study permit

examples.en: The specimen letter of acceptance for a study permit identifies the institution and intended program in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「学习许可用录取信」样张列出院校和拟读项目。

examples.en: We checked which institution issued the letter of acceptance for a study permit in the fictional admissions packet.
examples.zh: 我们核对虚构录取材料包中的「学习许可用录取信」由哪所院校签发。

collocations: verify a letter of acceptance for a study permit
institution issuing a letter of acceptance for a study permit
program named in a letter of acceptance for a study permit

words.enDefinition: a ceiling on the amount recoverable for specified liabilities under an agreement or legal rule

examples.en: The exercise compared the allowed claim with the liability cap written into the fictional agreement's schedule.
examples.zh: 练习将准许的请求额与虚构协议表中写明的「责任限额」作比较。

examples.en: We discussed whether one liability cap applied across all claims or separately to each claim in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论一项「责任限额」是适用于全部请求的合计金额，还是分别适用于每项请求。

words.enDefinition: Defamation communicated in writing or another sufficiently permanent form under the applicable law.

examples.en: The common law notes use a fictional printed newsletter to introduce the traditional category of libel.
examples.zh: 普通法笔记用一份虚构印刷简讯介绍「书面诽谤」这一传统分类。

examples.en: The tutorial asks how the medium of publication affects whether the allegation is analysed as libel.
examples.zh: 辅导课讨论传播媒介如何影响一项指控是否按「书面诽谤」分析。

words.enDefinition: In traditional common-law entrant classifications, a person privileged to enter or remain on land by the possessor's consent, typically outside the invitee category.

examples.en: The older common law chapter treats a social caller as a licensee under its entrant categories.
examples.zh: 这章较早时期的普通法材料把来串门的人归为「获准进入土地者」。

examples.en: The seminar explains why a person attending the family gathering might be classed as a licensee.
examples.zh: 研讨课解释了参加家庭聚会的人为什么可能被归为「获准进入土地者」。

collocations: classify a guest as a licensee

words.enDefinition: Chance that a particular risk will result in harm under the stated circumstances

examples.en: The worksheet assigns a different likelihood of harm to each invented scenario.
examples.zh: 习题给每个虚构情境设定不同的「损害发生的可能性」。

examples.en: We discussed the likelihood of harm using information available before the fictional event.
examples.zh: 我们依据虚构事件发生前已经掌握的信息讨论了「损害发生的可能性」。

words.enDefinition: a provision seeking to restrict the amount, scope or kinds of liability arising under an agreement

examples.en: The limitation of liability clause stated a maximum amount for certain claims in the fictional services contract.
examples.zh: 在虚构服务合同中，「责任限制条款」规定某些请求的最高责任金额。

examples.en: We checked whether the limitation of liability clause covered the particular obligation identified on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们核对「责任限制条款」是否涵盖课堂习题中指出的那项义务。

collocations: interpret a limitation of liability clause
enforce a limitation of liability clause
scope of a limitation of liability clause

words.expression: limitation period for a civil claim
words.lemma: limitation period for a civil claim
words.enDefinition: Period within which the applicable law generally allows a claim to begin
acceptedEnVariants: limitation period for a civil claim

examples.en: The worksheet uses fictional dates to illustrate a limitation period for a civil claim.
examples.zh: 习题用虚构日期说明「民事请求的时效期间」。

examples.en: We marked the limitation period for a civil claim on the timeline of the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们在假设案例的时间线上标出了「民事请求的时效期间」。

collocations: calculate the limitation period for a civil claim in a hypothetical
rules governing a limitation period for a civil claim
discuss a limitation period for a civil claim

words.zhGloss: 特定争议中的公众人物
words.enDefinition: A person treated as a public figure for a particular public controversy under US constitutional defamation law.
acceptedZhAnswers: 特定争议中的公众人物

examples.en: The American law seminar uses a fictional zoning debate to introduce the category of limited-purpose public figure.
examples.zh: 美国法律研讨课用一场虚构的分区规划争论介绍「特定争议中的公众人物」这一类别。

examples.en: Our example asks whether the claimant was a limited-purpose public figure in the controversy discussed by the newsletter.
examples.zh: 示例讨论原告是不是「特定争议中的公众人物」，所指的是简讯报道的那场争议。

collocations: classify a claimant as a limited-purpose public figure
status as a limited-purpose public figure

words.enDefinition: a term fixing an amount or formula payable for a specified breach, if enforceable under governing law

examples.en: The fictional liquidated damages clause used a daily amount tied to late completion of the specified work.
examples.zh: 虚构的「约定损害赔偿额条款」为指定工作迟延完工设置了按天计算的金额。

examples.en: We examined the liquidated damages clause under the legal test assigned in the English contract law seminar.
examples.zh: 我们依照英格兰合同法研讨课指定的法律检验标准，审查「约定损害赔偿额条款」。

collocations: amount under a liquidated damages clause

words.enDefinition: Record listing documents identified during civil disclosure under applicable rules

examples.en: The worksheet asks which entry in the list of documents for disclosure refers to the fictional invoice.
examples.zh: 习题问，「文书披露清单」中的哪一项指的是虚构发票。

examples.en: We compared the list of documents for disclosure with the separate statement describing the search.
examples.zh: 我们将「文书披露清单」与另行说明查找范围的声明作了比较。

collocations: read a list of documents for disclosure
entries in a list of documents for disclosure
attach a list of documents for disclosure

words.enDefinition: English protection for qualifying materials produced primarily for pending or reasonably contemplated litigation

examples.en: The worksheet asks why the fictional report might fall within litigation privilege.
examples.zh: 习题问，虚构报告为何可能属于「诉讼目的保密特权」的范围。

examples.en: We discussed litigation privilege with reference to the purpose stated in the fictional ruling.
examples.zh: 我们结合虚构裁定所述材料用途讨论了「诉讼目的保密特权」。

words.enDefinition: In English nuisance law, the principle that the character of the surrounding area can help determine what land use is acceptable.

examples.en: Our English law notes introduce the locality principle using two fictional streets with different patterns of use.
examples.zh: 英格兰法笔记用两条使用方式不同的虚构街道介绍「地段特征原则」。

examples.en: The locality principle is discussed after the tutor describes the surrounding shops and homes in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 老师介绍假设案例周边的店铺和住宅后，再讨论「地段特征原则」。

words.zhGloss: 毕业工签规则适用基准日
words.enDefinition: a reference date determined under the applicable Canadian post-graduation work permit rules for deciding which policy period applies
acceptedZhAnswers: 毕业工签规则适用基准日

examples.en: The worksheet uses a lock-in date for PGWP to identify which historical policy window governs the fictional case.
examples.zh: 习题用「毕业工签规则适用基准日」确定哪段历史政策适用于虚构案例。

examples.en: We compared the lock-in date for PGWP with the date on the fictional application receipt in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「毕业工签规则适用基准日」与虚构申请回执上的日期对照。

collocations: determine the lock-in date for PGWP
policy applicable on the lock-in date for PGWP
identify the lock-in date for PGWP

words.enDefinition: A formal descriptive title indicating the subject or purposes of an Act, particularly in UK legislation.

examples.en: Our exercise asks readers to compare the long title with the provisions of the fictional Act.
examples.zh: 练习要求读者将「法令长标题」与虚构法令的条款作比较。

examples.en: The long title on the sample Act describes its subject without listing every section in detail.
examples.zh: 样本法令上的「法令长标题」说明了法令主题，无须逐条详述。

words.expression: loss of a chance in negligence
words.lemma: loss of a chance in negligence
words.zhGloss: 过失侵权中的机会损失
words.enDefinition: Loss of a real chance of a benefit in certain negligence claims
acceptedZhAnswers: 过失侵权中的机会损失
acceptedEnVariants: loss of a chance in negligence

examples.en: The English law seminar considers loss of a chance in negligence in a fictional advice dispute.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课讨论虚构咨询纠纷中的「过失侵权中的机会损失」。

examples.en: In the worksheet, loss of a chance in negligence turns on whether a third party might have agreed.
examples.zh: 习题中的「过失侵权中的机会损失」取决于第三方原本是否可能同意。

collocations: claim for loss of a chance in negligence
value a loss of a chance in negligence
assess loss of a chance in negligence

words.enDefinition: Reduced ability to enjoy ordinary life or activities after an injury

examples.en: The English law chart treats loss of amenity as part of its nonfinancial category.
examples.zh: 英格兰法图表将「生活乐趣损失」归入非财产性类别。

examples.en: We discussed loss of amenity using an invented example that lists changes in activities.
examples.zh: 我们通过一个列出活动变化的虚构示例，讨论了「生活乐趣损失」。

collocations: distinction between pain and loss of amenity

words.enDefinition: the loss of value the injured party expected to receive from the contractual exchange

examples.en: The model judgment discusses loss of bargain by comparing what was promised with what the claimant actually received.
examples.zh: 示例判决比较合同承诺与请求人的实际所得，从而讨论「丧失合同利益」。

examples.en: We distinguished loss of bargain from an expense that the buyer incurred before either party performed.
examples.zh: 我们区分「丧失合同利益」与双方尚未履行时买方支出的一笔费用。

words.enDefinition: Reduced ability to earn money over time because of the relevant harm

examples.en: The seminar treats loss of earning capacity as a distinct issue from missed pay.
examples.zh: 研讨课将「劳动获利能力损失」这项问题与未获得的薪酬分开。

examples.en: We discussed loss of earning capacity through fictional assumptions about future work possibilities.
examples.zh: 我们用关于未来工作机会的虚构假设讨论了「劳动获利能力损失」。

collocations: damages for loss of earning capacity
compare loss of earning capacity with lost pay

words.enDefinition: Money the claimant would have earned but for the relevant harm

examples.en: The fictional table places missed pay in the loss of earnings column.
examples.zh: 虚构表格将未获得的薪酬放在「收入损失」一栏。

examples.en: We calculated loss of earnings from the two earnings totals supplied in class.
examples.zh: 我们根据课堂给出的两个收入总额计算了「收入损失」。

words.enDefinition: Harm from being unable to use an item for a period

examples.en: The hypothetical describes loss of use of property during the time the classroom model is unavailable.
examples.zh: 假设案例描述课堂模型无法使用期间的「财产使用损失」。

examples.en: We considered loss of use of property separately from the change in the item's value.
examples.zh: 我们将「财产使用损失」与物品价值的变化分开考察。

collocations: claim for loss of use of property
assess loss of use of property
period of loss of use of property

words.enDefinition: monetary compensation for sufficiently established profits that would have been earned absent the actionable breach

examples.en: The fictional claimant supported lost profit damages with sales records rather than relying only on projected revenue.
examples.zh: 虚构请求人以销售记录支持「利润损失赔偿」请求，并辅以对预期收入的说明。

examples.en: We subtracted the costs that would have been incurred before calculating the modeled lost profit damages in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在计算示例「利润损失赔偿」前，扣除了原本应发生的成本。

words.enDefinition: a seller who could and would have made both the breached sale and the later sale, so the later sale does not replace the lost transaction

examples.en: The retailer was a lost volume seller because it could and would have completed both sales.
examples.zh: 由于零售商有能力也本会完成两笔交易，因此属于「销量受损的卖方」。

examples.en: We classified the retailer as a lost volume seller after finding the second transaction would have happened anyway.
examples.zh: 在查明第二笔交易即使无违约也会发生之后，我们将零售商定为「销量受损的卖方」。

collocations: claim to be a lost volume seller

words.enDefinition: A court handling initial criminal proceedings and trying less serious offenses in England and Wales.

examples.en: The England and Wales worksheet marked the magistrates' court as the first forum in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 英格兰与威尔士课堂题把「治安法院」标为该虚构案件最初受理的法院。

examples.en: We compared the magistrates' court with the next court shown on the jurisdiction diagram in class.
examples.zh: 我们把「治安法院」与课堂管辖图中接下来列出的法院作了比较。

collocations: a hearing in a magistrates' court

words.enDefinition: The common law rule that a properly dispatched acceptance can take effect on dispatch where the rule applies.

examples.en: Our American common law exercise applied the mailbox rule to acceptance sent by ordinary post in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们的美国普通法习题将「邮寄承诺发信主义」用于假设案例中经普通邮寄发出的承诺。

examples.en: We compared the mailing and arrival dates before testing whether the mailbox rule mattered in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 我们比较寄出日期和到达日期，再看「邮寄承诺发信主义」是否影响虚构案例。

collocations: an exception to the mailbox rule
the timing under the mailbox rule

words.expression: maintenance funds for the Student route
words.lemma: maintenance funds for the student route
words.zhGloss: 英国学生类别生活资金
words.enDefinition: money considered for living expenses under the applicable UK Student route financial rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生类别生活资金
acceptedEnVariants: maintenance funds for the Student route

examples.en: The worksheet put maintenance funds for the Student route in a different column from planned course fees.
examples.zh: 习题把「英国学生类别生活资金」放在与拟定课程学费不同的栏。

examples.en: We identified the evidence category for maintenance funds for the Student route using the example financial statement.
examples.zh: 我们依据示例财务单辨认「英国学生类别生活资金」所属的证明类别。

collocations: evidence of maintenance funds for the Student route
verify maintenance funds for the Student route
requirements about maintenance funds for the Student route

words.enDefinition: An opinion whose reasoning is joined by a majority of the judges participating in the decision in question.

examples.en: The fictional court's majority opinion identifies the statutory provision that resolves the dispute about the permit.
examples.zh: 虚构法院的「多数意见」指出了解决许可争议所依据的制定法条款。

examples.en: We read the majority opinion first and then identified the judges who joined it in the mock case.
examples.zh: 在模拟案例中，我们先阅读「多数意见」，再找出赞同该意见的法官。

words.enDefinition: Wording that imposes an obligation rather than merely granting permission, as interpreted in context.

examples.en: Our drafting exercise asks which part of the fictional provision contains mandatory language imposing a duty.
examples.zh: 起草练习询问，虚构条文的哪个部分使用了设定义务的「强制性措辞」。

examples.en: The tutor compares mandatory language with wording that gives the fictional agency a choice under the statute.
examples.zh: 老师比较「强制性措辞」与允许虚构机构依据制定法自行选择的表述。

words.enDefinition: A minimum sentence that applicable law requires the court to impose when the specified conditions are met.

examples.en: The American exercise marked a mandatory minimum sentence as a statutory limit in the fictional sentencing materials.
examples.zh: 美国习题在虚构量刑材料中把「强制性最低刑」标为法定限制。

examples.en: We identified the mandatory minimum sentence provision before reading the classroom estimate of the guideline range.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「强制性最低刑」条文，再看课堂估算的指南量刑范围。

collocations: a statute providing a mandatory minimum sentence

words.enDefinition: Words or conduct that outwardly indicate agreement to a proposed bargain.

examples.en: The fictional opinion treated the reply as a manifestation of assent to the quoted proposal.
examples.zh: 虚构判决意见将这条回复视为接受所引提议的「同意的外在表示」。

examples.en: We discussed whether returning the marked form amounted to a manifestation of assent in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在课堂案例中，交回标记过的表格是否构成「同意的外在表示」。

words.enDefinition: Sequence or mechanism through which the relevant harm actually comes about

examples.en: The hypothetical distinguishes the manner of occurrence from the general kind of damage involved.
examples.zh: 假设案例区分了损害的「发生方式」和所涉损坏的一般类别。

examples.en: We noted the unusual manner of occurrence while considering whether the type was foreseeable.
examples.zh: 我们在分析损害种类是否可预见时，注意到了不同寻常的「发生方式」。

words.enDefinition: how a contractual duty must be carried out under the agreement

examples.en: The annex specified the manner of performance by requiring the contractor's files in a particular format.
examples.zh: 附件要求承包方按固定格式提供文件，由此规定「履行方式」。

examples.en: The fictional dispute concerned the manner of performance even though both sides agreed on the deadline.
examples.zh: 在虚构争议中，双方对截止日期没有分歧，争议集中在「履行方式」。

collocations: dispute over the manner of performance

words.enDefinition: damages based on a comparison between contract price and market price at the time and place specified by governing law

examples.en: The model market damages calculation used a market quotation from the date required by the New York rule.
examples.zh: 示例的「市价差额赔偿」计算采用纽约州规则规定日期的市场报价。

examples.en: We compared market damages with the result based on a replacement purchase in the fictional sales problem.
examples.zh: 在虚构买卖例题中，我们将「市价差额赔偿」与按替代采购计算的结果比较。

words.enDefinition: An additional term substantial enough to prevent its automatic inclusion in a merchant contract under UCC rules.

examples.en: The New York exercise asked whether an added clause constituted a material alteration under the UCC.
examples.zh: 纽约州习题问，增订条款是否构成「UCC 下的重大变更」。

examples.en: We separated minor wording changes from a possible material alteration under the UCC in the fictional exchange.
examples.zh: 在虚构交流中，我们区分了细小措辞变动与可能的「UCC 下的重大变更」。

collocations: consider a material alteration under the UCC
a possible material alteration under the UCC
identify a material alteration under the UCC

words.enDefinition: More than minimal contribution to the damage that actually occurred

examples.en: The English law chart uses material contribution to damage for harm produced through cumulative effects.
examples.zh: 英格兰法图表用「对损害的实质性促成」解释多个因素累积造成的损害。

examples.en: We distinguished material contribution to damage from merely making the fictional outcome more likely.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「对损害的实质性促成」和仅提高虚构结果发生的可能性。

collocations: establish a material contribution to damage

words.zhGloss: 对裁判有实质影响的案情
words.enDefinition: Facts significant to how a court frames or decides a legal issue in a case.
acceptedZhAnswers: 对裁判有实质影响的案情

examples.en: The writing exercise asks students to identify the material facts of a case from the fictional witness accounts.
examples.zh: 写作练习要求学生从虚构证人记述中找出「对裁判有实质影响的案情」。

examples.en: The professor notes that the material facts of a case may differ depending on the issue being discussed.
examples.zh: 教授提醒我们，讨论的问题不同，「对裁判有实质影响的案情」也可能不同。

collocations: identify the material facts of a case
summarise the material facts of a case
compare the material facts of a case

words.enDefinition: Significant rise in risk used for causation only in exceptional English cases

examples.en: The English law seminar labels material increase in risk as an exceptional doctrine on its chart.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课在图中将「风险的实质性增加」标为一项例外规则。

examples.en: We compared material increase in risk with an actual contribution to the stated harm.
examples.zh: 我们将「风险的实质性增加」与对所述损害实际产生的作用作了比较。

collocations: identify a material increase in risk
exceptional material increase in risk doctrine
discuss a material increase in risk

words.zhGloss: 不同措辞含义有别规则
words.enDefinition: An interpretive canon under which variations in wording within related statutory provisions may suggest a difference in meaning.
acceptedZhAnswers: 不同措辞含义有别规则

examples.en: The class applies the meaningful variation canon to two fictional sections that use different terms for the applicant.
examples.zh: 全班把「不同措辞含义有别规则」用于两项对申请人采用不同称呼的虚构条文。

examples.en: Our exercise asks whether the meaningful variation canon supports a different reading of the later provision.
examples.zh: 练习询问，「不同措辞含义有别规则」是否支持对后一条文的不同理解。

collocations: example of the meaningful variation canon

words.enDefinition: Rule or basis for quantifying compensation for an established negligence loss

examples.en: The exercise compares two methods before selecting the measure of damages in negligence for its fictional loss.
examples.zh: 练习先比较两种方法，再为虚构损失选择「过失赔偿的计算标准」。

examples.en: We discussed the measure of damages in negligence after agreeing which losses belonged in the analysis.
examples.zh: 我们确定了哪些损失应纳入分析后，讨论「过失赔偿的计算标准」。

collocations: identify the measure of damages in negligence
apply the measure of damages in negligence
determine the measure of damages in negligence

words.enDefinition: Private meeting between the mediator and one side during mediation

examples.en: The mediator in our role-play held a mediation caucus with the supplier's team.
examples.zh: 角色扮演中的调解员与供应商团队进行了「调解中的单方会谈」。

examples.en: A mediation caucus appears halfway through the simulation, after both sides have met together.
examples.zh: 模拟情境进行到一半时，双方共同会面后安排了「调解中的单方会谈」。

words.enDefinition: Protection of mediation communications from disclosure under applicable rules and exceptions

examples.en: Our seminar compared two courts' written rules on mediation confidentiality without assuming they matched.
examples.zh: 研讨课比较了两家法院关于「调解保密性」的书面规则，并没有预设两者相同。

examples.en: The sample mediation agreement explains how mediation confidentiality applies to notes from private discussions.
examples.zh: 示例调解协议解释了「调解保密性」如何适用于单方会谈的笔记。

words.enDefinition: Principle that a mediator facilitates discussion without favoring a party

examples.en: The ethics exercise on mediator neutrality asked us to identify when personal ties mattered.
examples.zh: 关于「调解员中立性」的伦理练习让我们辨别哪些情况下个人关系会产生影响。

examples.en: The instructor discussed mediator neutrality after a student asked whether facilitators choose a winner.
examples.zh: 一位学生问调解员会不会选出胜方，老师随后讲解了「调解员中立性」。

words.enDefinition: a rule under which specified applicants must provide an immigration medical examination as part of the applicable process

examples.en: The Canadian eligibility exercise indicates whether a medical examination requirement applies in each of two fictional cases.
examples.zh: 加拿大资格练习指出，两项虚构案例各自是否适用「移民体检要求」。

examples.en: We marked the medical examination requirement in the assigned guidance without evaluating anyone's health in the example.
examples.zh: 我们在指定指南上标出「移民体检要求」，示例中未对任何人的健康作评估。

collocations: medical examination requirement for an application
scope of a medical examination requirement
rule imposing a medical examination requirement

words.enDefinition: The mental element required by criminal law for the offense or a particular element.

examples.en: The classroom opinion examined mens rea by asking whether the fictional statute required knowledge of the circumstance.
examples.zh: 课堂判决通过追问虚构法规是否要求明知相关情形，分析了「犯罪的主观要件」。

examples.en: We read the paragraph about mens rea to see whether knowledge or intent was required.
examples.zh: 我们阅读关于「犯罪的主观要件」的一段，查看条文要求明知还是故意。

collocations: the mens rea of an offense

words.enDefinition: A question about an offer or possible changes that does not itself propose replacing the original bargain.

examples.en: The mock judge read the question about another time as a mere inquiry about the initial proposal.
examples.zh: 模拟裁判者把有关其他时间的问句理解为针对最初提议的「单纯询问」。

examples.en: We highlighted the tentative wording that made the message a mere inquiry in the English law exercise.
examples.zh: 在英格兰合同法练习中，我们高亮了使该消息成为「单纯询问」的试探性措辞。

collocations: classify a reply as a mere inquiry
distinguish a mere inquiry from a counteroffer

words.enDefinition: a failure to perform that does not go to the root of the bargain under the applicable legal rules

examples.en: The assignment discusses a minor breach of contract involving a discrepancy that did not defeat the agreement's purpose.
examples.zh: 作业讨论了一项「轻微违约」，涉及一处未使合同目的落空的小出入。

examples.en: We compared minor breach of contract with a serious breach while considering whether termination was available in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们对照「轻微违约」与严重违约，同时讨论能否终止合同。

collocations: allege a minor breach of contract
remedy for a minor breach of contract
damages for a minor breach of contract

words.enDefinition: A limited departure from an assigned work activity, potentially still treated as within the scope of employment.

examples.en: In our hypothetical, both groups agreed that the driver's stop was a minor detour from the assigned route.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中，两组都认为司机停车属于相对指派路线的「轻微偏离职务」。

examples.en: The American casebook uses a minor detour to contrast short incidental stops with entirely personal trips.
examples.zh: 美国案例教材用「轻微偏离职务」区分附带的短暂停留与纯粹的私人出行。

collocations: classify a stop as a minor detour
minor detour from an assigned route

words.enDefinition: The traditional common law principle that acceptance must agree to the offer's terms without changing them.

examples.en: The mirror image rule mattered in the classroom case because the reply changed a term about payment.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，回复改动了一项付款条款，因此涉及「镜像规则」。

examples.en: We compared the mirror image rule with the separate goods rule summarized in the United States materials.
examples.zh: 我们将「镜像规则」与美国资料中概述的货物买卖专项规则作了比较。

collocations: an exception to the mirror image rule

words.enDefinition: An interpretation approach from English law that considers the problem the earlier law failed to address and the Act was meant to remedy.

examples.en: The English legal history class uses the mischief rule to ask what gap the fictional statute addressed.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律史课运用「弊端规则」，探讨虚构制定法填补了什么漏洞。

examples.en: Our casebook presents the mischief rule before comparing it with modern approaches to statutory purpose in class.
examples.zh: 案例教材先介绍「弊端规则」，再将其与课堂学习的当代法条目的解释方法相比较。

words.enDefinition: A United States criminal offense in a lower classification than a felony under the applicable law.

examples.en: The classroom table placed the fictional misdemeanor in the category specified by that state's statute.
examples.zh: 课堂表格按题设州法规，把虚构的「轻罪」放入规定类别。

examples.en: We compared the misdemeanor label with the higher category used in the American mock case.
examples.zh: 我们把「轻罪」标签与美国模拟案件中使用的较高等级作比较。

collocations: classify an offense as a misdemeanor

words.enDefinition: An ending of a criminal trial without a valid final determination on the affected charge.

examples.en: The mock record noted a mistrial in a criminal case after the jurors reported no agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟卷宗记载，陪审员报告未能达成一致后，法庭宣布此次「刑事审判无效」。

examples.en: We distinguished a mistrial in a criminal case from a verdict of not guilty in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题中区分了「刑事审判无效」与无罪裁决。

collocations: declare a mistrial in a criminal case
a ruling on a mistrial in a criminal case
an issue involving a mistrial in a criminal case

words.enDefinition: A claim in England and Wales involving a reasonable expectation of privacy and weighing privacy rights against freedom of expression.

examples.en: The English privacy seminar lists misuse of private information separately from defamation in the fictional press dispute.
examples.zh: 英格兰隐私法研讨课在虚构媒体争议中分开列明了「不当使用私人信息」和诽谤。

examples.en: The textbook's example of misuse of private information shows how the court frames the competing interests.
examples.zh: 教材关于「不当使用私人信息」的例子展示了法院如何表述互相冲突的利益。

collocations: claim for misuse of private information

words.enDefinition: A consideration that can support a less severe sentence under the applicable rules.

examples.en: The tutor asked which stated consideration the hypothetical treated as a mitigating factor at sentencing.
examples.zh: 辅导老师问，假设案例把给出的哪一项考量视为「量刑减轻因素」。

examples.en: We matched each mitigating factor at sentencing with its description in the mock decision read in class.
examples.zh: 我们把各项「量刑减轻因素」与课堂所读模拟裁定中的对应描述配对。

collocations: identify a mitigating factor at sentencing
discuss a mitigating factor at sentencing
a finding of a mitigating factor at sentencing

words.enDefinition: reasonable steps to limit loss from breach, relevant to what damages are recoverable under the governing rules

examples.en: The class considered mitigation of contractual loss after the fictional buyer found comparable goods at another supplier.
examples.zh: 虚构买方从另一家供应方找到相当货物后，全班讨论了「减轻合同损失」。

examples.en: We distinguished reasonable steps for mitigation of contractual loss from steps that would have imposed disproportionate expense.
examples.zh: 我们区分为「减轻合同损失」采取的合理措施与会造成不相称开支的措施。

collocations: take steps for mitigation of contractual loss

words.enDefinition: Principle that compensation may exclude loss reasonably avoidable after the wrong

examples.en: The English law worksheet discusses mitigation of loss in negligence after the initial fictional damage.
examples.zh: 英格兰法习题在最初的虚构损坏之后讨论「过失侵权中的减损」。

examples.en: We kept mitigation of loss in negligence separate from decisions made before the hypothetical event.
examples.zh: 我们将「过失侵权中的减损」与假设事件之前作出的决定分开。

collocations: assess mitigation of loss in negligence
issues of mitigation of loss in negligence
role of mitigation of loss in negligence

words.enDefinition: A means, such as words or conduct, by which an offeree signifies acceptance.

examples.en: The class compared the mode of acceptance described in the model offer with the recipient's actual reply.
examples.zh: 我们把示例要约所述的「承诺方式」与收件人的实际回复作了对照。

examples.en: The New York goods exercise asked what mode of acceptance the fictional exchange reasonably invited.
examples.zh: 纽约州货物买卖习题问，虚构交流可以合理理解为允许哪一种「承诺方式」。

collocations: identify a permitted mode of acceptance
the mode of acceptance stated in an offer

words.enDefinition: Framework reducing compensation for claimant fault and blocking it at a statutory threshold

examples.en: The Ohio exercise uses modified comparative negligence to illustrate a limit on partial recovery.
examples.zh: 俄亥俄州法律练习通过「修正比较过失」说明部分获赔的界限。

examples.en: We marked the separate cutoff question for modified comparative negligence on the state comparison chart.
examples.zh: 我们在各州对比图表上单独标出了「修正比较过失」的获赔界限问题。

words.expression: motion to dismiss a civil complaint
words.lemma: motion to dismiss a civil complaint
words.zhGloss: 驳回民事起诉状的动议
words.enDefinition: US request for dismissal of a pleading on a recognized procedural ground
acceptedZhAnswers: 驳回民事起诉状的动议
acceptedEnVariants: motion to dismiss a civil complaint

examples.en: The mock federal docket shows a motion to dismiss a civil complaint before the disputed documents are exchanged.
examples.zh: 模拟联邦法院卷宗显示，在交换争议文件之前，出现了一项「驳回民事起诉状的动议」。

examples.en: We identified the stated basis for a motion to dismiss a civil complaint in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题中找出了「驳回民事起诉状的动议」所列的理由。

collocations: consider a motion to dismiss a civil complaint
grounds for a motion to dismiss a civil complaint
decision on a motion to dismiss a civil complaint

words.enDefinition: Several causes each independently enough to produce the same harm

examples.en: The worksheet presents multiple sufficient causes that would each produce the same modeled damage.
examples.zh: 习题列出了「多个充分原因」，其中任一个都足以造成同样的模型损坏。

examples.en: We discussed multiple sufficient causes after the ordinary counterfactual question became difficult to apply.
examples.zh: 通常的反事实问题难以适用时，我们讨论了「多个充分原因」。

words.enDefinition: Agreement of the parties to the same bargain, as shown by their words or conduct.

examples.en: The seminar found evidence of mutual assent in the two messages accepting the same exhibition date.
examples.zh: 讨论课从两条都接受同一展览日期的消息中找到了「双方合意」的证据。

examples.en: We asked whether mutual assent existed when the fictional groups had discussed different versions of the proposal.
examples.zh: 虚构的两个小组讨论的是不同版本的提议，我们于是考察是否存在「双方合意」。

words.enDefinition: In United States contract law, a shared mistaken belief about a basic assumption underlying the agreement.

examples.en: The American classroom case illustrated mutual mistake when both fictional parties were wrong about the same existing fact.
examples.zh: 美国课堂案例中，虚构双方都误以为同一项既存事实属实，以此说明「双方共同错误」。

examples.en: We checked the parties' messages for evidence of mutual mistake in the fictional agreement about the exhibit materials.
examples.zh: 我们查看双方的来往消息，在关于展品材料的虚构协议中寻找「双方共同错误」的证据。

collocations: a claim based on mutual mistake

words.enDefinition: In a contract based on exchanged promises, the requirement that the promises actually bind the parties or that another basis for enforceability exists.

examples.en: The American case study questioned mutuality of obligation because one fictional group appeared free to do nothing.
examples.zh: 美国案例题质疑双方是否存在「义务相互约束」，因为虚构的一组似乎可以完全不作为。

examples.en: We traced both promises before discussing mutuality of obligation in the seminar's fictional agreement about exhibition supplies.
examples.zh: 讨论课分析虚构展览物资协议的「义务相互约束」前，我们先追踪双方各自的承诺。

collocations: an issue of mutuality of obligation
an argument about mutuality of obligation

words.expression: named learning institution on a permit
words.lemma: named learning institution on a permit
words.zhGloss: 许可上列明的学习机构
words.enDefinition: the educational institution specifically identified in a particular Canadian study permit
acceptedZhAnswers: 许可上列明的学习机构
acceptedEnVariants: named learning institution on a permit

examples.en: The named learning institution on a permit can be identified from the school entry on the classroom specimen.
examples.zh: 可从课堂样张的学校条目，辨认「许可上列明的学习机构」。

examples.en: We compared the named learning institution on a permit with the school listed in a new fictional offer.
examples.zh: 我们将「许可上列明的学习机构」与新虚构录取通知所列的学校对照。

collocations: check the named learning institution on a permit
change the named learning institution on a permit
record the named learning institution on a permit

words.zhGloss: 澳海外学生教育国家规范
words.enDefinition: Australia's national standards for registered providers of education and training to overseas students, made under the ESOS framework
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳海外学生教育国家规范

examples.en: The worksheet cites the National Code for overseas students beside a fictional example of provider transfer.
examples.zh: 习题在虚构机构转学示例旁引述「澳海外学生教育国家规范」。

examples.en: We looked up the National Code for overseas students headings before comparing the two sample institutional policies.
examples.zh: 我们在比较两项院校样例政策前，先查阅「澳海外学生教育国家规范」的标题。

collocations: standard in the National Code for overseas students
requirements of the National Code for overseas students
compliance with the National Code for overseas students

words.enDefinition: Factor without which the loss would not have occurred as it did

examples.en: The worksheet asks whether the omission was a necessary condition for the loss in the fictional scenario.
examples.zh: 习题问，在虚构情境中，不作为是否为「损失发生的必要条件」。

examples.en: We read the timeline before identifying a necessary condition for the loss on the case chart.
examples.zh: 我们先查看时间线，再在案例图上确定一个「损失发生的必要条件」。

collocations: identify a necessary condition for the loss
find a necessary condition for the loss
test a necessary condition for the loss

words.enDefinition: A UK parliamentary procedure allowing a statutory instrument to stand unless annulled under the applicable procedure.
