examples.zh: 我们在关于开示范围的联邦程序习题中标出了「证据开示的比例原则」问题。

words.enDefinition: The prosecution's provision of case material to the defense as required by the governing criminal procedure.

examples.en: The England and Wales lesson placed prosecution disclosure in the preparations section of the mock case file.
examples.zh: 英格兰与威尔士课程将「控方披露」列在模拟卷宗的审判准备章节。

examples.en: We read the prosecution disclosure heading to see which procedural stage the classroom record described.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「控方披露」标题，确定课堂记录描述的是哪个程序阶段。

words.enDefinition: The prosecution's initial presentation of evidence to prove its charges at a criminal trial.

examples.en: The classroom timeline marked the end of the prosecution's case-in-chief before the next trial stage began.
examples.zh: 课堂时间线在下一个审理阶段开始前标出了「控方的主要举证阶段」结束的位置。

examples.en: The judge addressed the disputed count after the prosecution's case-in-chief ended in the mock federal trial.
examples.zh: 在模拟联邦审判中，「控方的主要举证阶段」结束后，法官处理了有争议的指控项。

collocations: the end of the prosecution's case-in-chief

words.enDefinition: In UK legislative databases, a provision shown in the text without having come into force at the displayed point.

examples.en: The website labels the prospective provision separately, and our example asks students to explain that status.
examples.zh: 网站单独标出「尚待生效的条文」，示例要求学生解释这一状态。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which prospective provision was printed but had no commencement date in the displayed text.
examples.zh: 练习单询问，所显示文本中哪项「尚待生效的条文」已经列出但尚无生效日期。

collocations: bring a prospective provision into force
check the status of a prospective provision

words.enDefinition: Order limiting discovery or its use for reasons recognized by the rules

examples.en: The mock court issues a protective order in discovery concerning the use of one record.
examples.zh: 模拟法院针对一份记录的使用发布了一项「证据开示保护令」。

examples.en: We highlighted which material the protective order in discovery covered in the fictional ruling.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构裁定中标出了「证据开示保护令」涵盖哪些材料。

collocations: issue a protective order in discovery
scope of a protective order in discovery
read a protective order in discovery

words.enDefinition: Aim used to identify the risks a particular duty guards against

examples.en: The English law exercise explains the protective purpose of a duty before grouping the losses.
examples.zh: 英格兰法练习先解释「义务的保护目的」，再给各项损失分组。

examples.en: We linked the protective purpose of a duty to the adviser’s assigned task in the fictional problem.
examples.zh: 我们把「义务的保护目的」与题设中交给虚构顾问的任务联系起来。

collocations: identify the protective purpose of a duty
examine the protective purpose of a duty
harm within the protective purpose of a duty

words.zhGloss: 教育机构未履行供课义务
words.enDefinition: under Australia's overseas education framework, a provider's failure to start an agreed course or cessation of delivery before completion in qualifying circumstances
acceptedZhAnswers: 教育机构未履行供课义务

examples.en: The Australian classroom scenario describes provider default after a fictional course ceased being delivered before completion.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚课堂案例中，虚构的课程在完成前停止提供，构成「教育机构未履行供课义务」。

examples.en: We read the provider default section before marking the institutional event on the timeline in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂时间线上标注教育机构的事件前，我们先阅读了有关「教育机构未履行供课义务」的部分。

words.enDefinition: a rule limiting transfers between registered Australian providers within a specified stage of an overseas student's study

examples.en: The classroom example asks which course stage the provider transfer restriction refers to in the fictional timeline.
examples.zh: 课堂示例问，「转学限制」涉及虚构时间线中的哪个课程阶段。

examples.en: The excerpt helped distinguish a provider transfer restriction from ordinary admission rules at the receiving college.
examples.zh: 我们用官方节选区分「转学限制」与接收学院的一般入学规则。

collocations: scope of a provider transfer restriction
exception to a provider transfer restriction

words.enDefinition: US concept limiting attribution of harm to legally sufficient causal connections

examples.en: The American law worksheet asks about proximate cause after asking what actually happened.
examples.zh: 美国法律习题问过实际发生了什么之后，再询问「近因」。

examples.en: We treated proximate cause as a jurisdiction-dependent concept in the comparative law chart.
examples.zh: 我们在比较法图中将「近因」视为因司法辖区而异的概念。

words.enDefinition: A legally sufficient connection between conduct and a result for attribution under applicable criminal law.

examples.en: The American worksheet discussed proximate cause in criminal law after treating factual causation as established in the problem.
examples.zh: 美国习题先假定题设已经证明事实因果关系，再讨论「刑法上的近因」。

examples.en: We considered proximate cause in criminal law when the mock opinion treated the causal chain as disputed.
examples.zh: 模拟判决认为因果链存在争议时，我们考察了「刑法上的近因」。

collocations: analyze proximate cause in criminal law
an issue about proximate cause in criminal law
discuss proximate cause in criminal law

words.zhGloss: 过失法上的关系接近性
words.enDefinition: Sufficient closeness of relationship relevant to recognizing a duty of care
acceptedZhAnswers: 过失法上的关系接近性

examples.en: The seminar considers proximity in negligence by comparing the parties' relationships in two fictional cases.
examples.zh: 研讨课通过比较两个虚构案例中的当事人关系来讨论「过失法上的关系接近性」。

examples.en: We annotated the facts bearing on proximity in negligence in the English law exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在英格兰法练习中标出了影响「过失法上的关系接近性」的事实。

collocations: facts relevant to proximity in negligence

words.enDefinition: The period during which a public body accepts comments from the public on a proposal, such as a proposed regulation.

examples.en: The fictional agency notice specifies a public comment period on the first page of the reading packet.
examples.zh: 虚构机构公报在阅读资料第一页规定了「公开意见征询期」。

examples.en: The rulemaking timeline shows where the public comment period falls between publication of the proposal and agency review.
examples.zh: 制定规则的时间线显示，「公开意见征询期」处于发布提案和机构审查之间的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: A US privacy tort concerning publicity given to private facts when the applicable legal requirements, including limits tied to public concern, are satisfied.

examples.en: The class matched public disclosure of private facts with the stipulated publication in a fictional case summary.
examples.zh: 全班将「公开披露私密事实」和虚构案例摘要中双方约定的公开行为对应起来。

examples.en: Our American privacy worksheet separates public disclosure of private facts from issues about statements alleged to be false.
examples.zh: 美国隐私法练习单把「公开披露私密事实」和有关陈述被指不实的问题分开。

collocations: claim for public disclosure of private facts
allege public disclosure of private facts
elements of public disclosure of private facts

words.enDefinition: In traditional common-law entrant classifications, someone invited to enter land as a member of the public for a designated public purpose.

examples.en: The old entrant categories illustrate public invitee status using a visitor to a fictional public library.
examples.zh: 旧有的进入者分类用虚构公共图书馆的访客来说明「受邀公众来访者」的身份。

examples.en: In the hypothetical, Rina was a public invitee while attending an exhibition expressly open to everyone.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中，里娜参观一场明确向所有人开放的展览时，属于「受邀公众来访者」。

collocations: classify someone as a public invitee
duties owed to a public invitee

words.enDefinition: A number identifying an enacted US federal public law by Congress and its sequence within that Congress.

examples.en: The library instructor asks us to locate the public law number on a sample American legislative document.
examples.zh: 图书馆讲师要求我们在一份美国立法文书样本上找出「美国联邦公法编号」。

examples.en: The public law number and the code citation appear in different places on the classroom reference card.
examples.zh: 课堂参考卡上的「美国联邦公法编号」和法典引文出现在不同位置。

words.enDefinition: An actionable interference with a right held by the public or a significant part of the community.

examples.en: The American torts reading introduces public nuisance through a hypothetical involving access to a shared public space.
examples.zh: 美国侵权法读物通过一个涉及公共空间通行的假设案例介绍「公共滋扰」。

examples.en: We compared public nuisance with a dispute limited to two neighbouring landholders in the second classroom example.
examples.zh: 在第二个课堂示例中，我们把「公共滋扰」与仅限两位相邻土地占有人的争议作比较。

words.enDefinition: In US constitutional defamation law, someone whose government role may subject a claim about official conduct to a particular standard.

examples.en: The American casebook asks how a public official would be classified when suing over statements about official duties.
examples.zh: 美国案例教材询问，「公职人员」针对有关其履职的陈述提起诉讼时该怎样归类。

examples.en: Our tutorial considers whether the fictional claimant is a public official for purposes of American defamation law.
examples.zh: 辅导课讨论，就美国诽谤法而言，虚构原告是否属于「公职人员」。

collocations: defamation claim by a public official
classify someone as a public official

words.enDefinition: An argument against enforcement because the agreement conflicts with a recognized legal public policy.

examples.en: The mock American judgment discussed a public policy defense before deciding whether the fictional promise was enforceable.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决先考察「公共政策抗辩」，再判断法院能否认定虚构承诺可强制执行。

examples.en: We read the stated policy before analyzing the public policy defense in the seminar's fictional contract problem.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读指出的公共政策，再分析讨论课虚构合同题里的「公共政策抗辩」。

collocations: a public policy defense to enforcement

words.zhGloss: 公私院校课程授权安排
words.enDefinition: an arrangement in which a private institution delivers a public institution's curriculum under licence, relevant to certain Canadian immigration rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 公私院校课程授权安排

examples.en: The case notes describe a public-private curriculum licensing arrangement between two fictional Canadian postsecondary institutions.
examples.zh: 案例注释描述虚构的两所加拿大高等教育院校之间的「公私院校课程授权安排」。

examples.en: We compared the public-private curriculum licensing arrangement with study delivered directly by the public institution in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「公私院校课程授权安排」与由公立院校直接授课的情形作比较。

collocations: identify a public-private curriculum licensing arrangement
program under a public-private curriculum licensing arrangement
effect of a public-private curriculum licensing arrangement

words.expression: publication on a matter of public interest
words.lemma: publication on a matter of public interest
words.zhGloss: 就公共利益事项发表内容
words.enDefinition: A defence under the Defamation Act 2013 subject to a public-interest subject matter and reasonably believing that publishing was in the public interest.
acceptedZhAnswers: 就公共利益事项发表内容
acceptedEnVariants: publication on a matter of public interest

examples.en: The English statute worksheet lists publication on a matter of public interest as a separate defence to consider.
examples.zh: 英格兰法条练习单将「就公共利益事项发表内容」列为单独考虑的一项抗辩。

examples.en: Our lesson on publication on a matter of public interest examines what the fictional editor reasonably believed.
examples.zh: 关于「就公共利益事项发表内容」的课程探讨了虚构编辑当时有理由相信什么。

collocations: defence of publication on a matter of public interest
requirements for publication on a matter of public interest
argue publication on a matter of public interest

words.enDefinition: Communication of the material to someone other than the person it concerns, as understood in defamation law.

examples.en: The lecturer uses a fictional email to explain publication to a third party in the defamation exercise.
examples.zh: 老师用一封虚构邮件说明诽谤法练习中「向第三人传播」的含义。

examples.en: The file asks whether one other person read the statement, which could establish publication to a third party.
examples.zh: 案卷询问是否有另一人读过该陈述，这一点可能证明存在「向第三人传播」。

collocations: establish publication to a third party
evidence of publication to a third party
requirement of publication to a third party

words.enDefinition: Rule reducing compensation by claimant fault without a cutoff based on its percentage

examples.en: The Washington law worksheet models pure comparative negligence with a fictional allocation of fault.
examples.zh: 华盛顿州法律习题用虚构的过失分摊来说明「纯粹比较过失」。

examples.en: We used pure comparative negligence in one tab of the classroom comparison chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂对比表的一栏采用「纯粹比较过失」规则。

words.enDefinition: Financial loss independent of injury to the claimant or their property

examples.en: The English law worksheet describes pure economic loss after a fictional valuation proves inaccurate.
examples.zh: 英格兰法习题介绍一份虚构估价不准确后出现的「纯经济损失」。

examples.en: We separated pure economic loss from spending to repair the model's damaged surface.
examples.zh: 我们将「纯经济损失」与修复模型受损表面所花的费用分开分析。

collocations: limits on recovery for pure economic loss

words.enDefinition: Failure to act or confer a benefit without creating the underlying danger

examples.en: The English exercise classifies a failure to help as a pure omission on these facts.
examples.zh: 英格兰法练习依题设事实，将未伸出援手归为「单纯不作为」。

examples.en: We distinguished the pure omission issue from conduct that changed the fictional situation.
examples.zh: 我们将「单纯不作为」问题与改变虚构情境的行为作了区分。

words.enDefinition: Conduct undertaken with a conscious objective to act or achieve a specified result under the stated legal model.

examples.en: The American model treated purposeful conduct as action directed toward the person's own stated objective.
examples.zh: 美国示例把为实现当事人所述目标而采取的行为归为「有目的的行为」。

examples.en: We noted purposeful conduct in the worksheet's table of mental states used in the fictional statute.
examples.zh: 我们在习题列出的虚构法规所用心理状态表中，标出了「有目的的行为」。

words.enDefinition: The aims that the applicable law asks a court to consider when selecting a sentence.

examples.en: The England and Wales worksheet listed the purposes of sentencing in its assigned extract from the statute.
examples.zh: 英格兰与威尔士习题在指定法规节选中列出了「量刑目的」。

examples.en: We compared two stated purposes of sentencing before reading the fictional judge's explanation of the outcome.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两项明确的「量刑目的」，再读虚构法官对结果的解释。

collocations: a provision on the purposes of sentencing

words.enDefinition: An approach that interprets a legal text in light of the purpose of the relevant provision or legislation.

examples.en: The fictional judgment uses purposive interpretation to relate the disputed wording to the statutory scheme as a whole.
examples.zh: 虚构判决运用「目的解释」，把争议措辞放在整个立法制度安排中理解。

examples.en: Our seminar compares purposive interpretation with another reading that focuses on the words in their immediate context.
examples.zh: 研讨课把「目的解释」与侧重措辞紧邻上下文的另一种读法作比较。

words.enDefinition: Protection for certain communications that applies only if the relevant legal conditions remain satisfied and can be defeated in specified circumstances.

examples.en: The seminar compares qualified privilege in defamation with the protection given to statements in certain judicial proceedings.
examples.zh: 研讨课比较了「诽谤中的有限特权」和某些司法程序中陈述享有的保护。

examples.en: The California mock problem includes an argument about qualified privilege in defamation for one fictional internal message.
examples.zh: 加州模拟题包含对一则虚构内部消息是否享有「诽谤中的有限特权」的论证。

collocations: scope of qualified privilege in defamation

words.enDefinition: a claim for reasonable payment for work or services in settings recognized by governing law

examples.en: The seminar discussed quantum meruit after the fictional provider completed work whose price was still in dispute.
examples.zh: 虚构服务提供者完成工作但价款仍有争议后，研讨课讨论了「合理报酬请求」。

examples.en: We considered the value of services already supplied when reading the hypothetical quantum meruit claim in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读假设的「合理报酬请求」时，考虑了已提供服务的价值。

collocations: value of services under quantum meruit

words.zhGloss: 本法院首次遇到的法律问题
words.enDefinition: A legal question the relevant court or jurisdiction has not decided before.
acceptedZhAnswers: 本法院首次遇到的法律问题

examples.en: The fictional opinion describes a question of first impression arising under a newly enacted local statute.
examples.zh: 虚构裁判意见称，一项新制定的地方法规引出了「本法院首次遇到的法律问题」。

examples.en: Our case brief explains why the dispute raised a question of first impression for that particular court.
examples.zh: 判例简报解释，为什么在该特定法院看来，这项争议引出了「本法院首次遇到的法律问题」。

collocations: present a question of first impression
decide a question of first impression
address a question of first impression

words.enDefinition: Later confirmation of a prior agreement by someone whom the law permits to adopt or reject it.

examples.en: The fictional opinion discussed ratification of a contract after the person later confirmed an earlier agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构判决在当事人后来确认先前的协议后，讨论了「合同追认」问题。

examples.en: We separated ratification of a contract from the original signature on the timeline of the classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例的时间线上，我们把「合同追认」与最初的签署分开标出。

collocations: an act of ratification of a contract
evidence of ratification of a contract

words.enDefinition: The legal reason or principle necessary to the result of a common-law decision, which can have precedential effect.

examples.en: Our common law seminar asks which legal principle forms the ratio decidendi of the fictional appeal.
examples.zh: 普通法研讨课询问，哪项法律原则构成虚构上诉中「判决的必要理由」。

examples.en: The worksheet separates the ratio decidendi from the court's discussion of an issue unnecessary to the result.
examples.zh: 练习单把「判决的必要理由」和法院对不影响结果之问题的讨论分开。

words.expression: read the contract as a whole
words.lemma: read the contract as a whole
words.enDefinition: To interpret a provision in relation to the rest of the contract rather than in isolation.
acceptedEnVariants: read the contract as a whole

examples.en: The tutor asked us to read the contract as a whole before assigning meaning to one sentence.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我们先「整体解读合同」，再判断某句话的含义。

examples.en: We had to read the contract as a whole in the fictional disagreement about the shared room.
examples.zh: 在这道关于共用房间的虚构争议题里，我们需要「整体解读合同」。

collocations: read the contract as a whole before construing a clause
invited to read the contract as a whole
asked to read the contract as a whole

words.enDefinition: Degree of caution a reasonable person would exercise in comparable circumstances

examples.en: The fictional agreement says nothing about what reasonable care would entail in the circumstances.
examples.zh: 虚构协议没有说明在该情境下怎样才算尽到「合理注意」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks whether the actions in the example met the test of reasonable care.
examples.zh: 习题问，例子中的行为是否达到了「合理注意」的标准。

words.enDefinition: An expectation of privacy that the law regards as objectively justified in the circumstances.

examples.en: The English seminar asks whether the fictional letter's author had a reasonable expectation of privacy.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课询问，这封虚构信件的作者是否有「合理隐私期待」。

examples.en: Our reading examines the setting and nature of the communication before discussing a reasonable expectation of privacy.
examples.zh: 阅读材料先审视沟通的场合和性质，再讨论「合理隐私期待」。

collocations: have a reasonable expectation of privacy
demonstrate a reasonable expectation of privacy
assess a reasonable expectation of privacy

words.enDefinition: Ability to anticipate the relevant kind of harm from the known circumstances

examples.en: The fictional judgment considers reasonable foreseeability of harm after identifying the alleged kind of damage.
examples.zh: 虚构判决先确定所称损坏的类别，再考察「损害的合理可预见性」。

examples.en: We discussed reasonable foreseeability of harm using only the information available before the hypothesized event.
examples.zh: 我们仅依据假设事件之前可以掌握的信息讨论「损害的合理可预见性」。

collocations: limits of reasonable foreseeability of harm

words.enDefinition: An examination for hazards that meets the level of care reasonably expected in the circumstances.

examples.en: The fictional audit log provides a starting point for discussing reasonable inspection of premises before opening.
examples.zh: 虚构的检查日志为讨论开门前「对场所的合理检查」提供了起点。

examples.en: Our class compared the notices and dates when assessing reasonable inspection of premises in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 在评估假设案例中是否有「对场所的合理检查」时，我们比较了告示和日期。

collocations: conduct a reasonable inspection of premises
duty to make a reasonable inspection of premises
evidence of reasonable inspection of premises

words.enDefinition: Justified cost incurred in reasonable efforts to reduce further loss

examples.en: The worksheet labels one fictional expenditure as a reasonable mitigation expense in the example.
examples.zh: 习题将示例中一笔虚构开支标为「合理减损费用」。

examples.en: We considered a reasonable mitigation expense separately from the amount of damage avoided.
examples.zh: 我们将「合理减损费用」与避免的损失数额分开考察。

words.enDefinition: Benchmark comparing conduct with that expected of a reasonable person in similar circumstances

examples.en: We used the reasonable person standard to assess the fictional organizer’s response to a warning.
examples.zh: 我们用「理性人标准」评估虚构组织者收到警示后的反应。

examples.en: The model answer applies the reasonable person standard using facts known at the time.
examples.zh: 参考答案用当时已知的事实来应用「理性人标准」。

words.zhGloss: 合同法中的理性人标准
words.enDefinition: An objective benchmark asking what a reasonable person in the parties' circumstances would understand from the relevant words or conduct.
acceptedZhAnswers: 合同法中的理性人标准

examples.en: The seminar used the reasonable person standard for contracts to assess what the fictional reply reasonably communicated.
examples.zh: 讨论课用「合同法中的理性人标准」，评估虚构回复可以合理理解为传达了什么。

examples.en: We applied the reasonable person standard for contracts using only the circumstances supplied in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们仅依据课堂练习给出的情形，运用「合同法中的理性人标准」。

collocations: apply the reasonable person standard for contracts
consider the reasonable person standard for contracts
a classroom example of the reasonable person standard for contracts

words.enDefinition: Step a reasonable person would take to reduce a relevant risk

examples.en: The class considers whether an extra check qualified as a reasonable precaution in the problem.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论在题设中，多核对一次是否属于「合理防范措施」。

examples.en: We compared the cost and usefulness of one reasonable precaution in the model answer.
examples.zh: 我们在参考答案中比较了一项「合理防范措施」的成本与作用。

words.enDefinition: Hypothetical practitioner exercising the care and skill ordinarily expected in the relevant field

examples.en: The class asks what a reasonable professional would have done with the same information.
examples.zh: 课堂问，拥有相同信息的「合理谨慎的专业人员」会怎样做。

examples.en: We compared the fictional adviser’s report with one expected from a reasonable professional.
examples.zh: 我们把虚构顾问的报告与对「合理谨慎的专业人员」的预期报告作了比较。

collocations: what a reasonable professional would do

words.enDefinition: Justified dependence on another's conduct or statement relevant to a negligence duty

examples.en: The seminar considers reasonable reliance in negligence after the fictional organizer follows the adviser's written estimate.
examples.zh: 在虚构组织者采纳顾问的书面估计后，研讨课讨论是否存在「过失法上的合理信赖」。

examples.en: We marked the facts bearing on reasonable reliance in negligence in the hypothetical report dispute.
examples.zh: 我们在假设的报告纠纷中标出了影响「过失法上的合理信赖」的事实。

collocations: facts showing reasonable reliance in negligence
role of reasonable reliance in negligence

words.enDefinition: Justified expense incurred in restoring property after legally attributable damage

examples.en: The case chart lists reasonable repair costs for restoring the fictional classroom model.
examples.zh: 案例图表列出了修复虚构课堂模型的「合理维修费用」。

examples.en: We discussed reasonable repair costs after comparing two invented estimates in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂比较了两份虚构报价后讨论「合理维修费用」。

words.enDefinition: A way of using a product that someone in the relevant legal position could reasonably anticipate.

examples.en: The seminar discusses reasonably foreseeable use by comparing the product notes with classroom observations of an imaginary item.
examples.zh: 研讨课把某件虚构物品的产品说明和课堂观察记录作对照，以讨论「可合理预见的使用」。

examples.en: The outline identifies reasonably foreseeable use as one issue raised by the sample description and recorded user behaviour.
examples.zh: 提纲把「可合理预见的使用」列为样品描述和所记录用户行为引出的问题之一。

words.enDefinition: A rule under which an acceptance takes effect when received rather than when sent.

examples.en: The fictional problem used a receipt rule to compare when an immediate message was sent and received.
examples.zh: 虚构题目采用「承诺到达主义」，比较一条即时消息的发送和接收时间。

examples.en: We discussed the receipt rule after the English law worksheet specified when the telex message reached its recipient.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题说明电传消息何时到达收件人后，我们讨论了「承诺到达主义」。

collocations: the effective time under a receipt rule

words.enDefinition: Court acceptance of the legal effect of an award made in arbitration

examples.en: The treaty exercise asks which paragraph discusses recognition of an arbitral award by another country's courts.
examples.zh: 条约练习要求找出哪一段讨论另一国法院「承认仲裁裁决」。

examples.en: The diagram places recognition of an arbitral award in a separate box from steps to enforce payment.
examples.zh: 示意图把「承认仲裁裁决」和强制付款的程序分框表示。

collocations: seek recognition of an arbitral award
judicial recognition of an arbitral award
refuse recognition of an arbitral award

words.enDefinition: Established relationship or situation in which courts already recognize a care duty

examples.en: The English law worksheet starts by asking whether a recognized duty category covers the scenario.
examples.zh: 英格兰法习题首先问，情境是否落在一个「既有义务类型」内。

examples.en: We matched the fictional relationship to a recognized duty category in the class chart.
examples.zh: 我们把虚构关系与课堂图中的一个「既有义务类型」配对。

words.enDefinition: A statutory protection limiting some landowner liability for recreational use of land, subject to the jurisdiction's conditions and exceptions.

examples.en: The California course pack includes a separate excerpt on recreational use immunity and its statutory exceptions.
examples.zh: 加州课程材料单列了一段关于「娱乐用途责任豁免」及其法定例外的摘录。

examples.en: Our fictional trail dispute illustrates why recreational use immunity is discussed separately from questions about land ownership.
examples.zh: 虚构步道争议说明了为何会把「娱乐用途责任豁免」与土地所有权问题分开讨论。

words.enDefinition: permission recorded under US student rules for a qualifying student to take less than the normally required workload
acceptedEnVariants: authorisation for a reduced course load

examples.en: The fictional record labels reduced course load authorization as a separate entry for the term in question.
examples.zh: 虚构记录将「减修课业授权」列为涉事学期的一项单独条目。

examples.en: The class distinguished reduced course load authorization from a student's unrecorded decision to take fewer classes.
examples.zh: 全班区分「减修课业授权」和学生自己决定少选课但未获得记录授权的情形。

collocations: scope of reduced course load authorization

words.enDefinition: A link between the statement and the claimant that readers or listeners can recognise, with or without a name.

examples.en: The fictional post uses initials, and the class considers whether they make a reference to the claimant.
examples.zh: 虚构帖子使用了姓名首字母，全班讨论这些字母能否构成「对原告的指涉」。

examples.en: Our answer discusses reference to the claimant separately from what the disputed statement was taken to mean.
examples.zh: 我们的答案把「对原告的指涉」和对争议陈述含义的理解分开讨论。

collocations: show a reference to the claimant

words.enDefinition: A failure to give property back after a request by a person entitled to possess it, potentially relevant to conversion.

examples.en: In the class problem, the parties disagree over whether the fictional letter showed a refusal to return property.
examples.zh: 在课堂题目里，双方就是否能从虚构信件看出「拒绝返还财产」意见不一。

examples.en: Our reading considers refusal to return property in a case where the borrower originally held it lawfully.
examples.zh: 阅读材料讨论了一起借用人原先合法持有财产、后来「拒绝返还财产」的案例。

collocations: evidence of refusal to return property

words.enDefinition: a course registered for delivery by a listed Australian provider to overseas students under the applicable framework

examples.en: The policy example labels the diploma as a registered course associated with the institution in the official register.
examples.zh: 政策示例将该文凭项目标为官方名录中与该院校对应的「澳大利亚登记课程」。

examples.en: We read the provider name before checking which registered course appeared in the fictional student's study file.
examples.zh: 我们先读取教育机构名称，再核对虚构学生学习档案所列的「澳大利亚登记课程」。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚注册教育机构
words.enDefinition: an education provider entered on the applicable Australian register for the delivery of courses to overseas students
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚注册教育机构

examples.en: The fictional university is the registered education provider named at the top of the classroom register extract.
examples.zh: 虚构大学就是课堂名录节选顶部列出的「澳大利亚注册教育机构」。

examples.en: We identified the registered education provider before looking at the codes of its registered courses in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们先找出「澳大利亚注册教育机构」，再查看其已注册课程的代码。

collocations: course with a registered education provider
obligations of a registered education provider

words.enDefinition: a routine break in a Canadian institution's academic calendar, relevant to some student immigration and work conditions

examples.en: The class marked the regularly scheduled break on the school's sample calendar between two study periods.
examples.zh: 全班在该校样例日历的两个学习时段之间标出了「校历常规假期」。

examples.en: We used the regularly scheduled break to explain why the fictional timetable contained weeks without classes.
examples.zh: 我们用「校历常规假期」解释虚构时间表为何列出几周没有课的时段。

collocations: dates of a regularly scheduled break

words.enDefinition: An offeree's communication declining the offered bargain.

examples.en: The worksheet treated the words of the fictional recipient as a clear rejection of an offer.
examples.zh: 习题把虚构收件人的这番话视为明确「拒绝要约」。

examples.en: We distinguished rejection of an offer from a question about a second possible delivery date in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「拒绝要约」和询问是否可采用另一个交付日期。

collocations: a clear rejection of an offer

words.enDefinition: a buyer's refusal to accept goods that do not meet contractual requirements when rejection is legally available

examples.en: The fictional example treats rejection of nonconforming goods as an issue before the buyer has accepted the shipment.
examples.zh: 虚构示例把「拒收不合约货物」作为买方接受该批货物之前要讨论的问题。

examples.en: We separated rejection of nonconforming goods from the remedies discussed after acceptance in the New York sales exercise.
examples.zh: 纽约州买卖法练习中，我们区分「拒收不合约货物」与接受货物之后讨论的救济。

collocations: notice of rejection of nonconforming goods

words.enDefinition: Financial loss resulting from harm to another person or their property

examples.en: The fictional organizer loses booking income after someone else's display breaks, illustrating relational economic loss.
examples.zh: 虚构组织者在他人的展品损坏后失去预订收入，这是「关系性经济损失」的例子。

examples.en: We distinguished relational economic loss from damage to the claimant's own property in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题中区分了「关系性经济损失」与原告自己财物受损。

words.enDefinition: A relationship sufficiently similar to employment to satisfy the relationship stage of vicarious liability in England and Wales.

examples.en: The English case summary asks whether the organisation and the individual had a relationship akin to employment.
examples.zh: 英格兰案例摘要询问，该机构和个人之间是否存在「类似雇佣的关系」。

examples.en: The tutor discussed a relationship akin to employment after reviewing the duties in our fictional volunteer programme.
examples.zh: 老师查看了虚构志愿者计划中的职责后，讨论了「类似雇佣的关系」。

collocations: establish a relationship akin to employment
identify a relationship akin to employment
facts suggesting a relationship akin to employment

words.enDefinition: Comparative degree to which each person's conduct deserves fault or criticism

examples.en: The English law exercise considers relative blameworthiness alongside the strength of each cause.
examples.zh: 英格兰法练习既考察「相对可责性」，也考察各原因的致损作用。

examples.en: We discussed relative blameworthiness before considering the figure suggested in the fictional judgment.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「相对可责性」，再考察虚构判决提出的数值。

words.enDefinition: an Australian education provider's agreement to let an overseas student transfer under the relevant provider transfer rules

examples.en: The teaching example lists a release from a registered provider between the original course and the new provider.
examples.zh: 教学示例在原课程与新教育机构之间列出「原注册机构同意转学」。

examples.en: We identified the release from a registered provider and then read the separate offer from the new provider.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「原注册机构同意转学」的记录，再阅读新机构单独发出的录取通知。

collocations: grant release from a registered provider
decision on release from a registered provider
condition for release from a registered provider

words.enDefinition: a legally effective surrender of specified claims arising under or connected with a contract

examples.en: We read the release of contractual claims to see which disputed invoices were listed in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「放弃合同请求权」的文件，查看练习中列出了哪些有争议的发票。

examples.en: The hypothetical agreement contains a limited release of contractual claims covering only the earlier delivery issue.
examples.zh: 假设协议中「放弃合同请求权」的范围有限，仅覆盖先前的交付问题。

collocations: execute a release of contractual claims
scope of a release of contractual claims
interpret a release of contractual claims

words.enDefinition: In United States usage, release based on a personal promise to appear rather than an upfront financial deposit.

examples.en: The American classroom glossary placed release on recognizance under release decisions in the fictional court record.
examples.zh: 美国课堂术语表把「具结释放」列在虚构案件卷宗的释放决定一栏。

examples.en: We matched release on recognizance to the example that described a promise to appear later.
examples.zh: 我们把「具结释放」与描述承诺日后出庭的例子对应起来。

collocations: release on recognizance in a criminal case

words.enDefinition: Connection by which information affects the probability of a material fact

examples.en: The federal example examines relevance of evidence in relation to one disputed date.
examples.zh: 联邦程序示例针对一个有争议的日期考察「证据相关性」。

examples.en: We discussed the relevance of evidence before considering other grounds for exclusion.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「证据相关性」，再讨论其他可能的排除理由。

collocations: relevance of evidence to an issue

words.enDefinition: money aimed at compensating losses incurred by relying on the contract, subject to the governing rules

examples.en: The hypothetical claim for reliance damages included preparation expenses tied to the agreement that the supplier later broke.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中，「信赖利益损害赔偿」请求包含与供应方后来违反的协议有关的筹备费用。

examples.en: We separated reliance damages from the predicted profits that would have followed full performance in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「信赖利益损害赔偿」和练习中完全履行后本可获得的预期利润区分开。

words.enDefinition: the interest in being restored to the position one would have occupied without relying on the contract

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates the reliance interest with expenses the fictional claimant would have avoided without the agreement.
examples.zh: 习题用虚构请求人如果没有信赖该协议本可避免的费用，说明「信赖利益」。

examples.en: We compared the reliance interest with the value of the performance promised by the hypothetical supplier in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「信赖利益」与假设供应方承诺履行的价值作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Continuing to occupy or stay on land once the applicable permission to be there has expired or been withdrawn.

examples.en: The facts list remaining after permission ends as a distinct issue alongside the original authorised visit.
examples.zh: 案情把「许可终止后继续停留」列为与最初获准到访并列的独立问题。

examples.en: In class we discussed how remaining after permission ends is different from an entry that was initially unauthorised.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论了「许可终止后继续停留」与起初就未获授权的进入有何不同。

collocations: allegation of remaining after permission ends
liability for remaining after permission ends
question about remaining after permission ends

words.enDefinition: In England and Wales, to order that a defendant be held in custody pending further proceedings.

examples.en: The fictional England and Wales docket recorded a decision to remand in custody before the next hearing.
examples.zh: 英格兰与威尔士的虚构案件登记表记载了下一次听证前「还押候审」的决定。

examples.en: We read the words remand in custody on the mock document's line about the next court date.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟文件中有关下一次开庭日期的一行读到「还押候审」。

collocations: an order to remand in custody
a decision to remand in custody
the meaning of remand in custody

words.enDefinition: the limitation that excludes contractual losses too remote under the applicable tests of responsibility and foreseeability

examples.en: The case note addressed remoteness of contractual loss separately from whether the breach caused the loss.
examples.zh: 案例注释将「合同损失过远性」与违约事实上是否造成损失分别讨论。

examples.en: We read the English judgment's discussion of remoteness of contractual loss after identifying the parties' agreement and circumstances.
examples.zh: 我们先梳理当事人的约定和相关情形，再阅读英格兰判决中关于「合同损失过远性」的论述。

collocations: test for remoteness of contractual loss
rule on remoteness of contractual loss

words.enDefinition: English negligence limit generally excluding unforeseeable kinds of harm

examples.en: We discussed remoteness of damage by listing the different kinds of loss in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们列出假设情境中不同类别的损失，以讨论「损害过远性」。

examples.en: The English seminar addresses remoteness of damage separately from whether the breach caused the loss.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课将「损害过远性」与义务违反是否造成损失分开讨论。

words.enDefinition: return of money paid before performance when required by the agreement, a remedy or the applicable law

examples.en: The fictional buyer sought repayment of an advance after the seller failed to supply the listed items.
examples.zh: 卖方未交付课堂例题列出的物品后，虚构买方请求「返还预付款」。

examples.en: We checked the timing of repayment of an advance against the dates given in the model settlement.
examples.zh: 我们将「返还预付款」的时间与示例和解协议给出的日期相核对。

collocations: terms for repayment of an advance

words.enDefinition: To remove a statutory provision's legal force through another enactment or recognised legislative act.

examples.en: The fictional legislature voted to repeal a statutory provision that had appeared in the old chapter.
examples.zh: 虚构立法机关投票决定「废止制定法条款」，这项条款原见于旧的一章。

examples.en: The outline asks which part of the new Act would repeal a statutory provision cited in the exercise.
examples.zh: 提纲询问，新法令的哪个部分将「废止制定法条款」，所指是练习引用的那一条。

collocations: vote to repeal a statutory provision
enact legislation to repeal a statutory provision

words.enDefinition: under applicable UK consumer law, performing a service again as necessary to bring it into conformity with the contract

examples.en: The class examined repeat performance of a service as one statutory response in the fictional UK consumer example.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「重新提供服务」作为虚构英国消费者案例中的一项法定应对方式分析。

examples.en: We compared repeat performance of a service with a reduction of the agreed price in the assigned reading.
examples.zh: 我们在指定阅读中，将「重新提供服务」与减少约定价款作对比。

collocations: request repeat performance of a service
provide repeat performance of a service
conditions for repeat performance of a service

words.enDefinition: under English law, a breach serious enough, or of a term classified as a condition, to entitle the other party to terminate

examples.en: The English exercise asked whether losing nearly the entire expected benefit amounted to repudiatory breach.
examples.zh: 英格兰法例题问，几乎完全失去预期合同利益，是否属于「根本性违约」。

examples.en: We distinguished repudiatory breach from the innocent party's later election in the fictional contract dispute.
examples.zh: 在虚构合同争议中，我们区分了「根本性违约」与守约方随后作出的选择。

words.enDefinition: Damage to how others regard a person or organisation, distinct from hurt feelings alone.

examples.en: The fictional witness statements help the class discuss possible reputational harm after the club newsletter was circulated.
examples.zh: 虚构证人陈述帮助全班讨论社团简讯传阅后可能发生的「名誉损害」。

examples.en: The worksheet on reputational harm asks which facts show a change in how others regarded the claimant.
examples.zh: 关于「名誉损害」的练习单询问，哪些事实表明他人对原告的看法发生了变化。

words.enDefinition: Federal discovery request asking another party to admit specified matters

examples.en: The mock request for admission asks about a particular date in the case file.
examples.zh: 模拟「事项承认请求」涉及案卷中的一个特定日期。

examples.en: We separated the request for admission from the request for records in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上把「事项承认请求」与要求提供记录的请求分开。

collocations: scope of a request for admission
response to a request for admission

words.enDefinition: Federal discovery request seeking specified documents, electronic information, or tangible items

examples.en: The fictional request for production lists several records from the mock contract dispute.
examples.zh: 虚构的「文件或物品出示请求」列出模拟合同纠纷中的几份记录。

examples.en: We distinguished a request for production from a list of written questions in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上区分了「文件或物品出示请求」与一组书面问题。

collocations: respond to a request for production
document identified in a request for production

words.zhGloss: 第19条要求加入的当事人
words.enDefinition: Person required to be joined if feasible under federal Rule 19 criteria
acceptedZhAnswers: 第19条要求加入的当事人

examples.en: The federal class asks whether the fictional owner is a required party under Rule 19.
examples.zh: 联邦法律课堂问，虚构所有人是否属于「第19条要求加入的当事人」。

examples.en: We marked the required party under Rule 19 on the diagram outside the original party group.
examples.zh: 我们将「第19条要求加入的当事人」标在图中原当事人组之外。

collocations: identify a required party under Rule 19
discuss a required party under Rule 19
whether someone is a required party under Rule 19

words.enDefinition: Doctrine allowing circumstances to support an inference of negligence in suitable cases

examples.en: The tutor introduces res ipsa loquitur through a fictional problem about a damaged display.
examples.zh: 老师通过一个展品损坏的虚构题设来介绍「事实自证过失」。

examples.en: We discussed why res ipsa loquitur involves reasoning from the circumstances of the event.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「事实自证过失」需要依据事件情境来推理。

words.enDefinition: A judgment delivered after the court has taken time following the hearing to consider its decision.

examples.en: The mock court schedule shows a reserved judgment listed for release several weeks after the fictional hearing.
examples.zh: 模拟法院日程显示，一份「庭后另行作出的判决」定于虚构庭审结束数周后公布。

examples.en: The English seminar contrasts a reserved judgment with one delivered orally at the hearing in the sample.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课比较「庭后另行作出的判决」和示例中当庭口头宣布的判决。

words.enDefinition: A doctrine in US law making an employer liable for certain wrongful acts by an employee within the scope of employment.

examples.en: The American torts casebook introduces respondeat superior in a chapter about liability arising from workplace activities.
examples.zh: 美国侵权法案例教材在讲解源于工作活动的责任一章介绍了「雇主替代责任原则」。

examples.en: Our exercise uses respondeat superior to organise the facts about the clerk's assigned duties in the fictional shop.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中按「雇主替代责任原则」梳理了虚构商店中店员受指派工作的事实。

words.zhGloss: 负责任的专业人士群体
words.enDefinition: Group of competent practitioners whose accepted views support a professional approach
acceptedZhAnswers: 负责任的专业人士群体

examples.en: The seminar asks what counts as a responsible body of professional opinion under the English standard.
examples.zh: 研讨课问，依英格兰法标准，什么才算「负责任的专业人士群体」。

examples.en: The hypothetical answer distinguishes a responsible body of professional opinion from an isolated professional view.
examples.zh: 假设案例的参考答案区分了「负责任的专业人士群体」和个别专业人士的意见。

collocations: consider a responsible body of professional opinion
support from a responsible body of professional opinion
identify a responsible body of professional opinion

words.enDefinition: a remedy following breach that restores a benefit conferred or its value when the applicable legal requirements are satisfied

examples.en: The fictional buyer requested restitution for breach to recover a payment made before the promised work was abandoned.
examples.zh: 虚构买方请求「违约后的返还救济」，以收回承诺工作被放弃前已支付的款项。

examples.en: The exercise considered restitution for breach separately from a demand for the profits expected under the agreement.
examples.zh: 练习将「违约后的返还救济」与请求合同预期利润分别考虑。

words.enDefinition: the interest in recovering the value of benefits one has conferred on another in connection with the agreement

examples.en: The professor used the restitution interest to focus on the value transferred to the other fictional party.
examples.zh: 老师通过「返还利益」，让学生关注给到虚构对方当事人的价值。

examples.en: We identified the restitution interest by tracing which party received the advance in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们通过追踪练习中哪一方收到了预付款，明确了「返还利益」。

collocations: recovery based on the restitution interest

words.enDefinition: the conditions that must be met to be considered for restoration of lost temporary resident status in Canada

examples.en: The lesson compares restoration eligibility for two fictional situations described in the Canadian course notes.
examples.zh: 课程比较加拿大课堂讲义中两个虚构情形的「身份恢复资格」。

examples.en: We checked which facts were relevant to restoration eligibility before reading the hypothetical outcomes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，在阅读假设结果之前，我们先核对哪些事实与「身份恢复资格」相关。

words.enDefinition: The part of an offense definition requiring a specified consequence of the conduct.

examples.en: The fictional statute included a result element requiring the court to consider a consequence separately.
examples.zh: 虚构法规包含一项「结果要件」，要求法院单独考察相应后果。

examples.en: We circled the result element in the assigned extract before reading the court's analysis of causation.
examples.zh: 阅读法院对因果关系的分析之前，我们先圈出指定节选中的「结果要件」。

collocations: an offense with a result element

words.enDefinition: A seller that sells products directly to final buyers rather than selling for resale.

examples.en: The discussion asks which business was the retail seller of the imaginary desk timer and who assembled it.
examples.zh: 讨论要求弄清哪家企业是虚构桌面计时器的「零售卖方」，以及由谁组装。

examples.en: The fictional retail seller retained an invoice recording the model and the date of the sale.
examples.zh: 虚构的「零售卖方」留存了一份注明型号和出售日期的发票。

words.enDefinition: Authority over land, premises, or work that a party keeps after giving another party some rights or responsibilities.

examples.en: The mock lease clause on retained control covers the stairwell shared by three fictional tenants.
examples.zh: 模拟租赁合同中关于「保留的控制权」的条款涉及三名虚构租客共用的楼梯间。

examples.en: During the tutorial, we identified which terms might show retained control after the units were let.
examples.zh: 在辅导课上，我们辨认了房间出租后哪些条款可能表明存在「保留的控制权」。

words.enDefinition: A withdrawal of an earlier statement, which can have consequences in defamation law under applicable rules.

examples.en: The fictional editor's retraction of a statement appears in the case packet alongside the original magazine article.
examples.zh: 虚构编辑的「撤回陈述」声明与原杂志文章一起出现在案例材料中。

examples.en: The remedies exercise asks how retraction of a statement might affect the issues raised in the mock dispute.
examples.zh: 救济练习询问，「撤回陈述」可能怎样影响模拟争议中提出的问题。

collocations: publish a retraction of a statement
effect of retraction of a statement

words.enDefinition: withdrawal of a prior anticipatory repudiation before the applicable legal limits prevent withdrawal

examples.en: The New York problem considers retraction of repudiation after a seller reverses an earlier written refusal.
examples.zh: 卖方推翻先前的书面拒绝后，纽约州例题讨论了「撤回拒绝履行」。

examples.en: We read the position of the retraction of repudiation on the fictional timeline alongside the buyer's response.
examples.zh: 我们查看「撤回拒绝履行」在虚构时间线上的位置，并一并查看买方的回应。

words.enDefinition: In a UK legislative database, a text updated editorially to show amendments and other applied effects, subject to update coverage.

examples.en: The website guide tells us how revised legislation displays a change beside the relevant fictional provision.
examples.zh: 网站指南告诉我们，「编入变动的立法文本」怎样在相关虚构条文旁显示一处修改。

examples.en: We compared revised legislation with the original instrument before deciding which version to quote in class.
examples.zh: 我们将「编入变动的立法文本」与原始法定文书作了比较，再决定在课上引用哪个版本。

words.enDefinition: a buyer's withdrawal of prior acceptance of goods under sales-law conditions, including substantial impairment in New York's UCC

examples.en: The fictional buyer argued for revocation of acceptance after discovering a serious defect following the initial inspection.
examples.zh: 在首次检验后发现严重瑕疵，虚构买方主张「撤回对货物的接受」。

examples.en: The New York problem distinguishes revocation of acceptance after a purchase from rejection before acceptance occurs.
examples.zh: 纽约州例题区分购买后「撤回对货物的接受」与接受之前拒收。

collocations: notify a seller of revocation of acceptance

words.zhGloss: 身份标识的商业利用权
words.enDefinition: A right recognised in some US jurisdictions to control certain commercial uses of one's identity or identifying features.
acceptedZhAnswers: 身份标识的商业利用权

examples.en: The California course introduces the right of publicity using a fictional athlete and the wording of an advertisement.
examples.zh: 加州课程用一名虚构运动员和一则广告的措辞介绍「身份标识的商业利用权」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks how a dispute over commercial use might raise the right of publicity under local law.
examples.zh: 练习单追问，商业使用争议如何在当地法律下引出「身份标识的商业利用权」问题。

collocations: commercial use and the right of publicity

words.expression: right to counsel in a criminal case
words.lemma: right to counsel in a criminal case
words.zhGloss: 刑事案件中的律师辩护权
words.enDefinition: The entitlement to legal representation at applicable stages of a criminal proceeding.
acceptedZhAnswers: 刑事案件中的律师辩护权
acceptedEnVariants: right to counsel in a criminal case

examples.en: The instructor highlighted the right to counsel in a criminal case on the classroom constitutional outline.
examples.zh: 老师在课堂宪法提纲上高亮了「刑事案件中的律师辩护权」。

examples.en: We identified the right to counsel in a criminal case before reading the fictional court's procedural summary.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「刑事案件中的律师辩护权」，再阅读虚构法院的程序摘要。

collocations: the scope of the right to counsel in a criminal case
identify the right to counsel in a criminal case
a discussion of the right to counsel in a criminal case

words.enDefinition: a right under an applicable law or agreement to correct nonconforming performance within allowed limits

examples.en: The New York sales exercise asks whether the seller has a right to cure the nonconforming delivery.
examples.zh: 纽约州买卖法练习问，卖方对不合约的交付是否有「补救权」。

examples.en: We compared the proposed replacement date with the deadline specified for the right to cure in the contract.
examples.zh: 我们将拟定更换日期与合同规定的「补救权」行使期限作比较。

collocations: scope of the right to cure

words.enDefinition: A current legal entitlement to take possession of property even if someone else presently holds it.

examples.en: The timing of the fictional loan determines when the owner had a right to immediate possession.
examples.zh: 虚构借用协议的时限决定了所有人在何时拥有「即时占有权」。

examples.en: The property worksheet asks who had a right to immediate possession on the date entered in the table.
examples.zh: 财产法练习单询问表中所列日期谁拥有「即时占有权」。

collocations: establish a right to immediate possession
assert a right to immediate possession
person with a right to immediate possession

words.zhGloss: 因违约终止合同的权利
words.enDefinition: an entitlement to end the contract for breach when the contract or applicable law provides that remedy
acceptedZhAnswers: 因违约终止合同的权利

examples.en: Under the assigned law, the fictional buyer's right to terminate for breach depended on the failure's severity.
examples.zh: 根据题设法律，该不履行的严重程度决定虚构买方是否享有「因违约终止合同的权利」。

examples.en: The professor distinguished the right to terminate for breach from a claim for compensation alone.
examples.zh: 老师区分了「因违约终止合同的权利」与单纯请求赔偿。

collocations: exercise the right to terminate for breach
scope of the right to terminate for breach
assert a right to terminate for breach

words.enDefinition: a term assigning responsibility for specified uncertainties or events to one or more parties

examples.en: The risk allocation clause stated who would bear certain costs if the hypothetical delivery was interrupted.
examples.zh: 「风险分配条款」规定，如果假设的交付中断，由谁承担某些费用。

examples.en: We read the risk allocation clause before assuming that an unexpected event excused the seller in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在认定意外事件能免除习题中卖方的责任之前，我们先阅读了「风险分配条款」。

collocations: risk allocation clause in a supply contract

words.enDefinition: An approach to design-defect analysis that weighs a design's safety risks against its benefits using applicable legal factors.

examples.en: We used the risk-benefit test to organise the court's discussion of a fictional office organiser design.
examples.zh: 我们根据「风险与效益权衡测试」整理了法院对一款虚构桌面收纳盒设计的讨论。

examples.en: The risk-benefit test in our California reading considers several design factors listed in the accompanying model instruction.
examples.zh: 加州法律读物里的「风险与效益权衡测试」涉及随附示范指引列出的若干设计因素。

words.enDefinition: Type of harm a statutory requirement is designed to prevent

examples.en: The worksheet asks whether the broken display illustrates a risk covered by the statute in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 习题问，展品损坏是否体现了假设情境中的一种「法规涵盖的风险」。

examples.en: We checked the risk covered by the statute before applying the California concept to the example.
examples.zh: 我们在把加州法律概念用于该示例之前，先核对了「法规涵盖的风险」。

collocations: identify the risk covered by the statute
harm within the risk covered by the statute
compare the risk covered by the statute

words.enDefinition: Formal approval by the monarch that completes the process by which a UK parliamentary bill becomes an Act.

examples.en: The UK timeline places Royal Assent after the parliamentary stages and before the Act's separate commencement date.
examples.zh: 英国时间线把「御准」放在议会各阶段之后、法令另定的生效日期之前。

examples.en: Our textbook uses a fictional Act to illustrate where the date of Royal Assent is recorded.
examples.zh: 教材用一部虚构法令展示了「御准」日期记录在什么位置。

words.enDefinition: A grammar-based interpretive principle under which a qualifying phrase ordinarily modifies its nearest reasonable antecedent.

examples.en: Our American legal writing tutorial applies the rule of the last antecedent to a fictional statutory sentence.
examples.zh: 美国法律写作辅导课把「就近先行项规则」用于分析一个虚构法条的句子。

examples.en: Students annotate the last item before explaining how the rule of the last antecedent might affect the reading.
examples.zh: 学生先标注最后一项，然后解释「就近先行项规则」可能怎样影响读法。

collocations: apply the rule of the last antecedent
invoke the rule of the last antecedent
limits of the rule of the last antecedent

words.enDefinition: English statutory contribution condition that both persons be liable for the same damage

examples.en: The class checks the same damage requirement before examining a fictional contribution question.
examples.zh: 课堂先核查「同一损害要件」，再分析一个虚构的分担问题。

examples.en: We used the same damage requirement to distinguish two separate losses on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们用「同一损害要件」区分图表上两项独立损失。

collocations: scope of the same damage requirement

words.enDefinition: a term making an obligation depend on whether specified performance satisfies a person under the applicable standard

examples.en: The fictional portrait agreement included a satisfaction clause addressing whether the client approved the finished work.
examples.zh: 虚构肖像委托协议包含「满意条款」，涉及委托人是否认可完成的作品。

examples.en: We examined which standard applied to the satisfaction clause in the assigned comparison of two different agreements.
examples.zh: 在指定的两项协议对照练习中，我们考察判断「满意条款」适用哪种标准。

words.enDefinition: an obligation to meet an applicable attendance standard for a course when required by Australian overseas education rules

examples.en: The fictional policy lists the satisfactory attendance requirement separately from completion of assessed work in the course.
examples.zh: 虚构政策将「出勤达标要求」与完成课程考核任务分别列出。

examples.en: We read the classroom extract to see which hypothetical course had a satisfactory attendance requirement.
examples.zh: 我们阅读课堂节选，查看哪项假设课程设有「出勤达标要求」。

words.enDefinition: A provision preserving an existing right, obligation, rule, or pending matter despite legislative change.

examples.en: Our example uses a saving provision to preserve earlier rights when the fictional statute replaces an older rule.
examples.zh: 示例用一项「保留条款」说明虚构制定法取代旧规则时如何保留先前产生的权利。

examples.en: The exercise asks which earlier obligations survive because of the saving provision quoted in the imaginary judgment.
examples.zh: 练习追问，虚构判决引用的「保留条款」使哪些先前义务继续存在。

words.enDefinition: Federal order setting deadlines and stages for managing a civil case

examples.en: The mock scheduling order sets dates for several stages of the case.
examples.zh: 模拟「诉讼日程令」为案件的几个阶段设定了日期。

examples.en: The scheduling order in our example places initial disclosures before the document requests.
examples.zh: 示例中的「诉讼日程令」规定先进行初始披露，再提出文书请求。

words.expression: scope of a duty of care
words.lemma: scope of a duty of care
words.enDefinition: Limits of the risks and interests a particular care obligation protects
acceptedEnVariants: scope of a duty of care

examples.en: The fictional judgment asks whether the loss falls within the scope of a duty of care.
examples.zh: 虚构判决问，所述损失是否落在「注意义务范围」之内。

examples.en: We discussed the scope of a duty of care after stating the purpose of the adviser's role.
examples.zh: 我们先说明顾问角色的目的，再讨论「注意义务范围」。

collocations: identify the scope of a duty of care
assess the scope of a duty of care
loss within the scope of a duty of care

words.enDefinition: In US federal civil procedure, the limits on discovery of relevant, nonprivileged matter proportional to the needs of the case.

examples.en: The federal chart connects the scope of civil discovery with the issues in dispute.
examples.zh: 联邦程序图将「民事证据开示范围」与争议问题联系起来。

examples.en: We examined the scope of civil discovery before reading the sample requests in class.
examples.zh: 我们先考察「民事证据开示范围」，再在课堂上阅读样本请求。

collocations: determine the scope of civil discovery
issues within the scope of civil discovery
limits on the scope of civil discovery

words.enDefinition: The range of work-related conduct for which an employee's actions can be attributed to the employer under applicable law.

examples.en: The students place each fictional task on a chart headed scope of employment to prepare for discussion.
examples.zh: 学生们把每项虚构工作填进题为「职务范围」的表格，为讨论做准备。

examples.en: The California classroom exercise asks whether the driver's assigned delivery fell within the scope of employment.
examples.zh: 加州课堂练习询问受指派的送货任务是否在司机的「职务范围」内。

words.enDefinition: Boundary of consequences legally attributed to conduct established as a factual cause

examples.en: The fictional example separates scope of liability from the bare fact that damage occurred.
examples.zh: 虚构示例把「法律责任范围」与损坏已发生这一事实分开分析。

examples.en: We discussed the scope of liability after assuming factual causation in the class problem.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂题设中假定事实因果关系成立，再讨论「法律责任范围」。

collocations: limits on the scope of liability

words.enDefinition: The limits on where, when, or for what purpose a person may enter or remain on premises.

examples.en: The tutor circled the dates on the ticket to illustrate the scope of permission it conveyed.
examples.zh: 老师圈出了票面上的日期，用以说明这张票授予的「许可范围」。

examples.en: Our exercise compares the scope of permission for stallholders with the permission given to exhibition visitors.
examples.zh: 练习比较了摊主与展览来访者获得的「许可范围」。

words.enDefinition: Range of harms that make the conduct legally blameworthy in the first place

examples.en: The worksheet compares the fictional damage with the scope of the risk in the allegation.
examples.zh: 习题将虚构损坏与主张所指的「风险范围」作比较。

examples.en: We labeled the scope of the risk before discussing what actually happened to the model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「风险范围」，再讨论模型实际发生了什么。

collocations: identify the scope of the risk
harm within the scope of the risk
consider the scope of the risk

words.enDefinition: Arbitration's legal location, which may differ from where hearings take place

examples.en: The mock award lists London as the seat of arbitration although the hearing took place online.
examples.zh: 模拟裁决列出伦敦为「仲裁地」，而听证在线上举行。

examples.en: The seminar diagram distinguishes the seat of arbitration from the physical location of the hearing.
examples.zh: 研讨课的示意图区分了「仲裁地」与实际举行听证的地点。

collocations: law of the seat of arbitration

words.enDefinition: A work that describes, explains, or analyses the law, such as a textbook or scholarly article.

examples.en: The librarian uses a secondary legal source to introduce the terms appearing in the fictional statute.
examples.zh: 图书馆员用一份「法律二手资料」介绍虚构制定法中出现的术语。

examples.en: We linked the secondary legal source to the decisions it discusses in the classroom research exercise.
examples.zh: 在课堂检索练习中，我们把「法律二手资料」和它讨论的裁判连起来。

collocations: discussion in a secondary legal source

words.enDefinition: Legally binding rules made by a person or body exercising rulemaking power delegated by primary legislation.

examples.en: The British textbook introduces secondary legislation alongside an extract showing who may make the authorised rules.
examples.zh: 英国教材在介绍「次级立法」时，附上一段说明哪些主体获准制定规则的摘录。

examples.en: The seminar compares two pieces of secondary legislation made under different sections of the fictional Act.
examples.zh: 研讨课比较了依据虚构议会法案不同条款制定的两部「次级立法」。

words.enDefinition: an applicant for an Australian visa assessed in a secondary capacity linked to a primary applicant

examples.en: The secondary visa applicant is linked to the main applicant in the fictional Australian family record.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的虚构澳大利亚家庭档案中，「签证附属申请人」与主申请人相关联。

examples.en: We checked the relationship field for the secondary visa applicant in the case materials on the course page.
examples.zh: 我们在课程页的案例材料中核对「签证附属申请人」的亲属关系栏。

collocations: details of a secondary visa applicant
eligibility of a secondary visa applicant

words.enDefinition: continuation of existing UK immigration permission after an in-time qualifying application to extend it, including an associated appeal or administrative review where section 3C applies

examples.en: The class marked the fictional period of section 3C leave between the previous expiry and the decision.
examples.zh: 全班将前一许可到期至决定之间的虚构时段标作「第3C条延续居留许可」。

examples.en: We used the statutory excerpt to distinguish section 3C leave from a fresh grant of immigration permission.
examples.zh: 我们用法条节选区分「第3C条延续居留许可」和新授予的移民许可。

words.enDefinition: Party participating in a proceeding without a lawyer acting as their representative

examples.en: The mock docket identifies one participant as a self-represented party in the case.
examples.zh: 模拟卷宗将一名参与者标为案件中「自行诉讼的当事人」。

examples.en: We compared the terms used for a self-represented party in two court systems.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个法院系统中对「自行诉讼的当事人」的称呼。

words.enDefinition: Differences in sentences across cases, especially where the cases are comparable in relevant respects.

examples.en: The seminar discussed sentencing disparity using only synthetic results from the classroom's set of hypothetical cases.
examples.zh: 讨论课只根据一组课堂假设案件的合成结果，讨论了「量刑差异」。

examples.en: We checked whether the two mock cases were comparable before describing their different outcomes as sentencing disparity.
examples.zh: 我们先核对两个模拟案例是否可比，再把不同结果描述为「量刑差异」。

words.enDefinition: An authoritative guideline for selecting a sentence, with legal force depending on the jurisdiction.

examples.en: The classroom exercise identified the sentencing guideline used in the fictional court's written explanation for its decision.
examples.zh: 课堂题指明虚构法院在其书面裁判说明中依据的「量刑指南」。

examples.en: We compared a sentencing guideline from England and Wales with its counterpart in the American teaching materials.
examples.zh: 我们将英格兰与威尔士的一份「量刑指南」与美国教学材料中对应的指南作比较。

words.enDefinition: A proceeding where the court considers and decides an appropriate sentence following a finding or plea of guilt.

examples.en: The mock docket scheduled a sentencing hearing after the fictional court recorded a finding of guilt.
examples.zh: 模拟案件登记表在虚构法庭记载有罪认定后安排了「量刑听证」。

examples.en: We read the heading for the sentencing hearing before identifying the issues discussed in the classroom transcript.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「量刑听证」的标题，再找出课堂模拟记录中讨论的事项。

collocations: a decision at a sentencing hearing

words.enDefinition: A judge's explanation of a sentence, given at sentencing or recorded in a related statement.

examples.en: The fictional transcript included sentencing remarks explaining the relationship between the court's findings and its decision.
examples.zh: 虚构庭审记录收录了「法官量刑说明」，解释法院认定与裁判决定之间的联系。

examples.en: We compared the sentencing remarks with the short description of the outcome on the classroom timeline.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「法官量刑说明」与课堂时间线上对结果的简要说明。

words.zhGloss: 基于法定因素偏离指南量刑
words.enDefinition: A federal sentence outside the advisory guidelines range based on statutory sentencing considerations, as distinct from a departure under a guideline provision.
acceptedZhAnswers: 基于法定因素偏离指南量刑

examples.en: The federal classroom exercise used sentencing variance for a decision outside the advisory range under statutory considerations.
examples.zh: 联邦法课堂题用「基于法定因素偏离指南量刑」描述一项依据法定考量作出的、在建议范围之外的裁定。

examples.en: We read the fictional court's explanation of a sentencing variance before comparing it with the guideline calculation.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读虚构法院对「基于法定因素偏离指南量刑」的解释，再与指南计算结果比较。

collocations: a judicial explanation of a sentencing variance

words.enDefinition: A grammar-based canon under which a modifier may apply to every element in a straightforward parallel series.

examples.en: The class applies the series-qualifier canon to a modifier following three parallel items in the fictional statute.
examples.zh: 全班用「并列项共同修饰规则」分析虚构制定法中三个并列项目之后的修饰语。

examples.en: Our worksheet contrasts the series-qualifier canon with another approach to deciding the scope of a modifying phrase.
examples.zh: 练习单将「并列项共同修饰规则」与另一种确定修饰语范围的方法作比较。

words.enDefinition: Serious loss of money, relevant under the Defamation Act 2013 in claims under the law of England and Wales by bodies trading for profit.

examples.en: The English law problem asks how serious financial loss would be assessed for the fictional trading company.
examples.zh: 英格兰法题目询问，如何评估一家虚构商业公司是否遭受「严重经济损失」。

examples.en: Our defamation table links serious financial loss to the statutory treatment of bodies that trade for profit.
examples.zh: 诽谤对照表将「严重经济损失」与法律对营利经营机构的规定联系起来。

collocations: likely to cause serious financial loss

words.enDefinition: The requirement under the law of England and Wales that a publication caused, or is likely to cause, serious harm to reputation.

examples.en: The English defamation exercise asks what evidence is relevant to the serious harm threshold in a fictional case.
examples.zh: 英格兰诽谤法练习询问，在一则虚构案例中哪些证据与「严重名誉损害门槛」有关。

examples.en: The serious harm threshold appears in a separate section of our outline from questions about defamatory meaning.
examples.zh: 我们的提纲把「严重名誉损害门槛」和有损名誉的含义问题列在不同章节。

collocations: evidence relevant to the serious harm threshold

words.enDefinition: Magnitude of the harm that might result if the risk materializes

examples.en: The seminar compares the seriousness of potential harm for two types of modeled damage.
examples.zh: 研讨课比较了两类模型损坏所对应的「潜在损害的严重性」。

examples.en: We considered the seriousness of potential harm separately from the likelihood in our fictional problem.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构题设中将「潜在损害的严重性」与发生的可能性分开考察。

collocations: consider the seriousness of potential harm
assess the seriousness of potential harm
account for the seriousness of potential harm

words.enDefinition: Formal delivery of a civil judgment in accordance with applicable rules

examples.en: The fictional chronology lists service of a civil judgment after the decision was recorded.
examples.zh: 虚构时间线在记载裁判后列出了「民事判决送达」。

examples.en: We matched service of a civil judgment to the dated record in the sample packet.
examples.zh: 我们将「民事判决送达」与样本文件包里带日期的记录配对。

collocations: record service of a civil judgment
date of service of a civil judgment
document showing service of a civil judgment

words.enDefinition: Formal delivery of the initiating form under England and Wales rules

examples.en: The mock chronology marks service of a claim form as a separate procedural event.
examples.zh: 模拟时间线把「起诉表送达」标为独立的程序事件。

examples.en: We found service of a claim form recorded beside the dated entry in the sample file.
examples.zh: 我们在样本案卷带日期的记录旁找到了「起诉表送达」的记载。

collocations: record service of a claim form
date of service of a claim form
rule on service of a claim form

words.enDefinition: Formal delivery of initial court papers to notify a party

examples.en: The federal classroom diagram records service of process before the defendant's response appears.
examples.zh: 联邦程序课堂图先记录「民事诉讼文书送达」，随后出现被告的答复。

examples.en: We distinguished service of process from later exchanges between the fictional parties.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「民事诉讼文书送达」与虚构当事人此后进行的交流。

words.enDefinition: Agreement in which parties resolve some or all matters in dispute

examples.en: The parties' fictional settlement agreement resolves the invoice dispute and leaves delivery dates unchanged.
examples.zh: 虚构案例中双方的「和解协议」解决了发票争议，并保持交付日期不变。

examples.en: We compared the draft settlement agreement with the final version after the negotiation exercise.
examples.zh: 协商练习结束后，我们对照了「和解协议」的草案与最终版本。

words.enDefinition: Conference where a judge or another neutral helps explore possible settlement

examples.en: A magistrate judge leads the settlement conference in the fictional federal court exercise.
examples.zh: 在虚构的联邦法院练习中，由一位联邦治安法官主持「和解会议」。

examples.en: The practice docket lists a settlement conference separately from the hearing on the motion.
examples.zh: 模拟案卷将「和解会议」和动议听证分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Liability limited to an individual party's own allocated share of recoverable loss

examples.en: The comparative chart labels separate individual obligations as several liability in the model.
examples.zh: 比较图将模型里各自独立的义务标为「按份责任」。

examples.en: We analyzed several liability using a fictional allocation between two responsible parties.
examples.zh: 我们通过两个责任方之间的虚构分摊来分析「按份责任」。

words.enDefinition: an individual entry in the US Student and Exchange Visitor Information System tracking details and events for a person

examples.en: The fictional SEVIS record shows the school, program dates and status label in separate parts of the display.
examples.zh: 虚构「SEVIS学生记录」在显示界面的不同位置列出学校、项目日期和状态标记。

examples.en: We followed changes to a SEVIS record across a timeline prepared for the immigration law class.
examples.zh: 我们沿移民法课编制的时间线追踪一份「SEVIS学生记录」的变化。

words.zhGloss: 美国学生项目学校认证
words.enDefinition: US government certification authorizing a school to enroll F or M nonimmigrant students in approved programs
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学生项目学校认证

examples.en: The handout describes SEVP certification as a school-level authorization in the American student immigration system.
examples.zh: 讲义将「美国学生项目学校认证」描述为美国学生移民体系中对学校作出的授权。

examples.en: We looked for SEVP certification on the institution's profile rather than on the student's fictional admission record.
examples.zh: 我们在院校资料中查找「美国学生项目学校认证」，学生的虚构入境记录是另一类文件。

words.enDefinition: under the UK Consumer Rights Act 2015, an initial statutory right to reject certain nonconforming goods within applicable limits

examples.en: The UK worksheet distinguishes the short-term right to reject from later options for nonconforming goods under the Act.
examples.zh: 英国法练习区分了「短期拒收权」与该法针对不合约货物规定的后续选项。

examples.en: We identified where the short-term right to reject appeared in the sequence of remedies in the assigned statute.
examples.zh: 我们在指定法规的救济顺序中，找出「短期拒收权」所处的位置。

collocations: exercise the short-term right to reject
limits on the short-term right to reject

words.enDefinition: The formal abbreviated name of an Act or other legislative instrument, used to identify or cite it.

examples.en: The UK exercise asks us to use the short title when referring to the fictional Act.
examples.zh: 英国练习要求我们在提及这部虚构法令时使用「法令简称」。

examples.en: Students found the short title in one section and the more descriptive wording at the top.
examples.zh: 学生们在一项条文里找出「法令简称」，并在文件上方发现了更详细的表述。

words.enDefinition: A legal form requirement calling for a signed written record for specified agreements or terms.

examples.en: The fictional New York case asked whether a signed writing requirement applied to the record before the court.
examples.zh: 虚构纽约州案例考察，「签署书面文件的要求」是否适用于法院审查的记录。

examples.en: We identified the signed writing requirement before comparing the documents supplied in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「签署书面文件的要求」，再比较课堂题所给的文书。

collocations: an exception to a signed writing requirement

words.enDefinition: In English law, a contract made without using the form of a deed.

examples.en: The English worksheet classified the fictional printing agreement as a simple contract made through written messages.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题把虚构印刷协议归为通过书面消息订立的「非契据合同」。

examples.en: We compared a simple contract with a deed in the two classroom examples about legal form.
examples.zh: 在关于法律形式的两个课堂示例中，我们对比了「非契据合同」和契据。

collocations: distinguish a simple contract from a deed

words.enDefinition: Defamation in spoken or another transient form recognised by the applicable law.

examples.en: The textbook introduces slander through a fictional remark heard at an academic society's weekly meeting.
examples.zh: 教材用学术社团例会上听到的一句虚构发言介绍「口头诽谤」。

examples.en: In the classroom dispute, the slander allegation concerns only the words reportedly spoken during the discussion.
examples.zh: 在课堂模拟争议中，「口头诽谤」指控仅涉及据称在讨论中说过的话。

words.enDefinition: In US federal publication, an individual publication of an enacted law before compilation in the Statutes at Large.

examples.en: The handout reproduces the front page of a slip law to show how headings appear in that format.
examples.zh: 讲义复制了「单行法印本」的首页，说明标题在这种格式里怎样呈现。

examples.en: Students matched a sample slip law to its later entry in the chronological collection of federal laws.
examples.zh: 学生们将一份「单行法印本」样本与它后来在按时间汇编的联邦法令全书中的条目配对。

collocations: publish an Act as a slip law

words.enDefinition: A separately issued version of a court opinion released before publication in a permanent volume of reports.

examples.en: The Supreme Court research guide lists a slip opinion before the later printed versions of the same decision.
examples.zh: 最高法院法律检索指南把「判决意见初刊本」排在同一裁判的较晚印刷版本之前。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks which citations might change between the slip opinion and the final bound version.
examples.zh: 练习单询问，对照「判决意见初刊本」和最后的合订本，哪些引证可能发生变化。

words.enDefinition: Public benefit of an activity considered when evaluating the care reasonably required

examples.en: The English law seminar discusses the social utility of conduct in a fictional exhibition problem.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课在一个虚构展览题设中讨论「行为的社会效用」。

examples.en: We considered the social utility of conduct alongside the probability and seriousness of harm.
examples.zh: 我们将「行为的社会效用」与损害的可能性和严重性一并考量。

collocations: consider the social utility of conduct
weigh the social utility of conduct
role of the social utility of conduct

words.enDefinition: A recognised origin or form of legal rules, such as legislation or judicial precedent in a particular system.

examples.en: The lecturer asks which source of law supports the rule printed on the first page of the handout.
examples.zh: 老师询问讲义第一页所印规则依据的是哪一种「法源」。

examples.en: The table identifies a source of law for each proposition raised in the fictional seminar problem.
examples.zh: 这张表为虚构研讨题提出的每项命题列出一个「法源」。

words.enDefinition: In US borrowed-employee doctrine, the second employer that controls or directs the employee in the assigned work.

examples.en: The worksheet asks which company acted as the special employer during the borrowed employee's temporary assignment.
examples.zh: 练习单询问，在借调雇员的临时任务期间，哪家公司充当了「借调用工雇主」。

examples.en: Our tutor underlined special employer beside the party alleged to have controlled the worker's day-to-day duties.
examples.zh: 老师在据称控制雇员日常职责的一方旁边，把「借调用工雇主」划出了下划线。

words.enDefinition: An exception in some US jurisdictions that may bring travel for a task assigned by an employer within the scope of employment.

examples.en: Our California materials index the special errand exception under employee travel and activities authorised by the employer.
examples.zh: 我们的加州法律材料把「特别差事例外」编入员工出行与雇主授权活动的条目下。

examples.en: The exercise asks whether collecting files for the fictional office could qualify under the special errand exception.
examples.zh: 练习询问替虚构办公室领取文件是否可能符合「特别差事例外」。

collocations: requirements of the special errand exception

words.zhGloss: 公共滋扰中的特别损害
words.enDefinition: An individual injury distinct from that suffered by the public generally, relevant to whether a private person may sue in certain jurisdictions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 公共滋扰中的特别损害

examples.en: The California exercise asks whether the facts could establish special injury in public nuisance for the private claimant.
examples.zh: 加州练习追问，相关事实能否让私人原告证明「公共滋扰中的特别损害」。

examples.en: Our reading places special injury in public nuisance under the separate heading for lawsuits brought by individuals.
examples.zh: 读物把「公共滋扰中的特别损害」列在个人提起诉讼的独立标题下。

collocations: plead special injury in public nuisance
demonstrate special injury in public nuisance
requirement of special injury in public nuisance

words.enDefinition: Relationship that may create a duty to protect another under relevant law

examples.en: The California worksheet asks whether a special relationship in negligence supports the proposed protective duty.
examples.zh: 加州法律习题问，是否存在支持所提保护义务的「过失法上的特殊关系」。

examples.en: We considered the special relationship in negligence question through an invented shared supervision scenario.
examples.zh: 我们通过虚构的共同监管情境考察「过失法上的特殊关系」问题。

collocations: identify a special relationship in negligence
recognize a special relationship in negligence
examine a special relationship in negligence

words.enDefinition: Federal jury verdict stating findings on specified factual issues

examples.en: The mock jury form uses a special verdict to record separate factual answers.
examples.zh: 模拟陪审团表格用「特别裁决」分别记录各事实问题的答案。

examples.en: We compared the special verdict with a single overall outcome on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们将「特别裁决」与图表上一个概括性结果作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Part 31 order concerning particular documents, classes, or a specified search

examples.en: The worksheet describes specific disclosure of one category of records in the dispute.
examples.zh: 习题描述就纠纷中某类记录进行的「特定文书披露」。

examples.en: We compared the specific disclosure order with a broader listing requirement in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上将「特定文书披露」令与范围更广的列示要求作了比较。

words.enDefinition: In some United States classifications, an intent to achieve a particular purpose beyond doing the stated act.

examples.en: The American seminar asked what additional purpose the fictional provision required for a finding of specific intent.
examples.zh: 美国讨论课问，虚构条文要求有何额外目的才能认定「特定故意」。

examples.en: We found the language describing the further objective before discussing specific intent in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂题中的「特定故意」前，我们先找出描述进一步目的的措辞。

words.enDefinition: a court order requiring a party to perform a contractual obligation, available only under applicable conditions

examples.en: The mock court considered specific performance because the agreement concerned an item with no readily available substitute.
examples.zh: 虚构法院考虑「强制实际履行」，因为协议所涉物品没有容易获得的替代品。

examples.en: We read the English law problem's separate discussion of specific performance and monetary damages for the same breach.
examples.zh: 我们阅读英格兰法例题中对同一违约的「强制实际履行」和金钱赔偿的分别讨论。

words.zhGloss: 具体条款优先于一般条款
words.enDefinition: An interpretive principle giving more specific language priority over conflicting general language where applicable.
acceptedZhAnswers: 具体条款优先于一般条款

examples.en: The tutor explained why specific terms control general terms in the classroom draft involving two conflicting provisions.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释，在有两项条款冲突的课堂草案中，为何适用「具体条款优先于一般条款」。

examples.en: We asked whether specific terms control general terms when both clauses addressed delivery in the mock case.
examples.zh: 在模拟案例中，两项条款都涉及交付，我们考察是否应适用「具体条款优先于一般条款」。

collocations: apply the principle that specific terms control general terms
the canon that specific terms control general terms
consider whether specific terms control general terms

words.enDefinition: A United States right against undue delay in bringing a criminal charge to trial under applicable rules.

examples.en: The American worksheet placed the speedy trial right in a separate section on constitutional protections.
examples.zh: 美国习题把「及时审判权」放在一个单独介绍宪法保障的章节。
