examples.en: We located the speedy trial right in the mock judgment before discussing the court's stated reasoning.
examples.zh: 我们先在模拟判决中找到「及时审判权」，再讨论法院给出的说理。

collocations: an issue involving the speedy trial right

words.enDefinition: withdrawal of a UK institution's license to act as an immigration sponsor under the relevant rules

examples.en: The classroom exercise records sponsor licence revocation as a decision concerning the institution in the fictional file.
examples.zh: 课堂练习将「担保资质撤销」记作虚构档案中一项针对院校的决定。

examples.en: We discussed sponsor licence revocation while reading the section about existing students in the sponsor guidance excerpt.
examples.zh: 我们阅读担保指南节选中涉及在读学生的部分时，讨论了「担保资质撤销」。

words.enDefinition: the UK online system through which licensed sponsors manage specified sponsorship activities and records

examples.en: The classroom illustration labels the sponsorship management system beside the sponsor's tasks rather than the student's application.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图把「英国担保管理系统」标在担保机构的任务旁，学生申请另列。

examples.en: We located the sponsorship management system entry in the sample university administrator's handbook used for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习用的大学管理人员样例手册中找到「英国担保管理系统」条目。

collocations: record in the sponsorship management system

words.enDefinition: Under England and Wales CPR Part 31, disclosure of categories including documents relied upon and those adversely affecting one party's case or supporting another's.

examples.en: The fictional order uses standard disclosure in a case governed by Part 31.
examples.zh: 虚构法院命令在适用民事程序规则第 31 部分的案件中采用「标准文书披露」。

examples.en: We classified the sample document under the standard disclosure categories in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上按照「标准文书披露」的类别给样本文书分类。

words.enDefinition: Level of care against which conduct is measured for possible breach

examples.en: The seminar identifies the standard of care in negligence before evaluating what the fictional worker did.
examples.zh: 研讨课先确定「过失法上的注意标准」，再评估虚构工作人员的举动。

examples.en: We compared two possible descriptions of the standard of care in negligence in our class notes.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂笔记中描述「过失法上的注意标准」的两种方式。

collocations: identify the standard of care in negligence
apply the standard of care in negligence
discuss the standard of care in negligence

words.expression: standard of proof in a civil case
words.lemma: standard of proof in a civil case
words.enDefinition: Degree of persuasion required to establish a matter in a civil proceeding
acceptedEnVariants: standard of proof in a civil case

examples.en: The class compares the standard of proof in a civil case with the separate burden question.
examples.zh: 课堂把「民事案件证明标准」和谁承担举证责任作了比较。

examples.en: We located the standard of proof in a civil case in the fictional instructions attached to the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在习题所附的虚构指示中找到了「民事案件证明标准」。

collocations: identify the standard of proof in a civil case
explain the standard of proof in a civil case
apply the standard of proof in a civil case

words.enDefinition: The governing constitutional text of a state in a federation, such as a US state.

examples.en: The American law seminar presents a state constitution alongside the federal Constitution for a comparison exercise.
examples.zh: 美国法律研讨课把一部「州宪法」和联邦宪法并列展示，作为比较练习。

examples.en: In the fictional state dispute, the question turns on which provision of the state constitution applies.
examples.zh: 在虚构的州法争议中，问题取决于「州宪法」的哪一条适用。

words.enDefinition: A United States state court hearing cases under that state's criminal law.

examples.en: The diagram placed the fictional prosecution in a state criminal court because it arose under state law.
examples.zh: 流程图将虚构追诉列在「州刑事法院」一栏，因为案件依据的是州法。

examples.en: We read the caption naming the state criminal court before discussing the level of review.
examples.zh: 我们先读注明「州刑事法院」的图注，再讨论审查层级。

collocations: appeal from a state criminal court
the jurisdiction of a state criminal court

words.zhGloss: 相关时间的认识或技术水平
words.enDefinition: The level of available scientific knowledge or technology at a legally relevant time.
acceptedZhAnswers: 相关时间的认识或技术水平

examples.en: The California warning case exercise compares the state of the art at distribution with later research findings.
examples.zh: 加州警示案例练习比较了产品分销时的「相关时间的认识或技术水平」与后来得到的研究发现。

examples.en: The state of the art evidence in the mock design file includes dated drawings and published studies.
examples.zh: 模拟设计案卷中有关「相关时间的认识或技术水平」的证据包括注明日期的图纸和公布的研究成果。

collocations: state of the art at distribution

words.enDefinition: A law enacted by a state legislature within a federation, as distinct from national legislation.

examples.en: Our American legal research exercise asks which state statute the fictional judgment applies to the dispute.
examples.zh: 美国法律检索练习要求判断虚构判决在争议中适用的是哪一部「州制定法」。

examples.en: Students compared the definition in the proposed state statute with the wording of the assigned federal law.
examples.zh: 学生把拟议「州制定法」的定义与指定阅读的联邦法措辞作比较。

words.enDefinition: Category of documents setting out parties' positions under England and Wales rules

examples.en: The seminar classifies the fictional defence as a statement of case under the rules.
examples.zh: 研讨课依规则将虚构答辩状归为「诉辩文书」。

examples.en: We compared one statement of case with a document recording evidence in the packet.
examples.zh: 我们将一份「诉辩文书」与文件包里一份记录证据的文件作了比较。

collocations: contents of a statement of case

words.enDefinition: Confirmation of honest belief in stated facts under England and Wales rules

examples.en: The specimen pleading ends with a separate statement of truth beneath the factual account.
examples.zh: 样本诉状在事实陈述下方另附一份「真实性声明」。

examples.en: We marked the statement of truth separately from the name identifying the fictional party.
examples.zh: 我们将「真实性声明」与用于确认虚构当事人身份的姓名分开标注。

collocations: verify a document with a statement of truth
wording of a statement of truth

words.zhGloss: 用于证明其内容属实的陈述
words.enDefinition: Statement submitted to establish the facts asserted in its own content
acceptedZhAnswers: 用于证明其内容属实的陈述

examples.en: The federal slide labels one sentence as a statement offered for its truth in its comparison.
examples.zh: 联邦程序幻灯片在对比中将一个句子标为「用于证明其内容属实的陈述」。

examples.en: We discussed the purpose of a statement offered for its truth in the fictional transcript extract.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了虚构笔录节选中「用于证明其内容属实的陈述」的用途。

collocations: identify a statement offered for its truth
example of a statement offered for its truth
rule concerning a statement offered for its truth

words.enDefinition: A United States legal rule requiring written evidence for enforcement of certain agreements, subject to applicable exceptions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 防止欺诈法上的书面要求

examples.en: The American class considered whether the statute of frauds applied to the fictional agreement for supplying exhibition materials.
examples.zh: 美国课堂考察「防止欺诈法上的书面要求」是否适用于这份供应展览材料的虚构协议。

examples.en: We drew a separate column for the statute of frauds issue in our mock case outline.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟案例提纲中，为「防止欺诈法上的书面要求」问题单列了一栏。

words.enDefinition: A common form of UK secondary legislation made under an authority granted by an Act.

examples.en: The tutor asked us to locate the enabling Act listed at the start of the sample statutory instrument.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们找出「法定文书」样本开头列出的授权法。

examples.en: The notes explain why the fictional statutory instrument and its enabling Act have different publication references.
examples.zh: 笔记解释虚构「法定文书」和授权法为什么各有不同的出版编号。

words.enDefinition: The highest sentence permitted under the applicable statute for the offense and circumstances.

examples.en: The tutor highlighted the statutory maximum sentence in the assigned law extract before discussing the mock judgment.
examples.zh: 辅导老师先在指定法规节选中高亮「法定最高刑」，再讨论模拟判决。

examples.en: We distinguished the statutory maximum sentence from the sentence actually recorded for the fictional offense in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「法定最高刑」与虚构犯罪实际被判处的刑罚。

collocations: remain below the statutory maximum sentence
a rule setting the statutory maximum sentence

words.enDefinition: An individual text unit within a statute that sets out a legal rule, power, definition, or related matter.

examples.en: The mock judgment quotes a statutory provision before explaining how its conditions relate to the fictional dispute.
examples.zh: 模拟判决先引用一项「制定法条款」，再解释其条件与虚构争议有何关系。

examples.en: Our worksheet asks us to locate the statutory provision making the requirement in the reading binding.
examples.zh: 练习单要求找出赋予读物中的该项要求以约束力的「制定法条款」。

words.enDefinition: A numbered or titled part attached to legislation that sets out supplementary or detailed statutory material.

examples.en: The fictional Act sends readers to a statutory schedule for the full list of covered properties.
examples.zh: 虚构法令让读者查阅「法令附表」，获取所涵盖财产的完整列表。

examples.en: Students checked whether the table in the statutory schedule was part of the legislation itself.
examples.zh: 学生核对「法令附表」中的表格是否属于立法文本本身。

collocations: list items in a statutory schedule

words.enDefinition: Required level of conduct derived from a rule in legislation

examples.en: The class compared the fictional statutory standard of care with the broader reasonable care question.
examples.zh: 课堂把虚构题设中的「法定注意标准」与更广泛的合理注意问题作了比较。

examples.en: We labeled the statutory standard of care before considering the purpose of the fictional statute.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「法定注意标准」，再考察虚构法规的目的。

collocations: identify a statutory standard of care
apply a statutory standard of care
violation of a statutory standard of care

words.enDefinition: Order temporarily suspending steps to enforce an existing judgment

examples.en: The mock file records a stay of enforcement while another issue is considered.
examples.zh: 模拟案卷记载，在审查另一问题期间实行「暂缓执行」。

examples.en: We marked the stay of enforcement on the timeline after the fictional judgment.
examples.zh: 我们在时间线上将「暂缓执行」标在虚构判决之后。

collocations: effect of a stay of enforcement

words.enDefinition: The commercial flow of goods into the market, a concept used in arguments about when or where a product was marketed.

examples.en: The moot problem states when the fictional manufacturer placed the model in the stream of commerce.
examples.zh: 模拟法庭题目写明虚构制造商何时把这个型号投放到「商业流通渠道」。

examples.en: The court passage on the stream of commerce concerns how the fictional item reached the domestic market.
examples.zh: 法院材料中有关「商业流通渠道」的一段涉及虚构物品如何进入国内市场。

collocations: place goods in the stream of commerce

words.enDefinition: exact adherence to the requirements of a term, condition or applicable rule

examples.en: The seminar asked whether strict compliance with the notice wording was necessary under the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 研讨课问，在虚构协议下，对通知措辞是否必须「严格遵守」。

examples.en: We distinguished strict compliance from substantial performance when reading the contrasting classroom decisions about the same condition.
examples.zh: 阅读针对同一条件作出不同结论的课堂判例时，我们区分「严格遵守」和实质履行。

words.enDefinition: Legal responsibility that can apply without proof of fault, once the requirements of the particular rule are met.

examples.en: The worksheet distinguishes strict liability from negligence using two hypothetical cases with identical facts about reasonable care.
examples.zh: 练习单以两个在合理注意方面案情相同的假设案例区分了「严格责任」与过失责任。

examples.en: The notes list strict liability under several separate doctrines, each with its own conditions in the jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 笔记把「严格责任」列在几项不同的法律原则下，各项在该司法辖区都各有适用条件。

words.enDefinition: Liability without proof of negligence for certain harm caused by certain animals, as defined by the applicable law.

examples.en: The textbook separates strict liability for animals from other strict liability rules before the first discussion problem.
examples.zh: 教材在第一道讨论题前，把「动物致损的严格责任」与其他严格责任规则分开。

examples.en: Our comparison chart shows that strict liability for animals has different requirements in the jurisdictions we studied.
examples.zh: 比较表显示，我们学习的各司法辖区对「动物致损的严格责任」有不同的要求。

collocations: rule on strict liability for animals
claims involving strict liability for animals
limits of strict liability for animals

words.enDefinition: An offense for which proof of a mental state is unnecessary for one or more defined elements.

examples.en: The fictional statute led the class to discuss which element made it a strict liability offense.
examples.zh: 虚构法规引导我们讨论，是哪项要件使它构成「严格责任犯罪」。

examples.en: We checked the stated definition before assuming what proof a strict liability offense required in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对给出的定义，再判断证明「严格责任犯罪」需要什么。

collocations: an element of a strict liability offense

words.enDefinition: Liability imposed under applicable product-defect rules without requiring the claimant to establish the defendant's negligence.

examples.en: The California chapter on strict product liability distinguishes fault in production from the resulting condition of the product.
examples.zh: 加州教材中关于「严格产品责任」的一章区分生产过程中的过失与成品实际呈现的状况。

examples.en: For the exam, Jo outlined the defect issues relevant to strict product liability in the hypothetical.
examples.zh: 为准备考试，乔列出了假设案例中与「严格产品责任」有关的缺陷问题。

words.zhGloss: ESOS规定的学生方违约情形
words.enDefinition: a statutory category covering a qualifying failure to start, withdrawal, or refusal by a provider to deliver a course on specified grounds
acceptedZhAnswers: ESOS规定的学生方违约情形

examples.en: The handout distinguishes student default under ESOS from the provider's inability to deliver the fictional course.
examples.zh: 讲义区分「ESOS规定的学生方违约情形」与教育机构无法提供虚构课程。

examples.en: We located student default under ESOS in the part of the official extract about student-side events.
examples.zh: 我们在官方节选中关于学生一方事件的部分找到了「ESOS规定的学生方违约情形」。

collocations: definition of student default under ESOS
consequences of student default under ESOS

words.enDefinition: an eligible partner or child applying for or granted UK permission linked to someone in the Student route

examples.en: The chart places a Student dependant beside the principal Student in the fictional family record from class.
examples.zh: 课堂虚构家庭记录将「英国学生类别家属」列在学生主申请人旁。

examples.en: We compared the Student dependant label with the label on the independent applicant in the training example.
examples.zh: 我们将培训示例中的「英国学生类别家属」标签与独立申请人所用标签比较。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生担保资质许可
words.enDefinition: UK authorization allowing an education provider to sponsor students under the applicable immigration routes and duties
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生担保资质许可

examples.en: The classroom diagram shows a student sponsor licence assigned to the institution named in the sample file.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示，样例档案所列院校取得了「英国学生担保资质许可」。

examples.en: We read the conditions attached to a student sponsor licence in the assigned UK guidance excerpt.
examples.zh: 我们阅读指定英国指南节选中，附在「英国学生担保资质许可」上的条件。

collocations: revocation of a student sponsor licence

words.enDefinition: a licensed UK student sponsor's duty to report specified changes or events to the immigration authority

examples.en: The worksheet distinguishes a student sponsorship reporting duty from the academic records maintained for the fictional campus.
examples.zh: 习题区分「学生担保报告义务」与虚构校区为教学管理保存的学业记录。

examples.en: We found the student sponsorship reporting duty in the part of the guidance listing sponsor responsibilities.
examples.zh: 我们在指南列出担保机构责任的部分找到「学生担保报告义务」。

collocations: comply with a student sponsorship reporting duty
scope of a student sponsorship reporting duty
notice about a student sponsorship reporting duty

words.enDefinition: an elected student union officer in a full-time role that can be relevant under specified UK Student route provisions

examples.en: The policy example lists Student Union Sabbatical Officer as an elected role in the fictional university's union.
examples.zh: 政策示例将「学生会脱产任职干部」列为虚构大学学生会的民选职位。

examples.en: We marked the Student Union Sabbatical Officer entry on the sample sponsorship record discussed in the lecture.
examples.zh: 我们在讲义所讨论的担保样例记录上标出「学生会脱产任职干部」条目。

collocations: serve as a Student Union Sabbatical Officer
permission linked to a Student Union Sabbatical Officer role

words.enDefinition: a failure to meet a condition attached to Student visa permission under the applicable legal framework

examples.en: The fictional record flags a possible student visa condition breach for discussion under the assigned Australian guidance.
examples.zh: 虚构记录标出一项可能「违反学生签证条件」的情形，供依据指定的澳大利亚指南讨论。

examples.en: We read the stated condition before classifying the model example as a possible student visa condition breach.
examples.zh: 我们先读明示条件，再判断示例是否可能属于「违反学生签证条件」。

collocations: assess a student visa condition breach
consequence of a student visa condition breach

words.enDefinition: the applicant seeking an Australian Student visa in their own capacity as the person intending to study

examples.en: The fictional family file lists the enrolled person as the student visa primary applicant on its first page.
examples.zh: 虚构家庭档案首页将入学者列为「学生签证主申请人」。

examples.en: We identified the student visa primary applicant before reviewing the related family entries in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们辨认出「学生签证主申请人」后，才查阅相关家属条目。

collocations: identify the student visa primary applicant
details of a student visa primary applicant
relationship to the student visa primary applicant

words.enDefinition: a favorable decision on a Canadian study permit application, communicated through the relevant decision process

examples.en: The fictional timeline marks study permit approval before the applicant presented the relevant entry document in the example.
examples.zh: 虚构时间线将「学习许可批准」标在示例中申请人提交相应入境文件之前。

examples.en: We distinguished study permit approval from filing the application in the classroom workflow diagram for Canada.
examples.zh: 我们在加拿大课堂流程图中，区分「学习许可批准」与提交申请。

words.enDefinition: reporting by designated Canadian institutions to immigration authorities about students' enrollment or compliance information under the applicable rules

examples.en: The agency handout describes study permit compliance reporting as a responsibility of designated institutions under the program.
examples.zh: 移民机构的讲义将「学习许可合规报告」描述为该项目下指定院校的责任。

examples.en: We compared study permit compliance reporting with a student's separate supporting document in the fictional classroom file.
examples.zh: 我们将「学习许可合规报告」与虚构课堂档案里学生另行提交的证明材料比较。

collocations: requirements for study permit compliance reporting
data for study permit compliance reporting

words.enDefinition: a legal exception allowing a person within its scope to study in Canada without a study permit

examples.en: The sample case concerns a possible study permit exemption under the rule excerpt assigned for class.
examples.zh: 样例涉及按课堂指定规则节选可能适用的「学习许可豁免」。

examples.en: We marked the facts relevant to the study permit exemption before comparing the two fictional applicants.
examples.zh: 我们先标出与「学习许可豁免」有关的事实，再对照两名虚构申请人。

collocations: scope of a study permit exemption
qualify for a study permit exemption

words.enDefinition: the listed date on which a Canadian study permit expires, subject to rules that can end validity earlier

examples.en: The study permit expiry date appears on a different line from the issue date on the teaching specimen.
examples.zh: 教学样张上的「学习许可到期日期」与签发日期分列两行。

examples.en: We matched the study permit expiry date to the date printed on the fictional permit in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「学习许可到期日期」与虚构许可上印出的日期对应起来。

collocations: check the study permit expiry date
record the study permit expiry date

words.enDefinition: whether a Canadian study permit continues to have legal effect under its dates and applicable legal rules

examples.en: The instructor compared study permit validity with the printed expiry date under two different hypothetical fact patterns.
examples.zh: 老师根据两种不同假设事实，对照「学习许可有效性」与印出的到期日期。

examples.en: We identified which event affected study permit validity in the classroom note on a fictional permit.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构许可的课堂注释里，辨认哪件事影响了「学习许可有效性」。

words.enDefinition: Court's legal authority to hear the particular type of dispute presented

examples.en: The federal example asks about subject-matter jurisdiction before considering any party's conduct.
examples.zh: 联邦法律示例在考察当事人行为前，先问法院有无「事项管辖权」。

examples.en: We separated subject-matter jurisdiction from the choice of courthouse on the fictional map.
examples.zh: 我们将「事项管辖权」与虚构地图上的审理地点选择分开。

words.enDefinition: A qualification signaling that parties do not yet intend to be bound before a formal agreement.

examples.en: The English seminar emphasized the words subject to contract printed at the top of the fictional draft.
examples.zh: 英格兰法律讨论课强调了虚构草案顶部印有「以正式订约为前提」几个字。

examples.en: We discussed whether the parties later departed from their subject to contract wording in the mock case.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了模拟案例中的双方后来是否不再坚持「以正式订约为前提」这一措辞。

collocations: mark a draft subject to contract
a proposal marked subject to contract

words.enDefinition: an eligible family member seeking to join a primary Australian visa holder through a later application

examples.en: In the model timeline, the subsequent entrant application followed the grant of the fictional student's own visa.
examples.zh: 示例时间线将「后续赴澳家属申请人」的申请安排在虚构学生本人签证获批之后。

examples.en: We distinguished a subsequent entrant from family members included in the first application in the same classroom case.
examples.zh: 在同一个课堂案例中，我们区分「后续赴澳家属申请人」与首次申请已列入的家庭成员。

words.enDefinition: The later progress of the same case, such as review of the cited decision by another court.

examples.en: Our reference card lists the subsequent history under a separate heading below the citation to the fictional decision.
examples.zh: 课堂参考卡在虚构裁判的引证下，用一个独立标题列出「案件后续程序历史」。

examples.en: We checked subsequent history to see whether the earlier decision was reviewed in the same fictional case.
examples.zh: 我们核对「案件后续程序历史」，看前一裁判在同一个虚构案件中是否受到复审。

words.enDefinition: Later cause arising independently of the earlier conduct under examination

examples.en: The fictional timeline adds a subsequent independent cause after the original event has ended.
examples.zh: 虚构时间线在原事件结束后增加了一个「后续独立原因」。

examples.en: We considered the subsequent independent cause separately when allocating the modeled losses by time.
examples.zh: 我们按照时间划分模型中的损失时，单独考虑了「后续独立原因」。

collocations: effects of a subsequent independent cause

words.enDefinition: In California civil causation, a factor that contributed to the harm and was more than remote or trivial. It need not be the only cause.

examples.en: The California exercise asks whether the fictional conduct was a substantial factor in the loss.
examples.zh: 加州法律练习问，虚构行为是否为造成该损失的「实质性因素」。

examples.en: We located the substantial factor question within the causation portion of the class chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图的因果关系部分找到了「实质性因素」问题。

words.enDefinition: a serious reduction in the value of an accepted lot or commercial unit to the buyer, in the stated sales-law context

examples.en: The New York worksheet asks whether the hidden fault caused substantial impairment of value to this hypothetical buyer.
examples.zh: 纽约州练习问，隐蔽瑕疵是否导致货物对这名假设买方的价值发生「严重减损」。

examples.en: We separated substantial impairment in the assigned rule from a minor discrepancy in the goods description.
examples.zh: 我们将指定规则中的「严重减损」与货物描述中的轻微出入区分开。

words.enDefinition: Interference significant enough in its degree or effect to meet an applicable legal threshold, such as in nuisance.

examples.en: The nuisance tutorial asks whether persistent effects described by the fictional witnesses amounted to substantial interference.
examples.zh: 滋扰辅导课讨论，虚构目击者描述的持续影响是否构成「实质性干扰」。

examples.en: In our exercise, substantial interference is considered separately from how long the neighbour had occupied the plot.
examples.zh: 练习中把「实质性干扰」与邻居占有土地的时长分开讨论。

words.enDefinition: A significant alteration to a product, such as one made after it leaves the seller, that may affect a defect claim.

examples.en: The fictional record asks whether replacing the entire cover counted as a substantial modification of a product.
examples.zh: 虚构案卷要求判断更换整个外壳是否算「对产品的重大改动」。

examples.en: Students discussed substantial modification of a product after receiving two photographs dated years apart in the case packet.
examples.zh: 在案例材料中看到拍摄时间相隔多年的两张照片后，学生们讨论了「对产品的重大改动」。

collocations: alleged substantial modification of a product
evidence of substantial modification of a product
assess substantial modification of a product

words.enDefinition: completion of the essential obligations despite relatively minor defects, under a doctrine that can allow payment subject to deductions

examples.en: The mock court considered substantial performance because the work was usable despite a small omission.
examples.zh: 虚构法院考虑是否存在「实质履行」，因为尽管少做了一小部分，完工部分仍可使用。

examples.en: We discussed substantial performance alongside the cost of fixing unfinished details in the fictional construction dispute.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构施工争议中，将「实质履行」与修补未完细节的成本结合讨论。

words.enDefinition: Truth in the important substance of an allegation, even if it contains minor inaccuracies that do not alter its overall effect.

examples.en: The class compared two fictional accounts to discuss when minor inaccuracies may be consistent with substantial truth.
examples.zh: 全班比较了两份虚构记述，讨论何种情况下细节小误差仍与「实质真实」相容。

examples.en: The American case exercise asks what difference the disputed date made to the argument about substantial truth.
examples.zh: 美国案例练习追问，有争议的日期对有关「实质真实」的论证有何影响。

words.enDefinition: In United States law, extreme unfairness in the substance or effects of the contract terms.

examples.en: The mock opinion discussed substantive unconscionability after describing how the clause placed almost every burden on one side.
examples.zh: 模拟判决先说明该条款如何将几乎所有负担施加给一方，再讨论「实质上的显失公平」。

examples.en: We examined the terms themselves before considering substantive unconscionability in the American classroom case study.
examples.zh: 在考察美国课堂案例中的「实质上的显失公平」之前，我们先阅读条款本身。

words.enDefinition: performance different from the one initially specified but provided instead under an agreement or applicable rule

examples.en: The fictional problem treats the alternate delivery method as substituted performance permitted by the stated sales rule.
examples.zh: 虚构例题将另一种交付方式视为指定买卖规则允许的「替代履行」。

examples.en: We identified the substituted performance before reviewing why the original delivery method was unavailable in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「替代履行」方式，再考察练习中原交付方式为何不可用。

words.enDefinition: Whether the promised exchange counts as consideration recognized by the applicable law.

examples.en: The English law worksheet discussed sufficiency of consideration before asking whether the classroom exchange seemed economically balanced.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法习题先讨论「对价的法律充分性」，再问课堂交易在经济上是否对等。

examples.en: We examined sufficiency of consideration by asking whether the promised act had legally recognized value in the problem.
examples.zh: 我们考察例题中承诺的行为是否有法律认可的价值，以分析「对价的法律充分性」。

collocations: a question about sufficiency of consideration
distinguish sufficiency of consideration from adequacy

words.enDefinition: Judgment resolving some or all issues without trial under applicable procedural standards

examples.en: The federal worksheet asks why the fictional court considered summary judgment before trial.
examples.zh: 联邦程序习题问，虚构法院为何在庭审前考虑作出「简易判决」。

examples.en: We compared the standards for summary judgment in federal and English procedure.
examples.zh: 我们比较了美国联邦程序和英格兰程序的「简易判决」标准。

words.enDefinition: In England and Wales, an offense normally tried in a magistrates' court without trial on indictment.

examples.en: The classroom chart marked the fictional charge as a summary-only offence in its England and Wales example.
examples.zh: 课堂图表把英格兰与威尔士示例中的虚构指控标为「仅简易审理的罪行」。

examples.en: We read the forum column after identifying the summary-only offence in the hypothetical list of charges.
examples.zh: 我们在假设指控清单中找出「仅简易审理的罪行」后，再查看审理法院一栏。

collocations: a charge for a summary-only offence

words.enDefinition: A legislative provision causing a rule or power to expire at a set time unless it is renewed or extended as allowed.

examples.en: The fictional statute's sunset clause links the expiration of a temporary power to a date in the schedule.
examples.zh: 虚构制定法的「自动失效条款」把一项临时权力的终止与附表中的日期关联起来。

examples.en: We checked whether the sunset clause applied to the entire fictional Act or only selected provisions.
examples.zh: 我们核对「自动失效条款」适用于整部虚构法令还是只适用于特定条文。

collocations: extend the deadline under a sunset clause

words.enDefinition: US intervening event that cuts off responsibility for earlier conduct under applicable law

examples.en: The California exercise asks whether a later event qualifies as a superseding cause.
examples.zh: 加州法律练习问，后续事件是否属于「阻断归责的介入原因」。

examples.en: We discussed the superseding cause category after tracing the complete fictional timeline.
examples.zh: 我们查看完整的虚构时间线后，讨论了「阻断归责的介入原因」这一类别。

words.enDefinition: an impossibility of performance arising from an event occurring after a contract was made

examples.en: The hypothetical dispute raised supervening impossibility after the sole object promised in the sale was accidentally destroyed.
examples.zh: 买卖中唯一承诺的物件意外毁损之后，假设争议提出了「嗣后履行不能」问题。

examples.en: We distinguished supervening impossibility from an obstacle already present when the fictional parties reached their agreement.
examples.zh: 我们将「嗣后履行不能」与虚构当事人达成协议时就已存在的障碍区分开。

words.enDefinition: In United States federal law, court-ordered supervision after a person is released from imprisonment.

examples.en: The federal worksheet placed supervised release after the fictional term of imprisonment on the sentencing timeline.
examples.zh: 联邦法习题在量刑时间线上把「出狱后监督期」标在虚构监禁期之后。

examples.en: We identified supervised release by reading the heading that followed the custody entry in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读羁押条目下方的标题，辨认出「出狱后监督期」。

words.enDefinition: Federal authority over related claims accompanying claims within original jurisdiction

examples.en: The hypothetical considers supplemental jurisdiction for a related claim in the same dispute.
examples.zh: 假设案例讨论同一纠纷中一项相关请求是否属于「补充管辖权」。

examples.en: We diagrammed the connection between claims when discussing supplemental jurisdiction in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂讨论「补充管辖权」时画出了请求之间的联系。

words.enDefinition: additional study alongside the main sponsored course when permitted under the UK Student route conditions

examples.en: The classroom scenario describes supplementary study as an extra course alongside the program in the sponsorship record.
examples.zh: 课堂情景将「附加学习」描述为担保记录中项目之外并行修读的一门课程。

examples.en: We compared supplementary study with replacing the main course in the UK sponsor guidance exercise.
examples.zh: 在英国担保指南练习中，我们将「附加学习」与替换主课程作比较。

collocations: supplementary study alongside a main course

words.enDefinition: a provision identifying obligations or rights that continue after a contract otherwise terminates or expires

examples.en: The survival clause in the fictional agreement kept a confidentiality duty in effect after the contract expired.
examples.zh: 在虚构协议中，「存续条款」使保密义务在合同期满后继续有效。

examples.en: We checked the survival clause before deciding which duties remained on the classroom timeline after termination.
examples.zh: 在判断课堂时间线上的合同终止后还剩哪些义务之前，我们先核对了「存续条款」。

collocations: obligation covered by a survival clause

words.enDefinition: A sentence whose execution is withheld subject to applicable terms and conditions.

examples.en: The mock England and Wales judgment described a suspended sentence as a distinct outcome in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，英格兰与威尔士模拟判决将「缓刑」描述为一种独立结果。

examples.en: We highlighted the suspended sentence entry before comparing the outcomes on the fictional court chart.
examples.zh: 在比较虚构法庭图表中的各种结果前，我们高亮了「缓刑」条目。

collocations: the terms of a suspended sentence
a judgment recording a suspended sentence

words.enDefinition: a temporary pause in an existing enrolment recorded under the provider's applicable rules

examples.en: The sample timetable labels suspension of enrolment as a break after the fictional student's course had already begun.
examples.zh: 样例时间表将「暂停在读注册」标为虚构学生课程开始之后暂停的一段时间。

examples.en: We placed suspension of enrolment separately from cancellation on the display used in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习使用的显示图上，将「暂停在读注册」与取消注册分别标出。

words.enDefinition: a temporary withholding of performance based on an applicable contractual or legal ground

examples.en: The fictional dispute concerns suspension of performance while the parties wait for information about the promised goods.
examples.zh: 虚构争议涉及各方等待有关约定货物的消息期间，是否可以「中止履行」。

examples.en: We marked suspension of performance as a pause on the classroom timeline, distinct from ending the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂时间线上将「中止履行」标为一段暂停，并与结束协议区分开来。

words.enDefinition: applying to move from one UK immigration permission route to another under the relevant rules

examples.en: The lecture contrasts switching immigration routes with extending the same type of permission in a fictional example.
examples.zh: 讲义在虚构示例中对照「转换移民类别」与延长同类许可。

examples.en: We marked the two route names when discussing switching immigration routes in the classroom guidance excerpt.
examples.zh: 我们在讨论课堂指南节选中的「转换移民类别」时，标出两类许可的名称。

words.zhGloss: 美国判决意见的官方案情与裁断摘要
words.enDefinition: In US Supreme Court publication, the Reporter of Decisions' summary accompanying an opinion for the reader's convenience.
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国判决意见的官方案情与裁断摘要

examples.en: The American court guide identifies who prepares the syllabus of an opinion for publication alongside the decision.
examples.zh: 美国法院指南说明由谁撰写「美国判决意见的官方案情与裁断摘要」，与裁判一同公布。

examples.en: Our class compared the syllabus of an opinion with the court's actual reasoning in a fictional example.
examples.zh: 全班在虚构示例中比较了「美国判决意见的官方案情与裁断摘要」与法院的实际论证。

collocations: consult the syllabus of an opinion
compare the syllabus of an opinion
summary in the syllabus of an opinion

words.zhGloss: 加拿大临时居民特许证
words.enDefinition: a discretionary Canadian immigration document that can allow a person who is inadmissible or otherwise fails a requirement to enter or remain temporarily
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大临时居民特许证

examples.en: The classroom decision explains a temporary resident permit in a fictional case involving an admissibility issue.
examples.zh: 课堂判例阐释了一个具有准入问题的虚构案例中的「加拿大临时居民特许证」。

examples.en: We read the temporary resident permit definition alongside the separate rules dealing with visas in Canada.
examples.zh: 阅读「加拿大临时居民特许证」定义时，我们一并阅读加拿大另行适用的签证规则。

collocations: validity of a temporary resident permit

words.enDefinition: legal status held by a foreign national authorized to remain in Canada temporarily, such as a visitor, worker or student

examples.en: The classroom chart groups three Canadian categories under temporary resident status in the fictional case summary.
examples.zh: 课堂图将虚构案例总结中的三个加拿大类别归入「加拿大临时居民身份」。

examples.en: We located temporary resident status on the timeline before examining which activities the specimen document authorized.
examples.zh: 我们先在时间线上找到「加拿大临时居民身份」，再查看样张授权哪些活动。

words.enDefinition: under sales law such as New York's UCC, placing and holding goods at the buyer's disposal with necessary notice

examples.en: The fictional seller's tender of delivery included making conforming goods available and giving the buyer notice.
examples.zh: 练习中，虚构卖方备妥符合约定的货物并通知买方，构成「备妥交付」。

examples.en: We marked the tender of delivery separately from the later collection time in the New York sales exercise.
examples.zh: 在纽约州买卖法练习中，我们将「备妥交付」与稍后的取货时刻分别标记。

words.enDefinition: an offer by a party to carry out what it owes under the contract

examples.en: The question distinguished the seller's tender of performance from the buyer's later decision to accept it.
examples.zh: 题目区分了卖方「履行的提出」与其后买方作出的接受决定。

examples.en: We discussed whether the attempted handover counted as a tender of performance under the hypothetical clauses.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了拟议的交接是否按假设条款构成「履行的提出」。

words.enDefinition: A term supplied by law for a category of contracts, rather than inferred only from this bargain.

examples.en: The classroom problem asked whether a term implied by law applied to the fictional agreement's category.
examples.zh: 课堂题考察一项「依法默示的条款」是否适用于这份虚构协议所属的合同类别。

examples.en: We read the relevant legal extract before identifying the term implied by law in the English exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先读相关法律节选，再确定英格兰法练习中的「依法默示的条款」。

collocations: identify a term implied by law
a default term implied by law
the source of a term implied by law

words.enDefinition: An unstated term inferred for a particular contract from its wording and circumstances under applicable law.

examples.en: The English exercise asked whether the fictional agreement required a term implied in fact to operate coherently.
examples.zh: 英格兰合同法练习问，是否需要一项「依事实默示的条款」，虚构协议才能合理运作。

examples.en: We drew the case facts beside the proposed term implied in fact in the classroom hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂假设案例中，把案件事实列在拟议的「依事实默示的条款」旁边。

collocations: identify a term implied in fact
argue for a term implied in fact
a proposed term implied in fact

words.enDefinition: The period of imprisonment imposed as all or part of a criminal sentence.

examples.en: The fictional judgment recorded a term of imprisonment in the section describing the court's sentencing decision.
examples.zh: 虚构判决在说明法院量刑决定的章节中记载了「监禁期限」。

examples.en: We read the term of imprisonment before locating other provisions in the classroom version of the judgment.
examples.zh: 阅读「监禁期限」后，我们再在课堂版判决中查找其他规定。

words.enDefinition: ending a contract through the parties' agreement under the applicable legal and contractual rules

examples.en: The worksheet treated termination by mutual agreement as a separate event from the seller's earlier proposed withdrawal.
examples.zh: 练习将「合意终止」与卖方先前提议退出区分为两个事件。

examples.en: We looked for both signatures before classifying the fictional document as termination by mutual agreement.
examples.zh: 我们先查看是否有双方签字，再将该虚构文件认作「合意终止」。

collocations: agree to termination by mutual agreement
terms of termination by mutual agreement

words.enDefinition: ending a contract on the basis of a specified reason such as a serious or uncured breach

examples.en: The fictional dispute about termination for cause turned on whether the relevant reason appeared in the agreed clause.
examples.zh: 有关「因事由终止」的虚构争议取决于相关事由是否写入约定条款。

examples.en: We classified the notice as termination for cause because it expressly relied on a stated contractual default.
examples.zh: 我们将该通知归为「因事由终止」，因为它明确以合同规定的一种违约情形为依据。

words.enDefinition: ending a contract under an agreed right that does not require a breach or other fault

examples.en: The classroom agreement allowed termination for convenience after notice, even if the supplier had performed on time.
examples.zh: 课堂所用协议允许一方通知后「任意终止」，即使供应方一直按时履行。

examples.en: We compared termination for convenience with the separate clause requiring an identified contractual breach before termination.
examples.zh: 我们将「任意终止」与另一个要求先确定具体违约才可终止的条款作比较。

words.enDefinition: a communication stating that an agreement is being brought to an end under a stated contractual or legal basis

examples.en: We located the termination notice on the fictional timeline and compared it with the earlier warning letter.
examples.zh: 我们找到虚构时间线上的「终止通知」，并与此前的警告信对照。

examples.en: The exercise asked whether the termination notice identified the clause it purported to rely on in the contract.
examples.zh: 习题问，该「终止通知」是否指出了它主张所依据的合同条款。

collocations: effective date of a termination notice

words.enDefinition: the change of a US student or exchange visitor record to Terminated under a recorded reason

examples.en: The fictional example listed a reason next to termination of a SEVIS record on the school's dashboard.
examples.zh: 学校面板的虚构示例在「终止SEVIS记录」旁列出一个原因。

examples.en: We distinguished termination of a SEVIS record from regular completion while reading the two case timelines.
examples.zh: 我们阅读两份案例时间线时，区分「终止SEVIS记录」与正常完成项目。

collocations: record termination of a SEVIS record
reason for termination of a SEVIS record
date of termination of a SEVIS record

words.zhGloss: 法律在地域上的实际适用
words.enDefinition: In UK legislation, the places or geographic connections in relation to which a provision operates in practice.
acceptedZhAnswers: 法律在地域上的实际适用

examples.en: Our example distinguishes territorial application from the legal systems of which the fictional provision forms part.
examples.zh: 示例将「法律在地域上的实际适用」与虚构条文归属哪些法律体系区分开来。

examples.en: The section on territorial application states which places the rule concerns in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，关于「法律在地域上的实际适用」的条文指明这一规则涉及哪些地区。

words.enDefinition: In UK legislative drafting, the jurisdiction or jurisdictions of whose law a provision forms part.

examples.en: The UK exercise asks us to trace territorial extent using the final provisions of the fictional Act.
examples.zh: 英国练习要求我们根据虚构法令的最后几条查明「条文归属的法域范围」。

examples.en: On the worksheet, territorial extent is shown separately from the date the rule comes into force.
examples.zh: 练习单分别列出「条文归属的法域范围」和规则生效之日。

words.enDefinition: An interpretive approach that focuses on the wording and structure of the contract.

examples.en: The tutor used textual interpretation to explain how the sentence's grammar supported one reading of the draft.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「文本解释」说明句子的语法如何支持对草案的一种理解。

examples.en: We examined the clause's punctuation and structure when practicing textual interpretation in the fictional contract dispute.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构合同争议中练习「文本解释」，检查条款的标点与结构。

collocations: an argument based on textual interpretation
a textual interpretation of a clause

words.enDefinition: The principle that a defendant responsible for a recognized kind of harm is liable for its full extent even if an unusual vulnerability made it worse.

examples.en: The English law exercise introduces the thin skull rule after assuming responsibility for the harm.
examples.zh: 英格兰法练习先假定对损害负有责任，再介绍「薄颅骨规则」。

examples.en: We discussed the thin skull rule in a fictional example involving unusually severe consequences.
examples.zh: 我们用一个后果异常严重的虚构示例讨论了「薄颅骨规则」。

collocations: apply the thin skull rule in a hypothetical
scope of the thin skull rule

words.enDefinition: Federal pleading asserting a claim against a newly joined third party

examples.en: The fictional federal third-party complaint introduces a person outside the original case.
examples.zh: 虚构的联邦「第三方起诉状」引入了原案件当事人之外的一人。

examples.en: We highlighted the separate claim stated in the third-party complaint in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上标出了「第三方起诉状」所陈述的独立请求。

words.enDefinition: a contract claim that cannot be maintained because the applicable period for bringing it has expired, subject to exceptions

examples.en: The classroom case note reports a time-barred contract claim after applying the stipulated limitation rule to the facts.
examples.zh: 课堂案例注释将规定的时效规则适用于事实后，记录了一项「超过时效的合同请求」。

examples.en: We traced the dates used by the mock court to classify the demand as a time-barred contract claim.
examples.zh: 我们追踪虚构法院所用的几个日期，了解该请求为什么被列为「超过时效的合同请求」。

collocations: defence to a time-barred contract claim

words.enDefinition: the date or period when a contractual duty must be carried out

examples.en: The time for performance appeared in a separate schedule attached to the fictional venue agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构场地协议所附的一份独立时间表列出了「履行时间」。

examples.en: We read the signed amendment to see whether it changed the time for performance originally specified.
examples.zh: 我们阅读已签署的修订文本，查看它是否改变了原定「履行时间」。

words.expression: time is of the essence clause
words.lemma: time is of the essence clause
words.enDefinition: a term making timely performance of a specified obligation essential, with consequences depending on the governing law
acceptedEnVariants: time is of the essence clause

examples.en: The contract excerpt contains a time is of the essence clause for delivery before a scheduled exhibition.
examples.zh: 合同节选含有一项「时间为要件条款」，适用于预定展览前的交付。

examples.en: We checked whether the time is of the essence clause covered only delivery or all scheduled obligations.
examples.zh: 我们核对「时间为要件条款」只涉及交付，还是覆盖所有有时限的义务。

collocations: include a time is of the essence clause
interpret a time is of the essence clause
scope of a time is of the essence clause

words.enDefinition: An England and Wales consent order staying proceedings on settlement terms usually recorded in a schedule, with provision to apply to enforce the terms.

examples.en: In the English example, the agreement is in the schedule to the Tomlin order.
examples.zh: 在这个英格兰案例中，协议载于「汤姆林令」的附表。

examples.en: Our tutor used a Tomlin order to illustrate a stay based on settlement terms.
examples.zh: 老师通过一份「汤姆林令」举例说明法院如何按和解条款中止诉讼。

collocations: proceedings stayed under a Tomlin order

words.enDefinition: Civil wrong involving a breach of reasonable care causing legally recognized harm

examples.en: The seminar separates the tort of negligence into several questions on its fictional case chart.
examples.zh: 研讨课把「过失侵权」拆分为几个问题，列在虚构案例的图表上。

examples.en: Our worksheet applies the tort of negligence to a dispute over a damaged classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们的习题将「过失侵权」用于分析一场围绕课堂模型受损的纠纷。

collocations: elements of the tort of negligence
liability in the tort of negligence
diagram of the tort of negligence

words.enDefinition: A regularly observed practice in a trade that may inform the meaning of an agreement.

examples.en: The New York goods exercise considered a trade usage when interpreting a term about standard poster sizes.
examples.zh: 纽约州货物买卖练习解释有关常用海报尺寸的条款时，考察了一项「行业惯例」。

examples.en: We asked what evidence of trade usage existed beyond one party's own practice in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 我们考察，在虚构案例中，除一方自己的做法外，还有什么证据能证明「行业惯例」。

collocations: interpret a term in light of trade usage

words.enDefinition: the school receiving a student's SEVIS record from another institution in a US immigration transfer

examples.en: The transfer-in school appears as the receiving institution in the fictional diagram of record control.
examples.zh: 在虚构记录管理图中，「SEVIS接收学校」是接收记录的院校。

examples.en: We matched the transfer-in school label to the new institution in the classroom sample timeline.
examples.zh: 我们把「SEVIS接收学校」标签与课堂样例时间线上的新院校对应起来。

collocations: record received by the transfer-in school

words.enDefinition: the institution releasing a student's SEVIS record to a different school

examples.en: The transfer-out school held the record before the marked release date in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 在虚构示例中，「SEVIS转出学校」在标出的转出日期之前掌管该记录。

examples.en: We used different colors for the transfer-out school and the receiving institution on the exercise diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在练习图上用不同颜色分别表示「SEVIS转出学校」与接收院校。

words.enDefinition: the date on which control of a transferring student's SEVIS record passes to the designated new school

examples.en: The sample timeline places the transfer release date between the two schools' labeled periods of record control.
examples.zh: 示例时间线把「SEVIS转出日期」标在两所学校各自掌管记录的时段之间。

examples.en: We identified the transfer release date in the teaching record before comparing it with the new term's start.
examples.zh: 我们先在教学记录中找出「SEVIS转出日期」，再与新学期开始日期比较。

collocations: record control after the transfer release date

words.enDefinition: A provision explaining how legal rules apply during the change from one legal regime to another.

examples.en: The textbook uses a transitional provision to show how the fictional statute treats matters already in progress.
examples.zh: 教材用一项「过渡条款」说明虚构制定法如何处理已经开始的事项。

examples.en: The class read the transitional provision after comparing the commencement dates printed on the two handouts.
examples.zh: 全班比较两份讲义印出的生效日期后，阅读了「过渡条款」。

words.enDefinition: A condition on premises that exists for a limited time, with its duration potentially relevant to notice.

examples.en: The class considered when the transitory condition first appeared in the fictional shopping concourse chronology.
examples.zh: 全班根据虚构购物大厅事件的时间线，讨论那种「短暂存在的状况」最早何时出现。

examples.en: The witness describes a transitory condition that appeared briefly between two inspections of the fictional hall.
examples.zh: 证人描述说，在对虚构礼堂进行的两次检查之间，曾出现过一种「短暂存在的状况」。

collocations: actual notice of a transitory condition

words.zhGloss: 消费者合同条款透明性
words.enDefinition: The United Kingdom consumer law requirement for written terms to be legible and expressed in plain, intelligible language.
acceptedZhAnswers: 消费者合同条款透明性

examples.en: The seminar used two fictional notices to discuss transparency of consumer terms under the United Kingdom reading.
examples.zh: 讨论课用两则虚构通知，分析英国法律阅读材料中的「消费者合同条款透明性」。

examples.en: We reviewed the wording and readability when discussing transparency of consumer terms in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂例题中的「消费者合同条款透明性」时，我们查看了措辞及可读性。

collocations: a rule on transparency of consumer terms
an issue of transparency of consumer terms

words.enDefinition: Wrongful interference with another person's possession or use of movable property, actionable under rules that vary by jurisdiction.

examples.en: The US property torts chapter uses a fictional loaned book to introduce the idea of trespass to chattels.
examples.zh: 美国财产侵权章节用一本虚构的借出书籍介绍「动产侵害」的概念。

examples.en: We discussed whether the short interference described in the scenario could be analysed as trespass to chattels.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了能否把情境所述的短暂干涉分析为「动产侵害」。

words.enDefinition: Someone who enters or remains on land without legally effective permission or another lawful entitlement.

examples.en: In the fictional case, the court considered whether the entrant became a trespasser when permission ended.
examples.zh: 在虚构案例中，法院考虑了许可终止后进入者是否成了「无权进入或停留者」。

examples.en: The heading trespasser identifies a category of entrant in this extract from a common law textbook.
examples.zh: 在这段普通法教材摘录中，「无权进入或停留者」这个标题标明了进入者的一种类型。

words.enDefinition: Collection of documents assembled for use at an England and Wales trial

examples.en: The class reads the index before opening the fictional trial bundle.
examples.zh: 课堂先看索引，再翻阅虚构的「庭审文件汇编」。

examples.en: We found the relevant specimen invoice in the trial bundle for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习用的「庭审文件汇编」里找到了相关的样本发票。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚学费保障服务
words.enDefinition: the Australian government service assisting eligible students when their provider cannot fully deliver a course under the scheme
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚学费保障服务

examples.en: The case diagram lists the Tuition Protection Service beside the options described for the fictional course closure.
examples.zh: 案例图将「澳大利亚学费保障服务」列在虚构课程停办情形所述选项旁。

examples.en: We identified the Tuition Protection Service in the section of the department's guidance about a provider default.
examples.zh: 我们在政府部门指南有关教育机构未履行供课义务的部分找到了「澳大利亚学费保障服务」。

collocations: role of the Tuition Protection Service

words.enDefinition: Beyond the legal powers given to a person or body, often used when reviewing the validity of an act or rule.

examples.en: The mock judgment asks whether the fictional regulation was ultra vires under the authority granted by Parliament.
examples.zh: 模拟判决讨论，依议会所授予的权限，虚构规章是否是「超越权限的」。

examples.en: In class, we compared the grant of power with the conduct alleged to be ultra vires.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把授予的权力与被指为「超越权限的」行为作比较。

words.expression: unanimous verdict in a criminal case
words.lemma: unanimous verdict in a criminal case
words.enDefinition: A criminal jury verdict in which all jurors agree on the decision under the applicable procedure.
acceptedEnVariants: unanimous verdict in a criminal case

examples.en: The federal worksheet explained a unanimous verdict in a criminal case using a fictional jury's recorded agreement.
examples.zh: 联邦法课堂题用虚构陪审团所记载的一致意见，解释「刑事案件的一致裁决」。

examples.en: We marked the unanimous verdict in a criminal case after reading the classroom transcript of the announcement.
examples.zh: 我们读过课堂宣告记录后，标出了「刑事案件的一致裁决」。

collocations: reach a unanimous verdict in a criminal case
an instruction on a unanimous verdict in a criminal case
a record of a unanimous verdict in a criminal case

words.enDefinition: Extreme unfairness in a contract or term that can affect enforceability under applicable United States law.

examples.en: The New York classroom exercise asked about unconscionability in a fictional goods agreement with a sharply one-sided term.
examples.zh: 纽约州课堂习题就一份条款明显偏向一方的虚构货物协议，提出了「显失公平」问题。

examples.en: We read the mock court's discussion of unconscionability before comparing the agreement's terms and formation circumstances.
examples.zh: 对照协议条款与订立情形前，我们先读了模拟法院对「显失公平」的讨论。

words.enDefinition: Voluntary commitment to provide services that may create a duty of care

examples.en: The fictional note records an undertaking to act to review one part of the display plan.
examples.zh: 虚构记录记载了审查展品计划中一部分内容的「承担行动义务」。

examples.en: We examined the scope of an undertaking to act in the California law worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在加州法律习题中分析了「承担行动义务」的范围。

collocations: scope of an undertaking to act

words.enDefinition: Improper use of influence or a relationship of trust that undermines a party's free decision to agree.

examples.en: The mock English judgment considered undue influence when discussing how trust affected the fictional party's apparent agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟英格兰判决在讨论信任如何影响虚构当事人表面同意时，考察了「不当影响」。

examples.en: We highlighted the facts about the relationship before discussing undue influence in our seminar's fictional contract problem.
examples.zh: 讨论课分析虚构合同题里的「不当影响」之前，我们先标出了有关双方关系的事实。

words.enDefinition: An agreement to which a legal rule denies enforceability in the relevant circumstances.

examples.en: The fictional American opinion treated the missing formality as the reason for classifying an unenforceable agreement.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决把形式要件欠缺作为认定「不可强制执行的协议」的理由。

examples.en: We discussed why the mock court called it an unenforceable agreement despite evidence that both parties had agreed.
examples.zh: 尽管有证据显示双方达成合意，模拟法院仍称它为「不可强制执行的协议」，我们讨论了原因。

collocations: classify an agreement as an unenforceable agreement
an action on an unenforceable agreement
the effect of an unenforceable agreement

words.enDefinition: In common law formation terminology, a contract in which an offer invites acceptance through a requested act.

examples.en: The American lecture used a fictional reward for a returned notebook to illustrate a unilateral contract.
examples.zh: 美国课堂用送回笔记本即可获得奖励的虚构例子说明「单务合同」。

examples.en: We identified the requested act before deciding whether the hypothetical offer described a unilateral contract in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先找出所要求的行为，再判断习题中的假设要约是否涉及「单务合同」。

collocations: an offer for a unilateral contract
an example of a unilateral contract

words.enDefinition: A mistaken belief held by only one party when the parties entered into an agreement.

examples.en: The seminar identified unilateral mistake because only one fictional party misunderstood the quantity in the proposal.
examples.zh: 讨论课认定存在「单方错误」，因为只有一方误解了虚构提议中的数量。

examples.en: We looked separately at what each party believed before discussing unilateral mistake in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 讨论课堂案例中的「单方错误」前，我们分别查看了双方各自相信的情况。

words.enDefinition: A subject-based codification of the general and permanent federal laws of the United States.

examples.en: The library worksheet distinguishes the United States Code from the chronological collection used in the next question.
examples.zh: 图书馆练习单区分了「《美国法典》」与下一题使用的按时间顺序编纂的汇编。

examples.en: Our seminar locates a definition in the United States Code using the title and section supplied in class.
examples.zh: 研讨课根据课上提供的编号和条号，在「《美国法典》」中找出一项定义。

collocations: section of the United States Code
title of the United States Code
codified in the United States Code

words.enDefinition: The official series publishing opinions of the Supreme Court of the United States.

examples.en: The American research exercise places United States Reports alongside other sources where the same opinions can appear.
examples.zh: 美国法律检索练习把「《美国最高法院判例汇编》」与也可能刊载相同意见的其他来源并列。

examples.en: We used the United States Reports reference to identify the volume and first page on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习单中的「《美国最高法院判例汇编》」引证，找出了卷号和起始页。

words.enDefinition: The official chronological collection in which US public laws, private laws, and certain other documents are published.

examples.en: The American seminar uses the United States Statutes at Large to discuss how enacted laws are arranged chronologically.
examples.zh: 美国法律研讨课用「《美国联邦法令全书》」说明已制定的法律怎样按时间顺序编排。

examples.en: We identified the volume number in the United States Statutes at Large reference on our reading worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在阅读练习单的「《美国联邦法令全书》」引文中找出了卷号。

collocations: volume of the United States Statutes at Large
citation to the United States Statutes at Large
published in the United States Statutes at Large

words.enDefinition: retention of a benefit at another's expense in circumstances that the applicable legal system recognizes as unjust

examples.en: The class discussed unjust enrichment after reading about a payment received twice in the fictional account records.
examples.zh: 全班在阅读虚构账目中同一款项被收取两次的情况之后，讨论了「不当得利」。

examples.en: We distinguished unjust enrichment from damages measured by what the contract would have delivered under the stipulated facts.
examples.zh: 在题设事实下，我们区分了「不当得利」与按合同本可履行的利益计算的赔偿。

words.enDefinition: Agreement to an offer without adding a condition or requiring a change to its terms.

examples.en: The mock judgment treated the short reply as unqualified acceptance of the terms in the last email.
examples.zh: 模拟判决将简短回复视为对上一封邮件条款的「无保留承诺」。

examples.en: We looked for unqualified acceptance after checking whether the fictional recipient had requested a different price.
examples.zh: 我们先核对虚构收件人是否要求另定价格，再寻找「无保留承诺」。

words.enDefinition: A landholder's ability to use land and benefit from its ordinary occupancy, protected to varying degrees by nuisance law.

examples.en: The group marked the passages about use and enjoyment of land in the fictional neighbours' statements.
examples.zh: 小组在虚构邻居的陈述中标出了有关「土地的使用与享用」的段落。

examples.en: The exercise separates physical damage from an interference with use and enjoyment of land in the second scenario.
examples.zh: 在第二个情境中，练习把有形损坏与对「土地的使用与享用」的干扰区分开来。

collocations: interfere with use and enjoyment of land
ordinary use and enjoyment of land
protect use and enjoyment of land

words.enDefinition: an application that meets the legal requirements for valid lodgement, separate from whether a visa can be granted

examples.en: The policy exercise distinguishes a valid visa application from an application that satisfies the criteria for grant.
examples.zh: 政策练习区分「有效签证申请」与符合获批标准的申请。

examples.en: We marked the question about a valid visa application before considering the fictional decision-maker's later assessment in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在讨论虚构决定人员的后续审核前，先标出有关「有效签证申请」的问题。

collocations: requirements for a valid visa application

words.enDefinition: Movement of a pending case to a different legally authorized court location

examples.en: The mock docket shows a venue transfer between two districts on the map.
examples.zh: 模拟卷宗显示，地图上的两个司法区之间发生了「审理地移转」。

examples.en: We listed the original district separately from the destination after venue transfer.
examples.zh: 我们把原司法区和「审理地移转」后的目标司法区分别列出。

words.enDefinition: A trial decision finding the charged offense unproved under the applicable standard.

examples.en: The mock transcript recorded a verdict of not guilty for the second count in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 模拟庭审记录载明，虚构案例的第二项指控获「无罪裁决」。

examples.en: We matched the verdict of not guilty to the count listed on the classroom jury form.
examples.zh: 我们把「无罪裁决」与课堂陪审团表格中列出的相应指控项对应起来。

collocations: return a verdict of not guilty
record a verdict of not guilty
a verdict of not guilty on one count

words.enDefinition: A statement that can be tested as true or false, as opposed to a value judgment or personal reaction.

examples.en: The tutorial compares a verifiable assertion of fact with a reader's personal rating of a fictional exhibition.
examples.zh: 辅导课把「可核实的事实断言」与读者对虚构展览的个人评分作比较。

examples.en: The students argued over whether the newspaper's fictional sentence contained a verifiable assertion of fact about attendance.
examples.zh: 学生们争论虚构报纸上的句子是否含有一项关于到场人数的「可核实的事实断言」。

collocations: make a verifiable assertion of fact
contain a verifiable assertion of fact
identify a verifiable assertion of fact

words.enDefinition: confirmation of the authenticity or details of an acceptance letter by the issuing Canadian institution under the applicable immigration process

examples.en: The exercise places verification of acceptance letter details between application submission and the fictional officer's decision.
examples.zh: 习题将「录取信核验」安排在提交申请和虚构官员作出决定之间。

examples.en: We distinguished verification of acceptance letter details from the admissions decision itself in the sample case.
examples.zh: 在样例中，我们区分了「录取信核验」和录取决定本身。

collocations: record verification of acceptance letter details
institutional verification of acceptance letter details
status of verification of acceptance letter details

words.enDefinition: The principle requiring courts to follow precedents of higher courts that bind them on the issue concerned.

examples.en: The American courts worksheet uses vertical stare decisis to explain how a lower court treats higher precedent.
examples.zh: 美国法院制度练习单用「纵向遵循先例原则」解释下级法院如何对待上级法院的先例。

examples.en: Our tutor draws two levels on the diagram before introducing vertical stare decisis in the hypothetical system.
examples.zh: 老师先在示意图上画出两级法院，再介绍假设体系中的「纵向遵循先例原则」。

words.enDefinition: Civil liability attributed to one party for another's wrongful conduct because the required relationship and connection are established.

examples.en: The lecture introduces vicarious liability through a fictional complaint involving an employer and a shop assistant.
examples.zh: 讲座用一起涉及雇主和店员的虚构申诉介绍「替代责任」。

examples.en: The summary on vicarious liability explains why the organisation's own conduct is a separate question in the example.
examples.zh: 关于「替代责任」的摘要解释，为何在示例中，组织自身的行为是另一个问题。

words.enDefinition: A statement describing how an offense affected a victim, submitted under applicable procedure.

examples.en: The classroom docket listed a victim impact statement as a separate document in the fictional sentencing file.
examples.zh: 课堂案件登记表把「被害人影响陈述」列为虚构量刑卷宗中的一份独立文书。

examples.en: The mock sentencing transcript referred to a victim impact statement when explaining what information the court had considered.
examples.zh: 模拟量刑记录在说明法庭考量了哪些信息时，提到了「被害人影响陈述」。

collocations: the purpose of a victim impact statement

words.enDefinition: a date on which a visa ceases to be in effect under the applicable grant and legal rules

examples.en: The classroom chart marks the visa cessation date separately from the last teaching day in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 课堂图表将虚构示例的「签证失效日期」与最后一个教学日分别标出。

examples.en: We identified the visa cessation date in the Australian decision excerpt assigned for discussion in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在指定讨论的澳大利亚决定节选中找到了「签证失效日期」。

collocations: effect of a visa cessation date

words.enDefinition: an authorized official who makes a decision on a visa application under the applicable immigration law

examples.en: The exercise names the visa decision-maker in the administrative record, separate from the institution that offered admission.
examples.zh: 练习中的行政记录写明「签证决定人员」，并与提供录取的院校分开列示。

examples.en: We read which documents the visa decision-maker relied on in the hypothetical Australian decision summary.
examples.zh: 我们阅读假设澳大利亚决定的摘要，查看「签证决定人员」依据了哪些文件。

collocations: reasons given by a visa decision-maker

words.enDefinition: a traveler exempt from the visa requirement for a specified trip, subject to the applicable entry rules

examples.en: The handout classifies the fictional visitor as a visa-exempt traveler for the stated Canadian trip.
examples.zh: 讲义将该虚构访客在题设加拿大行程中归为「免签旅行者」。

examples.en: We discussed why a visa-exempt traveler may still need a separate travel authorization in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论课堂习题中的「免签旅行者」为何仍可能需要另外的旅行授权。

words.enDefinition: formal granting of a visa by the authority responsible for issuing it

examples.en: The timeline lists visa issuance before the fictional traveler arrived at the port of entry for inspection.
examples.zh: 时间线上，「签证签发」在虚构旅行者抵达入境口岸接受检查之前。

examples.en: We placed the date of visa issuance next to the consular decision in the classroom timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂时间线上将「签证签发」的日期标在领事决定旁。

collocations: visa issuance by a consular post

words.enDefinition: An apparent agreement treated as having no contractual legal effect from the outset under the applicable law.

examples.en: The mock opinion described a void contract as having no contractual effect from the beginning in that jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 模拟判决指出，在该司法辖区，「无效合同」从一开始就不发生合同效力。

examples.en: We asked why the classroom problem classified the fictional document as a void contract under the stated rule.
examples.zh: 我们问，课堂题为何按所给规则把这份虚构文书归为「无效合同」。

collocations: classify an agreement as a void contract
an issue involving a void contract
distinguish a void contract from a voidable one

words.enDefinition: A contract that has effect unless a party entitled to avoid it chooses to do so.

examples.en: The classroom case distinguished a voidable contract from an agreement that had no effect from the start.
examples.zh: 课堂案例区分了「可撤销合同」和从一开始就不发生效力的协议。

examples.en: We discussed who could avoid the voidable contract under the assumptions stated in the fictional problem.
examples.zh: 我们讨论在虚构题设下，谁有权撤销这份「可撤销合同」。

collocations: a party to a voidable contract
distinguish a voidable contract from a void agreement

words.enDefinition: English defense based on freely accepting the relevant risk and its consequences

examples.en: The English law exercise introduces volenti non fit injuria through a fictional consent question.
examples.zh: 英格兰法练习通过一个虚构的同意问题介绍「自甘风险抗辩」。

examples.en: We kept volenti non fit injuria separate from the apportionment question on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表上将「自甘风险抗辩」与责任分摊问题分开。

collocations: scope of volenti non fit injuria

words.enDefinition: Freely agreeing to bear a risk, with awareness of its nature

examples.en: The fictional scenario asks whether simple awareness shows voluntary acceptance of risk in the circumstances.
examples.zh: 虚构情境问，在题设条件下，仅仅知道风险能否证明「自愿接受风险」。

examples.en: We discussed voluntary acceptance of risk separately from the claimant's possible lack of reasonable care.
examples.zh: 我们把「自愿接受风险」与原告可能未尽合理注意分开讨论。

collocations: evidence of voluntary acceptance of risk

words.enDefinition: The rule requiring a voluntary act, or a legally relevant omission, as a basis for liability.

examples.en: The fictional opinion discussed the voluntary act requirement before considering the separate question of the mental element.
examples.zh: 虚构判决先讨论「自愿行为要件」，再单独考察心理状态要件。

examples.en: We identified the voluntary act requirement in the assigned criminal law extract before comparing the examples.
examples.zh: 比较各例之前，我们先在指定的刑法节选中找出「自愿行为要件」。

collocations: an issue under the voluntary act requirement
the scope of the voluntary act requirement

words.enDefinition: a legally recognized giving up of a contractual right inferred from a party's actions under the governing rules

examples.en: The fictional judge considered waiver by conduct because the seller repeatedly accepted deliveries made after the stated date.
examples.zh: 虚构法官考虑是否存在「以行为表示放弃权利」，因为卖方反复接受晚于约定日期的交付。

examples.en: We examined the written objection before deciding whether waiver by conduct could be inferred in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在判断练习中能否推断出「以行为表示放弃权利」之前，我们先查阅书面异议。

words.enDefinition: a party's voluntary decision to give up reliance on a condition intended for its benefit, where legally effective

examples.en: The problem examined waiver of a condition after the fictional buyer expressly stopped requiring the inspection before completion.
examples.zh: 虚构买方明确放弃完成前的检查要求后，例题讨论了「放弃援引条件」。

examples.en: We considered whether the letter showed waiver of a condition or merely extended the original deadline.
examples.zh: 我们讨论该函是否构成「放弃援引条件」，还是只延长既定期限。

collocations: effect of waiver of a condition

words.enDefinition: Federal agreement to dispense with formal service of the summons

examples.en: The sample federal file contains a waiver of service of summons among its early entries.
examples.zh: 联邦法院样本案卷的早期记录中有一份「放弃正式传票送达」。

examples.en: We labeled the waiver of service of summons separately from the complaint in the mock docket.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟卷宗中将「放弃正式传票送达」与起诉状分开标注。

collocations: request a waiver of service of summons
record a waiver of service of summons
specimen waiver of service of summons

words.enDefinition: language seeking to exclude or change an otherwise applicable warranty, subject to governing law

examples.en: The mock opinion reviewed whether the warranty disclaimer met the requirements of the assigned New York sales rule.
examples.zh: 虚构判词审查该「担保排除声明」是否符合题目指定的纽约州买卖规则。

examples.en: We read the warranty disclaimer before comparing it with the separate limit on available damages.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「担保排除声明」，再与单独限制赔偿范围的条款作比较。

words.enDefinition: a seller's assurance under applicable sales law that the transfer conveys good title and, normally, no undisclosed lien

examples.en: The worksheet raised a warranty of title question when a third party claimed the illustrated goods as collateral.
examples.zh: 第三人主张所示货物是其担保物时，习题提出了「权属担保」问题。

examples.en: We discussed the warranty of title separately from whether the goods worked as promised in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「权属担保」与货物能否按承诺使用分别讨论。

collocations: warranty of title in a sale

words.enDefinition: Degree of persuasive force given to evidence in evaluating a disputed issue

examples.en: The fictional judgment discusses the weight of evidence after admitting both documents.
examples.zh: 虚构判决接纳两份文书后，讨论各自的「证据证明力」。

examples.en: The sample opinion gives limited weight of evidence to the unsigned record.
examples.zh: 裁判意见的示例认为，未签名记录的「证据证明力」有限。

words.enDefinition: A canon of statutory interpretation that reads a provision in the context of the entire enactment.

examples.en: The American law exercise applies the whole-act rule by reading the disputed section with the rest.
examples.zh: 美国法练习运用「通读整部法令规则」，把争议条文与其他部分对照阅读。

examples.en: Our outline introduces the whole-act rule after showing how two sections of the fictional statute relate.
examples.zh: 提纲先说明虚构制定法的两项条文有什么关联，然后介绍「通读整部法令规则」。

collocations: reasoning based on the whole-act rule

words.enDefinition: Civil responsibility connected with keeping a legally classified wild animal, subject to applicable ownership, risk, and harm requirements.

examples.en: The comparative table lists wild animal liability separately from statutory rules covering certain domestic animals in California.
examples.zh: 比较表把「野生动物致损责任」与加州某些家养动物适用的法定规则分开列出。

examples.en: The wild animal liability seminar uses stipulated facts and focuses on how the legal category is defined.
examples.zh: 关于「野生动物致损责任」的研讨课采用双方约定的事实，重点是该法律分类的定义方式。

words.enDefinition: a UK sponsor's withdrawal of its support for a particular student in its immigration sponsorship records

examples.en: The classroom timeline marks withdrawal of student sponsorship as an event recorded by the fictional sponsor.
examples.zh: 课堂时间线将「撤回学生担保」标为虚构担保机构记录的一项事件。

examples.en: We distinguished withdrawal of student sponsorship from a later decision about immigration permission in the case example.
examples.zh: 我们在案例示例中，将「撤回学生担保」与随后作出的移民许可决定区分开。

collocations: date of withdrawal of student sponsorship
grounds for withdrawal of student sponsorship

words.enDefinition: Genuine settlement communication normally excluded as evidence on the merits in English proceedings

examples.en: The civil litigation problem describes the settlement email as a without prejudice communication under English law.
examples.zh: 这道民事诉讼题将和解邮件描述为英格兰法律下「和解保密沟通」。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed why the label alone cannot make a letter a without prejudice communication.
examples.zh: 老师讨论了为什么只加一个标记不能让信件成为「和解保密沟通」。

collocations: privilege for a without prejudice communication
admissibility of a without prejudice communication

words.expression: without prejudice save as to costs
words.lemma: without prejudice save as to costs
words.zhGloss: 不损害权利但费用除外
words.enDefinition: English settlement wording preserving protection while allowing consideration when costs are decided
acceptedZhAnswers: 不损害权利但费用除外
acceptedEnVariants: without prejudice save as to costs

examples.en: The example letter is marked without prejudice save as to costs in the margin next to the proposal.
examples.zh: 示例信件在提议旁的空白处标注了「不损害权利但费用除外」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why without prejudice save as to costs appears in the heading of the sample offer.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么示例要约的标题写着「不损害权利但费用除外」。

collocations: letter marked without prejudice save as to costs
offer made without prejudice save as to costs
heading without prejudice save as to costs

words.enDefinition: Federal protection for qualifying materials prepared in anticipation of litigation

examples.en: The mock order discusses work-product protection for notes prepared specifically for the lawsuit.
examples.zh: 模拟法院命令讨论专为该诉讼准备的笔记是否受到「诉讼准备材料保护」。

examples.en: We marked work-product protection beside the separate question about attorney-client communications.
examples.zh: 我们在关于律师与委托人沟通的独立问题旁标出了「诉讼准备材料保护」。

words.enDefinition: An agreement whose terms are recorded in writing as the parties' contract.

examples.en: The classroom file contained a written contract listing the fictional exhibition dates and shared room details.
examples.zh: 课堂档案里有一份「书面合同」，列出虚构展览的日期和共用场地细节。

examples.en: We compared the written contract with the earlier correspondence to see which points the document covered.
examples.zh: 我们把「书面合同」与早期往来记录对照，查看文书涵盖了哪些事项。

collocations: the terms of a written contract

words.enDefinition: A written record evidencing an agreement, which may satisfy a form requirement under applicable law.

examples.en: The mock American opinion asked whether a message served as a written memorandum of a contract for goods.
examples.zh: 模拟美国判决问，一则消息是否可作为货物合同的「书面备忘记录」。

examples.en: We compared the written memorandum of a contract with the agreement described in the classroom conversation transcript.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同书面备忘记录」与课堂对话记录中描述的协议作了比较。

collocations: identify a written memorandum of a contract
details in a written memorandum of a contract
a signed written memorandum of a contract
